items.title: 仏大統領、「正当性ない」抗議活動禁止へ　暴動は「極左に責任」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Michel Rose

[パリ　２２日　 ロイター] -
items.body:
Michel Rose

[パリ　２２日　 ロイター] - フランスのマクロン大統領は２２日、教育環境の改善などを求める大規模な抗議デモが各地で続く中、「正当性のない」抗議活動を向こう数日以内に禁止すると表明した。また、先週末に発生した暴動や略奪は極左の「扇動的な」団体や破壊行為者に責任があるとの認識を示した。

マクロン氏はこの日、情報機関トップや主要閣僚との会合を実施。会合後に記者団に対し「１７日に国家の転覆を目的とする極左団体による政治的かつ扇動的な行為があった」と述べ、労働組合などが主催するデモについては実施を認めるものの、商店などを保護するためデモ隊のルート変更を求める可能性があると語った。

ダルマナン法相は、デモ参加禁止命令に違反した人の選挙権停止のほか、暴力行為や略奪、警察への攻撃に関与した人に対するソーシャルメディアの利用制限を導入したい考えを示した。

地元当局によると、フランス第２、第３の都市であるマルセイユとリヨンで２４日に予定されていた全ての抗議活動は禁止されている。ただ、フランス最大の学生組合ＵＮＥＦは２４日に集会を呼びかけているほか、２０１８年に発足した反体制運動「黄色いベスト運動」もパリ中心部を行進する計画を届け出るなど、新たな抗議活動の動きは広がりつつある。

２２日はパリで予定されていた学生による抗議集会が当初は禁止されたが、その後実施が認められた。ただ、無許可の集会が開かれる可能性が警戒される中、公共交通当局はパリ中心部の複数の地下鉄駅を閉鎖している。

items.title: External evaluators find flaws in OpenAI’s AI monitoring system in pilot review
items.author: The Straits Times
items.summary: METR and Redwood Research found several new vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s internal system.
items.body:
External evaluators find flaws in OpenAI’s AI monitoring system in pilot review
Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox

An exercise conducted from July 21 to Aug 11 gave outside researchers “a deep level of access” to OpenAI’s internal infrastructure.
PHOTO: REUTERS

Published   Oct 23, 2026, 03:40 AM

Updated   Oct 23, 2026, 03:40 AM

Set as preferred source

Summarise

METR and Redwood Research found flaws in OpenAI’s AI monitoring system during a July 21 to Aug 11 pilot review. They said an exploit could hide hundreds of agent actions from monitoring.
The evaluators also found a possible way for OpenAI’s Codex agents to bypass security limits and use users’ full permissions. OpenAI said it has patched the issues in production safeguards.
The review gave outside researchers deep access to OpenAI’s internal code, documents and staff. The groups said future evaluations should be more transparent, while OpenAI said the findings will shape later research.

AI generated

NEW YORK - AI safety evaluators METR and Redwood Research found several new vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s internal system, including an exploit agents could have used to keep hundreds of their actions from being monitored, in a pilot review earlier this year.
The exercise, conducted from July 21 to Aug 11, gave outside researchers “a deep level of access” to OpenAI’s internal infrastructure for so-called embedded evaluations, the safety nonprofits said on Oct 22.
METR and Redwood said they each sent one researcher, tested an arrangement giving access to OpenAI’s internal code, documentation and some technical staff. Both were accompanied on site and used OpenAI-issued devices that “never left the premises”.

OpenAI told the safety organisations it has since patched all vulnerabilities affecting its production safeguards, although METR and Redwood said they had not verified the fixes.
AI labs, experts and the Trump administration have touted independent evaluation by outside reviewers as a way to safely advance the technology without slowing its development.
However, AI companies are worried that evaluator staff working inside the companies’ walls could take proprietary information to rivals, Reuters reported earlier this month.

While OpenAI received a full 61-page internal report, METR and Redwood said they agreed to publish only a broad summary publicly, and gave OpenAI the right to redact sensitive information.
Unlike in some previous evaluations, they could not independently disclose those redactions, but said they expected greater transparency in future evaluations.
The researchers also identified a potential way for OpenAI’s Codex agents to bypass security restrictions and act with their users’ full permissions.

The evaluators assessed the monitoring system as it existed on and before July 21, and noted that OpenAI was expanding the system during the exercise.
OpenAI said the “findings helped strengthen safeguards as we expanded the system and will help shape future research collaborations with METR and other third-party evaluators.” REUTERS

items.title: Café arábica recua após atingir máxima em quase 6 semanas; cacau também cai
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os contratos futuros do café arábica na bolsa ICE recuaram nesta quinta-feira em relação à recente alta de quase seis semanas, à medida que os operadores realizaram lucros, com a expectativa de que os estoques dos países consumidores continuem a crescer à medida que as exportações do Brasil, principal produtor, ganham ritmo.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros do café arábica na bolsa ICE recuaram nesta quinta-feira em relação à recente alta de quase seis semanas, à medida que os operadores realizaram lucros, com a expectativa de que os estoques dos países consumidores continuem a crescer à medida que as exportações do Brasil, principal produtor, ganham ritmo.
CAFÉ * Os futuros de café arábica fecharam em queda de 3,7 centavos, ou 1,2%, a US$3,1245 por libra-peso, após atingirem US$3,1820 na quarta-feira, sua maior cotação desde 9 de setembro.
* "As exportações brasileiras estão fortes e as colheitas do Hemisfério Norte se aproximam, mas uma reposição significativa dos estoques provavelmente ainda levará vários meses", observou o corretor e consultor independente Michael J. Nugent.
* Os estoques de café verde no Japão e na Europa, dois dos maiores mercados para a bebida, diminuíram em agosto em relação ao ano passado, de acordo com dados de entidades do setor.
* Em outros lugares, o mercado está acompanhando de perto a eleição presidencial no Brasil neste domingo.
* Uma vitória de Flávio Bolsonaro é vista como um fator de alta para o real brasileiro . Isso também desestimula os exportadores brasileiros a venderem café cotado em dólares, reduzindo seus retornos em moeda local.
* O café robusta caiu 1,9%, para US$3.301 por tonelada métrica.
AÇÚCAR * O açúcar bruto fechou em queda de 0,32 centavo, ou 1,6%, a 20,13 centavos por libra-peso, afastando-se da máxima de 21,29 registrada na semana passada, a maior em 19 meses.
* Foi o quinto fechamento negativo consecutivo, já que alguns fundos que mantêm uma posição comprada quase recorde realizaram lucros, uma vez que o mercado não conseguiu manter a alta, segundo corretores.
* O açúcar vinha se beneficiando da alta nos preços da energia , o que incentiva as usinas a aumentar a produção do etanol, biocombustível derivado da cana, em detrimento do açúcar.
* Enquanto isso, espera-se que as chuvas excessivas associadas ao El Niño persistam no Brasil, principal produtor, prejudicando a colheita e reduzindo o teor de sacarose na cana. Há rumores de problemas relacionados às chuvas também na Argentina, prejudicando a moagem da cana no país, embora a Argentina não seja um grande produtor.
* O preço do açúcar branco caiu 1,8%, para US$533,90 a tonelada.
CACAU * O cacau em Londres fechou com queda de 173 libras, ou 3,9%, para 4.296 libras por tonelada, após ter fechado com alta de 0,5% na quarta-feira.
* O volume de moagem de cacau da Indonésia, um indicador da demanda, aumentou 2% no trimestre de julho a setembro em comparação com o trimestre anterior, informou um órgão do setor.
* O presidente de Gana, John Dramani Mahama, afirmou que o país tem como meta processar localmente pelo menos 50% de seus grãos de cacau, com apenas 50% da produção anual disponível para exportação.
* O cacau de Nova York caiu 4,5%, para US$5.582 por tonelada.
(Reportagem de May Angel e Marcelo Teixeira)

items.title: Actor Tom Skerritt, star of 'Alien' and 'Top Gun,' dies at 93
items.author: Will Dunham
items.creator: Will Dunham
items.summary: Versatile actor Tom Skerritt, who starred in Hollywood megahits including the sci-fi classic "Alien," the war comedy "M*A*S*H," and the action drama "Top Gun," has died at the age of 93, his manager confirmed.
items.body:
Versatile actor Tom Skerritt, who starred in Hollywood megahits including the sci-fi classic "Alien," the war comedy "M*A*S*H," and the action drama "Top Gun," has died at the age of 93, his manager confirmed.
Skerritt, a Detroit native whose Hollywood career spanned from the 1960s to the 2020s, died on Wednesday of natural causes, said ABC7, citing a statement from his family.
Known for his rugged good looks and ability to shine in a variety of genres, Skerritt delivered memorable performances in leading and supporting roles in film and television.
Skerritt's breakthrough role was a roguish US Army surgeon in director Robert Altman's 1970 Korean War black comedy "M*A*S*H," a film whose ensemble cast also included Donald Sutherland, Elliott Gould and Sally Kellerman. Skerritt played Southerner Duke Forrest as the doctors at the Mobile Army Surgical Hospital stitched up wounded troops.
The film, whose popularity coincided with American unease over the Vietnam War, was nominated for five Academy Awards.
In director Ridley Scott's claustrophobic 1979 sci-fi horror "Alien", Skerritt played Dallas, the captain of an ill-fated spacecraft whose crew encounters a deadly parasitic extraterrestrial creature with a surrealist look and a bad attitude. In the film's famous and bloody "chestburster" scene, Skerritt's character is seated next to cast mate John Hurt when a baby alien violently exits the torso of Hurt's character.
"Alien," an influential masterpiece whose ensemble cast also included Sigourney Weaver and Ian Holm, earned two Oscar nominations.
"It is spontaneity and impulse that make the difference, and that is what I felt we had with 'Alien.' Every one of us had that immediate rapport with each other - the respect that I had for the other actors and the respect that they had for me," Skerritt told interviewer Peter Sobczynski in 2019, while also lauding Scott's directorial brilliance.
"Alien" was one of several films in which Skerritt appeared that featured strong female characters, in this case Weaver's courageous character Ripley. That was considered pioneering at the time.
"When I read the script, one of the things that I liked most about it was that the woman becomes the hero. I loved that," Skerritt said.
"The sight of women being in positions of strength and fortitude to make the right connections and decisions was what appealed to me. I experienced that as well in 'Steel Magnolias,' with the women in that. I liked the idea of women being tough and strong and influential."
In "Steel Magnolias" (1989), Skerritt played Drum Eatenton, husband of Sally Field's M'Lynn Eatenton.
Tony Scott, the brother of the "Alien" director, cast Skerritt in the key supporting role of naval aviation instructor Viper Metcalf in the 1986 blockbuster "Top Gun" that helped star Tom Cruise soar into Hollywood's stratosphere.
Skerritt also played Shirley MacLaine's husband in director Herbert Ross's 1977 ballet drama "The Turning Point," and starred alongside another emerging star in Brad Pitt in Robert Redford's beautifully shot 1992 period drama "A River Runs Through It."
Among other films in which he appeared were: "Harold and Maude" (1971), "Ice Castles" (1978), "The Dead Zone" (1983), "Poltergeist III" (1988), "Contact" (1997), "Tears of the Sun" (2003) and "Ted" (2012).
On the small screen, Skerritt starred in the offbeat CBS series "Picket Fences" from 1992 to 1996, playing a Wisconsin town sheriff and claiming an Emmy as outstanding lead actor in a drama series in 1993.
Born on August 25, 1933, in Detroit, Skerritt served in the US Air Force before becoming an actor, making his film debut in 1962 alongside a young Redford in "War Hunt." He was a father of five children and was married three times.

items.title: Elon Musk invests about $1 billion in Skydance, CNBC reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Elon Musk has made a roughly $1 billion investment in Skydance , CNBC reported on Thursday, citing a person familiar with the matter.
items.body:
Elon Musk has made a roughly $1 billion investment in Skydance (SKYD.N) , CNBC reported on Thursday, citing a person familiar with the matter.
Representatives for Skydance and Musk did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment.
Here are more details:
Earlier this month, Paramount Skydance completed its $110 [USN:L4N45S0XK TEXT:"billion takeover"] of Warner Bros Discovery and the combined entity was named Skydance
"It's going to be a great company," US President Trump told reporters earlier this month, expressing his approval of the merger
SpaceX (SPCX.O) CEO Musk, who has been rebuilding his ties with Trump, has had a longstanding bond with Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison, whose son David Ellison leads Skydance
The investment comes as Ellison looks [USN:L4N45S0XK TEXT:"to position Skydance"] as a technology-driven media business and cut costs
Last month, Ellison named former Mattel (MAT.O) CEO Ynon Kreiz as Skydance's co-CEO
Musk's commitment is part of a wider effort by Skydance to raise equity investments, according to Semafor, which first reported the news
In 2022, Larry Ellison had committed $1 billion to fund Musk's purchase of Twitter, now X
"I'm very close friends with Elon Musk," senior Ellison had said in 2018
Larry Ellison had also [USN:L4N3XS0QO TEXT:"personally guaranteed"] over $40 billion equity financing when Paramount offered to buy Warner Bros

items.title: Trump signs order aimed at reducing single-family housing costs
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US President Donald Trump on Thursday signed an executive order aimed at reducing the costs of single-family home ownership and mortgages, the White House said in a statement.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump on Thursday signed an executive order aimed at reducing the costs of single-family home ownership and mortgages, the White House said in a statement.
The order instructs the Federal Housing Finance Agency to launch a pilot program that would proactively cancel borrowers' mortgage insurance premiums once they meet equity requirements based on current market value, and to make permanent an FHFA pilot waiving title insurance on refinancings.
It also creates a task force on manufactured housing innovation to expand factory-built housing eligible for federal programs, and directs the agriculture and veterans affairs secretaries to reduce interest rates on single-family home loans issued by their departments.

items.title: EU antitrust regulators to decide on Deutsche Boerse, Allfunds deal by November 27
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: EU antitrust regulators will decide by November 27 whether to approve Deutsche Boerse's €5.35 billion ($6 billion) acquisition of Amsterdam-listed fund trading platform Allfunds , a European Commission filing showed on Thursday.
items.body:
EU antitrust regulators will decide by November 27 whether to approve Deutsche Boerse's (DB1Gn.DE) €5.35 billion ($6 billion) acquisition of Amsterdam-listed fund trading platform Allfunds (ALLFG.AS) , a European Commission filing showed on Thursday.
Deutsche Boerse, which has said the deal is part of its goal of becoming a European champion in providing critical infrastructure for financial markets, put in a request for EU approval earlier on Thursday, according to the filing.
The Commission, which is the EU competition enforcer, can approve the deal with or without remedies after its preliminary review or it can open a four-month long investigation if it has serious concerns.
($1 = 0.8912 euros)

items.title: Petróleo fecha em máxima de 5 meses com temor sobre oferta no Oriente Médio
items.author: Scott Disavino
items.creator: Scott Disavino
items.summary: Os preços do petróleo fechou com alta de 4% nesta quinta-feira, atingindo a máxima em cinco meses, depois que ataques dos houthis na Arábia Saudita alimentaram preocupações de novas interrupções no abastecimento de energia proveniente dessa importante região exportadora.
items.body:
Os preços do petróleo fechou com alta de 4% nesta quinta-feira, atingindo a máxima em cinco meses, depois que ataques dos houthis na Arábia Saudita alimentaram preocupações de novas interrupções no abastecimento de energia proveniente dessa importante região exportadora.
Os contratos futuros do Brent subiram US$4,35, ou 4%, fechando a US$113,17 o barril, enquanto o petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos subiu US$2,32, ou 2,4%, fechando a US$99,47.
Esse foi o maior fechamento do Brent desde 4 de maio e manteve o índice de referência global em território tecnicamente sobrecomprado pela terceira vez em uma semana.
“O mercado está se recuperando devido a mais uma forte injeção de prêmio de risco, relacionada a um novo ataque dos houthis à infraestrutura saudita, em meio a rumores de um ataque conjunto dos EUA e de Israel ao Irã após as eleições de meio de mandato”, afirmaram analistas da consultoria de energia Ritterbusch and Associates em uma nota.
A Saudi Aramco (2223.SE) instruiu seus funcionários a evacuarem sua sede em Dhahran, no Golfo Pérsico, perto do Barein, informou a Reuters, à medida que os combates entre o maior exportador mundial de petróleo e os houthis do Iêmen se intensificavam.
Os confrontos entre os houthis e uma coalizão liderada pela Arábia Saudita, que apoia o governo internacionalmente reconhecido do Iêmen, se intensificaram desde que o grupo alinhado ao Irã avançou em direção a Bab el-Mandeb, um ponto estratégico para a navegação na foz do Mar Vermelho.
“Os relatos de que as exportações de petróleo do Oriente Médio estão superando os níveis anteriores ao conflito são mais do que compensados pelos ataques a navios no Estreito de Ormuz e pelos ataques dos houthis à Arábia Saudita e à sua infraestrutura petrolífera”, afirmou Tamas Varga, analista da PVM Oil.
Analistas do Morgan Stanley estimaram que as exportações de petróleo do Oriente Médio ficaram em torno de 17 milhões de barris por dia na semana passada. As exportações de petróleo da região tiveram média de cerca de 18 milhões de bpd nos 12 meses anteriores ao início da guerra com o Irã, de acordo com a Kpler.
Nos EUA, a refinaria Valero Energy (VLO.N) deu início à temporada de resultados das refinarias americanas nesta quinta-feira ao divulgar seu maior lucro trimestral de todos os tempos, superando as expectativas de Wall Street, já que as interrupções no abastecimento de combustível decorrentes das guerras no Irã e na Ucrânia impulsionaram as margens durante o terceiro trimestre.

items.title: Vacuna de Merck/Moderna reduce más de 40% el riesgo de muerte o recurrencia de melanoma
items.author: Julie Steenhuysen, Michael Erman
items.creator: Julie Steenhuysen, Michael Erman
items.summary: Moderna y Merck anunciaron el jueves que la vacuna contra el cáncer basada en ARNm que han desarrollado, combinada con una inmunoterapia de uso generalizado, redujo el riesgo de muerte o recurrencia del melanoma un 42% y la propagación de la enfermedad en un 38% en un ensayo a gran escala.
items.body:
Moderna (MRNA.O) y Merck (MRK.N) anunciaron el jueves que la vacuna contra el cáncer basada en ARNm que han desarrollado, combinada con una inmunoterapia de uso generalizado, redujo el riesgo de muerte o recurrencia del melanoma un 42% y la propagación de la enfermedad en un 38% en un ensayo a gran escala.
Los datos del ensayo de fase III, en el que participaron más de 1.100 pacientes, podrían allanar el camino hacia una nueva era de tratamientos personalizados. Moderna y Merck anunciaron en agosto que el tratamiento había tenido éxito, pero no facilitaron detalles de las pruebas.
Es el primer estudio que demuestra que la combinación de una vacuna basada en mutaciones específicas del tumor de cada paciente, junto con un fármaco que ayuda al sistema inmune a combatir el cáncer, puede mantener la enfermedad a raya. La vacuna se probó junto con Keytruda, la exitosa inmunoterapia de Merck, que se encuentra entre los medicamentos más vendidos del mundo.
Las acciones de Moderna, que se habían disparado desde el anuncio del ensayo en agosto —casi cuadruplicándose hasta el cierre del miércoles—, cayeron más de un 20% después de que los resultados se filtraran en una página web de oncología a primera hora del jueves. Las acciones de Merck bajaron alrededor de un 0,7%.
Está previsto que los resultados, basados en los datos de los pacientes correspondientes a los dos primeros años tras el tratamiento, se presenten el sábado en el congreso de la Sociedad Europea de Oncología Médica que se celebra en Madrid.
"Esto es muy significativo desde el punto de vista estadístico. No es una casualidad", dijo el doctor Hussein Tawbi, experto en melanoma e investigador del ensayo en el Centro Oncológico MD Anderson de la Universidad de Texas, al referirse a los resultados.
En el ensayo se evaluaron nueve dosis de la vacuna, conocida como intismeran, junto con Keytruda, a partir de las 13 semanas posteriores a la cirugía para extirpar las lesiones de melanoma. Su respuesta se comparó con la de los pacientes tratados únicamente con Keytruda, una terapia estándar para el melanoma.
Entre los que recibieron la vacuna además de Keytruda, el 82,2% seguía sin cáncer al cabo de dos años, en comparación con el 70% de los pacientes que recibieron únicamente Keytruda.

items.summary: A planned Pittsburgh Steelers fan event scheduled for Sunday in Paris has been canceled amid civil unrest in the French capital.
items.body:
A planned Pittsburgh Steelers fan event scheduled for Sunday in Paris has been canceled amid civil unrest in the French capital.
The Steelers and New Orleans Saints are scheduled to play the NFL's first regular-season game in Paris on Sunday at Stade de France. Commissioner Roger Goodell said Wednesday that he was confident in the security plan for the game.
"We've made all the preparations," Goodell said. "Protests are not unusual in France, as you know, and that's something that we will be aware of and make sure that the appropriate arrangements are made."
However, the league and the Steelers opted to cancel the Steelers House fan event. The organizations announced the decision Thursday in a joint statement.
"Following recent events in the Bastille neighborhood, and after careful consideration, we felt it appropriate not to move forward with the planned Steelers House fan event in Paris," a message posted to X read.
Protests in France began Sept. 17, with demonstrators marching peacefully to protest poor conditions in schools. People angered by the rising cost of living later joined the demonstrations.
Last weekend, some protests turned violent as rioters set fire to a historic city hall and cars, and looted high-end boutiques. In the Bastille neighborhood, stores were broken into and fires were set.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Geadas tardias causam perdas de até 15% em algumas áreas de trigo na Argentina, diz bolsa
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: As geadas tardias registradas nas últimas semanas causaram perdas entre 10% e 15% da safra de trigo 2026/27 em algumas regiões da Argentina, informou nesta quinta-feira a Bolsa de Cereais de Buenos Aires (BdeC), que, por enquanto, manteve estável sua estimativa de produção do cereal em 23,4 milhões de toneladas.
items.body:
As geadas tardias registradas nas últimas semanas causaram perdas entre 10% e 15% da safra de trigo 2026/27 em algumas regiões da Argentina, informou nesta quinta-feira a Bolsa de Cereais de Buenos Aires (BdeC), que, por enquanto, manteve estável sua estimativa de produção do cereal em 23,4 milhões de toneladas.
As baixas temperaturas recentes também foram acompanhadas por chuvas e dias com exposição solar limitada, o que também poderia afetar o rendimento das plantas, informou a bolsa. A Argentina é um importante exportador de trigo e o maior fornecedor ao Brasil.
"As condições do cultivo não refletem alterações consideráveis", afirmou a BdeC em seu relatório agrícola semanal.
No entanto, a bolsa destacou que, caso as condições adversas persistam, "elas poderiam comprometer o potencial de rendimento".
A colheita do trigo começa em novembro na Argentina. Na quarta-feira, a Bolsa de Comércio de Rosário elevou sua estimativa para a safra de trigo para 23,8 milhões de toneladas.
MILHO Com relação ao milho da safra 2026/27, a Bolsa de Buenos Aires informou que, no oeste e no sul da região agrícola da Argentina, as baixas temperaturas e as condições úmidas estão atrasando o plantio, cuja implantação está concluída em 39,8% da área prevista.
Para a BdeC, a Argentina -- terceiro maior exportador mundial do cereal -- terá uma safra de 66 milhões de toneladas.
(Reportagem de Maximilian Heath)

items.title: Ações da Meta despencam com preocupação sobre investimentos em IA
items.author: Prathik Jayaprakash, Aditya Soni
items.creator: Prathik Jayaprakash, Aditya Soni
items.summary: As ações da Meta desabavam mais de 8% nesta quinta-feira, à medida que os investidores reagiam negativamente a mais um aumento na previsão de investimento anual em inteligência artificial e a um plano de emissão de novas ações para ajudar a financiar esses gastos.
items.body:
As ações da Meta (META.O) desabavam mais de 8% nesta quinta-feira, à medida que os investidores reagiam negativamente a mais um aumento na previsão de investimento anual em inteligência artificial e a um plano de emissão de novas ações para ajudar a financiar esses gastos.
O custo do seguro contra inadimplência da dívida da gigante das redes sociais também atingiu um recorde histórico, o mais recente sinal de que os temores sobre o custo da corrida pela IA estão se espalhando para os mercados de crédito.
A onda de vendas ocorre apesar de resultados trimestrais melhores do que o esperado e de uma previsão de desempenho sólida, destacando o crescente mal-estar dos investidores em relação aos investimentos em IA, que estão levando empresas de tecnologia a se endividarem. Esses gastos também levaram a dona do Instagram, do Facebook e do WhatsApp à primeira queima de caixa em mais de uma década.
Os investidores já estavam nervosos neste mês com o aumento da dívida relacionada à IA, vendendo em massa ações de empresas de computação em nuvem, como CoreWeave (CRWV.O) e Nebius, que estão investindo várias vezes mais do que sua receita em data centers para atenderem a uma crescente carteira de clientes.
Especialistas afirmam que essa onda de endividamento deixa as empresas de IA vulneráveis a qualquer queda brusca na demanda, ao mesmo tempo em que as sobrecarrega com chips que se desvalorizam em cinco ou seis anos, forçando uma nova rodada de investimentos para se manterem competitivas.
Na quarta-feira, a Meta aumentou o limite inferior de sua faixa de previsão de investimento em US$5 bilhões, para entre US$135 bilhões e US$145 bilhões.
Esses gastos serão direcionados ao plano abrangente da Meta de colocar o agente de IA “Muse” no centro da estratégia da Meta.
Para ajudar a financiar essa iniciativa, a Meta criará uma nova classe de ações sem direito a voto, chamada Classe C. A empresa afirmou que pode levantar centenas de bilhões de dólares ao longo de vários anos para financiar investimentos em IA, aquisições e remuneração de funcionários, com as emissões de ações começando já este ano.
O documento também destacou que as emissões ajudaram a evitar o financiamento por meio de dívida, o que poderia afetar negativamente as classificações de crédito da Meta.
Na quinta-feira, os swaps de inadimplência de crédito (CDS) de cinco anos da Meta eram negociados em níveis recordes de 114,79 pontos-base.
No entanto, Shay Boloor, estrategista-chefe de mercado da Futurum Equities, afirmou que a decisão não é necessariamente um sinal de deterioração dos fundamentos da empresa.
O aumento nos spreads dos CDS “pode ter mais a ver com os bancos se protegendo contra a exposição ao enorme financiamento da dívida da Meta para IA do que com o risco real de inadimplência”, disse ele.
Até o fechamento da quarta-feira, as ações da Meta acumularam alta de mais de 5% neste ano. Se a queda no valor dos papeis nesta quinta-feira se mantiver, a Meta deve perder cerca de US$114 bilhões em valor de mercado.

items.title: Patriots face Bears with makeshift O-line on short week
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Drake Maye will be operating behind a makeshift offensive line when the New England Patriots visit the Chicago Bears on Thursday night.
items.body:
Drake Maye will be operating behind a makeshift offensive line when the New England Patriots visit the Chicago Bears on Thursday night.
Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel confirmed that starting guards Ben Brown and Alijah Vera-Tucker have been ruled out against Chicago (4-2) after being injured during last Sunday's 26-19 victory over the New York Jets. Brown left the game with a knee injury and Vera-Tucker exited the contest with a hamstring injury.
They will be replaced by Matt Pryor and Walter Rouse. Pryor, 31, has started 40 of the 111 games he has played in during his NFL career, including 15 of 17 games with the Bears in 2024. Rouse, 25, will make his first career NFL start Thursday.
The Patriots (4-2) have won their past three games, but will be facing a Bears defense that has 17 sacks, including a season-high five in the team's 31-23 win at Atlanta last week.
New England will also be without wide receiver Romeo Doubs, who was placed on injured reserve Monday after he sustained a shoulder injury while catching a 42-yard touchdown pass against the Jets. He has 14 receptions for 261 yards and three scores this season.
"It's been a next-man-up mentality," Maye said. "That's a Coach Vrabel-coached team. He always says it and we believe it. We gotta have identity throughout. It's not just the top guys. It's the guys in practice in the huddle."
It's been a Jekyll-and-Hyde season for Maye, who had one touchdown pass and was intercepted six times in his first three games. He has 10 touchdown passes and one interception in the three games since.
"Drake Maye is one of those guys who does an outstanding job with his feet," said Bears defensive coordinator Dennis Allen. "There's been times when you watch it, there's been pressure on the quarterback and he makes people miss and he creates run plays down the field, so I see him doing a lot of good things. I see especially his athleticism showing up. His ability to throw the ball down the field has been exceptional."
One of Chicago's two losses came when the Bears were without starting quarterback Caleb Williams because of a hamstring injury. Williams returned against Atlanta and completed 30 of 36 passes for 305 yards and a touchdown in a 31-23 victory. It was the first time Williams played since he left the fourth quarter of a 9-3 loss to Minnesota on Sept. 20.
The Bears enter this game averaging an NFL-best 160.7 rushing yards per game. Only Buffalo (14) has more rushing scores than Chicago's 13. D'Andre Swift has run for a team-high 398 yards and six touchdowns on 94 carries.
"They have really good talent," Vrabel said. "The O-line is excellent. They're well-coached. It's a good scheme. I think that the backs run hard and the receivers ... when you can run the football, the receivers have to be a big factor in that, and they are.
"(Stopping the run) will be our emphasis, but obviously there's a lot more that they do than run the football."
Patriots backup cornerbacks Karon Prunty (hamstring) and Channing Canada (hamstring) also were ruled out. Right tackle Morgan Moses (foot), linebacker Christian Elliss (chest) and safeties Kevin Byard III (chest) and Craig Woodson (shoulder) were listed as questionable.
For the Bears, running back Kyle Monangai (thumb, toe) has been ruled out for a third straight game.
Linebacker Jack Sanborn (concussion) also was ruled out, fellow linebacker T.J. Edwards (hamstring) is doubtful, and defensive back Tyrique Stevenson (hip) is questionable after participating fully in practice Wednesday.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Juventus fight back to draw with Rennes as Leverkusen go top
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Juventus dropped their first points of the Europa League campaign after coming from behind to draw 2-2 with visitors Rennes on Thursday.
items.body:
Juventus dropped their first points of the Europa League campaign after coming from behind to draw 2-2 with visitors Rennes on Thursday.
Zeki Celik gave Juventus a fifth-minute lead, but the French side kept their composure and were level 10 minutes later when Jordan international Musa Al-Taamari finished from close range for his first goal in the competition.
Rennes then stunned the hosts with a Boulaye Dia penalty two minutes before the break as the Italians struggled to create chances until Nick Woltemade equalised from the spot in the 67th minute.
The German forward twice went close to scoring again as Luciano Spalletti's team upped the pressure, and Juve thought they had won it in the 88th minute when Jhon Lucumi found the net from close range, but his effort was ruled out for offside.
The draw at least spared Juventus a second successive defeat following Sunday's 3-0 home [USN:L6N46407C TEXT:"loss"] to Lazio in Serie A.
Jonas Hofmann made the most of his surprise start for Bayer Leverkusen, scoring twice in three minutes to give the Bundesliga side a 2-0 victory at OFI Crete to go top of the table with their third straight win.
OFI, who stunned Hoffenheim 2-0 in their opening league-phase match, were twice caught napping by Hofmann, who was added to the side following an injury to Martin Terrier.
Leverkusen have nine points and lead Ferencvaros on goal difference after the Hungarian side beat Torreense 4-1.
Sunderland, who were also chasing a third win, took a second-minute lead against Lech Poznan through Timur Tutierov but Leo Bengtsson grabbed a 70th-minute equaliser to earn the Polish side a 1-1 draw. Sunderland have seven points, level with fourth-placed Juventus.

反落して取引を終えた。銀行株の売り注文が目立った。原油高やフランス国債利回りの上昇も相場の重荷となった。

ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は４．１７％安。四半期決算を発表したスペインの銀行バンキンターは７．６％下落。英銀大手バークレイズは２．３％安。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州高級品株１０種指数は０．９１％安。足元の売上高が市場予想に届かずフランスの高級ブランド大手エルメスは４．９％下落した。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は２．０４％安。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への懸念が再燃し、欧州の半導体大手ＳＴマイクロエレクトロニクスは４．９％、オランダの半導体製造装置メーカーＡＳＭＬホールディングは５．０％、ドイツの半導体大手インフィニオン・テクノロジーズは６．０％いずれも下落した。

一方、食品・飲料株指数は１．９２％高。売上高の伸び率が市場予想を上回ったスイスの食品大手ネスレは１．１％上昇した。ヘルスケア株指数は２．０７％上昇。堅調な業績予想を示したベルギーのバイオ医薬品グループ、ユーシービーは２１．６％高だった。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

独仏１０年債利回り格差が１５年ぶりの高水準に拡大した。フランスの厳しい財政状況と抗議デモ継続への懸念が投資家心理を圧迫した。

フランスの指標１０年債利回りは終盤、６．５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の５．０６％。一時は５．１４１５％と、２００２年７月以来の高水準を付けた。

安全資産とされるドイツ国債との利回り格差は１７７．７ｂｐと、ユーロ圏債務危機下の２０１１年１１月以来の水準に拡大。フランスの財政見通しに対する投資家の不安を浮き彫りにした。

ユーロ圏の指標となる独１０年債利回りは７ｂｐ低下の３．３４％。原油価格が上昇する中でも、安全資産需要が独国債を支えた。

独国債に対する利回り格差はユーロ圏全体で拡大した。ベルギーは１０ｂｐ拡大の１１０ｂｐと、２０１２年以来の高水準となった。イタリアは１０．５ｂｐ拡大の１２３ｂｐ、スペインは６ｂｐ拡大の７０ｂｐ、ギリシャは８．５ｂｐ拡大の１０６ｂｐだった。

金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りは６ｂｐ低下し、３．０２％となった。

短期金融市場が終盤に織り込む２７年末のＥＣＢ中銀預金金利は３．１５％。０．２５％ポイントの利上げを２回実施し、３回目を実施する確率が８０％であることを示している。

items.title: Affirm CEO Levchin Sees Strong Demand Ahead of Sam’s Club Partnership
items.summary: Max Levchin, founder and CEO of Affirm Holdings, says the company is seeing no slowdown in demand from consumers or retailers, despite concerns about squeezed household budgets and a challenging consumer-spending outlook. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: トランプ氏、マスク氏にウクライナ向けスターリンク制限解除要請＝報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [キーウ　２２日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[キーウ　２２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は米宇宙開発企業スペースＸを率いるイーロン・マスク氏に電話し、ウクライナに対する衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の利用制限を解除するよう求めた。米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）が２２日、米当局者の話として報じた。

ＷＳＪによると、トランプ氏はマスク氏に対し、ウクライナ向けのスターリンクの通信速度が時速１６０キロ程度に制限された状態が続いていることに不満を示した。同紙は米国とウクライナの当局者の話として、トランプ氏とマスク氏の協議後まもなく、スターリンクは通常に近い状態で利用できるようになったと伝えている。一部のウクライナ当局者はＷＳＪに対し、完全には復旧していないものの、速度制限下にあった時期より高速で利用できるようになったと語った。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領はこれに先立ち、スターリンクの通信速度は回復していないと述べ、この問題について向こう数日以内にルビオ米国務長官と協議できることを期待していると語っていた。

items.title: プーチン氏、ウクライナ東部「歴史的にロシアの土地」　安保確約必要
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［モスクワ　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［モスクワ　２２日　ロイター］ - ロシアのプーチン大統領は２２日、ロシアが一方的に併合したと主張するウクライナ東部の地域について、「歴史的にロシアの土地だ」と述べ、和平協議に向けたロシアの立場を改めて強調した。

プーチン氏はまた、ロシア、米国、ウクライナによる３者協議が実施される場合、ロシアとウクライナ双方に対する安全保障の確約を協議の中心に据えるべきだと主張。欧州全体の安全保障問題についても議論する必要があると述べた。

また、ロシアは欧州との戦争を準備していないとの立場を改めて示した。

プーチン氏は２１日、米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使と会談後、ウクライナ和平に向けた米国仲介の協議を来月にも再開することで合意。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領も同日、ロシア、米国、ウクライナの実務レベル協議を早期に開催するとの米国の提案を支持すると表明した。

items.title: US farm secretary says USDA reorganization blocked by judge is 'full bore ahead'
items.author: Leah Douglas
items.creator: Leah Douglas
items.summary: US Secretary of Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins said on Thursday that the Department of Agriculture is "full bore ahead" on an agency reorganization that was blocked by a federal judge last week.
items.body:
US Secretary of Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins said on Thursday that the Department of Agriculture is "full bore ahead" on an agency reorganization that was blocked by a federal judge [USN:L6N46015C TEXT:"last week"].
The USDA has [USN:L6N41613W TEXT:"planned "]to relocate thousands of employees outside of the Washington region and consolidate other regional offices as part of the President Donald Trump administration's overhaul of the federal branch.
A federal judge October 13 [USN:L6N46015C TEXT:"blocked "]the effort at several USDA agencies, ruling that the agency was "reprogramming" congressional funds for the reorganization, or using money for a different purpose than it was intended.
"We are full bore ahead in the reorganization," Rollins said on a call with reporters. "We believe in it more today than we ever have."
The USDA did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

items.title: Heladas tardías causan pérdidas de hasta 15% en áreas de trigo de Argentina
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Las heladas tardías registradas en las últimas semanas causaron pérdidas de entre 10% y 15% del trigo 2026/27 en algunas zonas de Argentina, dijo el jueves la Bolsa de Cereales de Buenos Aires (BdeC), que por el momento mantuvo estable su estimación de cosecha del cereal en 23,4 millones de toneladas.
items.body:
Las heladas tardías registradas en las últimas semanas causaron pérdidas de entre 10% y 15% del trigo 2026/27 en algunas zonas de Argentina, dijo el jueves la Bolsa de Cereales de Buenos Aires (BdeC), que por el momento mantuvo estable su estimación de cosecha del cereal en 23,4 millones de toneladas.
Las bajas temperaturas recientes han estado acompañadas también de precipitaciones y jornadas con limitada exposición solar, lo que también podría impactar en los rendimientos de las plantas, dijo la Bolsa. Argentina es un importante exportador internacional de trigo.
"La condición de cultivo no refleja modificaciones considerables", dijo la BdeC en su reporte agrícola semanal. Pero la entidad destacó que, de continuar las condiciones negativas, "podrían comprometer el potencial de rendimiento".
La cosecha del trigo comienza en noviembre en Argentina. El miércoles, la Bolsa de Comercio de Rosario [USN:L1N4671BZ TEXT:"subió su estimación"] de cosecha de trigo a 23,8 millones de toneladas.
MAÍZ Con respecto al maíz 2026/27, la Bolsa de Buenos Aires dijo que en el oeste y el sur de la zona agrícola de Argentina las bajas temperaturas y las condiciones húmedas están demorando la siembra, cuya implantación está completa en un 39,8% del área prevista.
Para la BdeC, Argentina -el tercer exportador mundial del cereal- tendrá una cosecha de 66 millones de toneladas.

items.summary: A US appeals court on Thursday upheld Apple and director M. Night Shyamalan's jury win in a dispute with filmmaker Francesca Gregorini over allegations that their Apple TV+ show "Servant" ripped off her movie "The Truth About Emanuel."
items.body:
A US appeals court on Thursday upheld Apple (AAPL.O) and director M. Night Shyamalan's jury win in a dispute with filmmaker Francesca Gregorini over allegations that their Apple TV+ show "Servant" ripped off her movie "The Truth About Emanuel."
The 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals rejected Gregorini's challenges to a California jury's verdict that had said Apple and Shyamalan's "Servant" could not have copied from her film
Gregorini's attorney and spokespeople for Apple did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the decision
Gregorini [USN:KBN1ZE2W1 TEXT:"sued Apple and Shyamalan"] for copyright infringement in 2020, arguing that "Servant," which ran from 2018 to 2023, was a "brazen copy" of "The Truth About Emanuel"
"Servant" and "The Truth About Emanuel" are both about a mother grieving the death of her baby who forms an attachment to a realistic doll
A jury [USN:L6N3O60HV TEXT:"determined"] last year that the makers of "Servant" lacked access to Gregorini's film before making their show
The 9th Circuit had [USN:L1N2UY1F8 TEXT:"revived"] the case in 2022 after finding that a federal judge dismissed it prematurely
The case is Gregorini v. Apple Inc, 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals, No. 25-3225.
For Gregorini: Patrick Arenz of Robins Kaplan
For Apple: Nicolas Jampol of Davis Wright Tremaine
Read more:
[USN:KBN1ZE2W1 TEXT:"Director says in lawsuit Apple, Shyamalan stole her movie"]
[USN:L1N2UY1F8 TEXT:"Apple and M. Night Shyamalan must face director's lawsuit in latest court twist"]
[USN:L6N3O60HV TEXT:"Apple, M. Night Shyamalan win copyright trial over 'Servant' TV show"]

items.title: IPO da Anthropic concentra interesse de investidores no mercado de IA
items.author: Echo Wang
items.creator: Echo Wang
items.summary: O calendário de ofertas públicas iniciais de ações (IPO) do setor de tecnologia, que antes era bastante robusto, agora se resume apenas à Anthropic.
items.body:
O calendário de ofertas públicas iniciais de ações (IPO) do setor de tecnologia, que antes era bastante robusto, agora se resume apenas à Anthropic.
A companhia de inteligência artificial está seguindo em frente para realizar seu IPO em meados de novembro, após prever a divulgação do prospecto da operação no final deste mês, segundo fontes a par do assunto, que alertam que o plano e as datas estão sujeitos a alterações.
O IPO da Anthropic testará se sua posição no centro do próspero setor de IA, que alguns investidores acreditam ser digna de uma avaliação potencial de US$1,5 trilhão, será capaz de superar um ambiente de mercado que normalmente levaria banqueiros e advogados especializados em transações a aconselhar um adiamento. O mercado espera que a Anthropic comece a negociar suas ações para investidores em potencial durante a semana de 9 de novembro, disse uma das fontes.
Outras empresas dos setores de infraestrutura de inteligência artificial e centrais de processamento de dados adiaram suas aberturas de capital, enfrentando um aumento nas taxas de juros que ajudou a alimentar uma onda de vendas maciças de ações e títulos de dívida de operadores de IA, como a CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , além de questionamentos mais amplos sobre a sustentabilidade dos gastos com a tecnologia.
Esse contraste ressalta o apelo da Anthropic aos investidores, mesmo com as preocupações sobre a concorrência de modelos de código aberto e a segurança da IA pesando sobre o setor.
A Anthropic se recusou a comentar.
AVALIAÇÕES SOB PRESSÃO A retração do setor de IA segue uma série de adiamentos e cancelamentos de IPOs desde setembro, à medida que a volatilidade do mercado e o aumento das taxas de juros tornaram mais difícil para as empresas garantirem preços atraentes.
A Switch, operadora de data centers, e a Nscale, provedora de infraestrutura de IA, adiaram seus planos de IPO para o final deste ano, disseram fontes a par do assunto, embora tenham enfatizado que os planos permanecem em aberto e sujeitos a alterações. A SB Energy, apoiada pela SoftBank, também adiou sua abertura de capital, conforme noticiado anteriormente pela Reuters.
A NScale se recusou a comentar. A Switch não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário.
A Elice, startup sul-coreana de chips de IA, foi uma das últimas a arquivar seus planos de abertura de capital da noite para o dia. A AirTrunk REIT, apoiada pela Blackstone, e a Firmus, apoiada pela Nvidia (NVDA.O) , também retiraram ou suspenderam suas ofertas, segundo reportagem da Reuters.
O recente IPO da Oura aumentou a cautela entre os emissores em potencial. A oferta atraiu pouca participação de investidores que operam apenas com posições compradas, disse uma fonte a par do assunto, levantando preocupações sobre o tamanho da demanda por parte de investidores institucionais, que normalmente fornecem uma base estável de acionistas para empresas recém-listadas.

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝円が大幅高、原油高やＡＩ収益懸念で安全資産買い
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、円が１日としては約１カ月ぶりの大幅上昇となる見通し。株式市場の不安定な動きや中東での戦争長期化に伴う原油高、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資の将来の収益性に対する疑念を背景に、投資家が安全資産を求めた。

円は対ドルで０．７５％上昇し、１ドル＝１５６．９６円となった。

円相場の動きの一部は、重要な節目である１ドル＝１６０円に近づいていたことも背景にある可能性がある。この水準に近づくほど、日本当局が円を下支えするため再び介入する可能性が高まると見られている。

ドルは、円と同様に伝統的な安全資産とされるスイスフランに対して０．４２％下落し、１ドル＝０．８２１フランとなった。

円やユーロなど主要通貨に対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．０８％低下し、１０１．６０。

ユーロは０．０９％下落し、１ユーロ＝１．１２２２ドルとなった。

ウェルズ・ファーゴのグローバル為替戦略責任者、エリック・ネルソン氏は「米国のＡＩ関連企業の信用力とフランスの国家としての信用力という、それぞれの弱点を巡る材料がせめぎ合っている。ここ数日は、どちらへの懸念が強いかによって相場が左右されている。フランスへの懸念が米国のＡＩ関連企業の信用力への懸念を上回る限り、ユーロは相対的に軟調に推移するだろう」と語った。

フランスが巨額の債務負担に対処できるかどうかへの懸念が同国の国債を圧迫し、債務水準が高い他のユーロ圏諸国への不安も高めている。

英ポンドは０．０５％上昇し、１ポンド＝１．３４０１ドル。豪ドルは０．１１％下落し、１豪ドル＝０．７０１９米ドルとなった。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは４．２７％下落し、８万１０２３ドルとなった。

items.title: Hot Picks: Three U.S. financial stocks with earnings growth potential
items.author: BNN Bloomberg
items.summary: Keith Buchanan shares his views on Travelers, Aflac and Wells Fargo and the earnings potential of U.S. financial stocks.
items.body: The U.S. financial sector offers a window into business activity and consumer finances. Trading, initial public offerings, advisory work and credit trends help reveal the economy’s health. BNN Bloomberg spoke with Keith Buchanan, senior portfolio manager at Globalt Investments, about his three financial stock selections and how he evaluates opportunities across banking and insurance. Key Takeaways Read the full transcript below: LINDSAY: It’s time now for Hot Picks, and our next guest has three financial companies on his radar. Let’s welcome in Keith Buchanan, senior portfolio manager at Globalt Investments. Great to have you join us once again. Thank you. KEITH: Thank you. LINDSAY: So, before we get into your actual picks, I always like to start with a broader look at the financial—at the sector. And this—today we’re talking about financials. What do you think is driving the financial sector right now? Is it one thing? Is it interest rates, earnings growth, the broader economy? Is it a number of things? KEITH: I choose all the above. I think the financials is a unique space that really gives a glimpse into the window of many facets for our economy. We’ve seen interest rate volatility, trading, some anxiety among investors, also the IPO movement, and also the advisory businesses all really come together to kind of give a glimpse of business America and how small and midsize business are performing, but also some of the consumer elements, too, with credit cards and that, you know, some of the credit issues that—that are starting to bubble up here at the larger banks. We get a full view of—of the broader economy, which is interesting in covering the group on a day-to-day basis. LINDSAY: Okay, so let’s get into your picks, then. The first one is Travelers. I know this—this company just also reported earnings. So tell us more about the opportunities you see—you see right now. KEITH: Sure, Travelers is a company that really just is executing in a very high clip, not only from a, you know, writing profitable business, but also investment portfolios kicking in extra earnings that kind of just put the ice meal on the cake. The insurance business right now is one that—that gets left behind in moments like we’ve seen over the last couple of years. But in moments like we are right now, where there are several risks that investors are becoming more and more concerned about, the market really looks at some of these names as a very stable provider of earnings, which we think earnings will be kind of the balance of whether this market holds up over the next 12 to 18 months or whether there’s a bear market that ensues. And names like this will be more attractive the more the latter becomes a fear of the broader market. So Travelers is a name that we really feel like offers a lot to our clients’ portfolios right now. LINDSAY: And it delivered a really strong third quarter. Like, what do you think was behind that performance? KEITH: Again, just growing a profitable business. They—they’ve been able to move in P&C and property and casualty in a way that most smaller corporations haven’t been able to. They’re broader geographically, so they have been able to diversify from a lot of just really concentrated risks, whether it’s weather-related or otherwise. So, being bigger has been better, and they’ve been able to really execute it on an underwriting standpoint. LINDSAY: Okay, Aflac, your next company for today, your next pick. Tell us more about this one. KEITH: Sure, Aflac is a little different from Travelers. It doesn’t have, like, the best-of-breed allure to it. It has a, you know, of course, a big part of its business is in Japan, so we have to understand how currency really affects from a couple of different standpoints. But they’ve been executing a really more of a self-help story within the insurance space, smaller and, of course, you know, a different facet of the business. But, you know, Aflac has been able to perform extremely well from a stock standpoint, and we’re really—again, it really—we really appreciate what it offers our strategy going forward. For specifically within the financial space, where it’s really hard to find these more stable earnings growers without concerns about the economy declines over the next couple of years. LINDSAY: Well, because Japan is one of Aflac’s biggest markets, right? Like, are they facing any pressure from the rising interest rates and a weaker yen? KEITH: Yes, they are, but in an interesting, kind of ironic way, the fear that kind of comes up from that actually drives, from a pricing standpoint, better pricing environment in Japan. So that—that’s kind of helped them in a—in a really ironic twist of fate. So we really, from aspect of what it offers their business lines, you know, exposure to Japan is something we actually become to enjoy in these—again, some of these moments where we have a little more fear permeating the marketplace. LINDSAY: Okay, your last pick for today is Wells Fargo. Tell us more about that. KEITH: Again, another self-help story, but more on the major bank side. Without the asset cap now, they really have opened the door, and execution is the way they kind of drive value through that door. You get it at a discount that, frankly, has been warranted over the last several years. We feel like it might be a way to really drive shareholder value going forward. The earnings picture is much more clear now, and we feel like Wells has a diversification among its businesses and its geographies in order to drive that value going forward and close that valuation gap between Wells Fargo and the rest of the major banks. We feel like it’s a self-help story that’s earnings-driven and really has upside from here. LINDSAY: I just want to go back to the general sector as well. Like, what’s the biggest risk—risk do you think financial stocks maybe face over the next even year or so? KEITH: Sure. The biggest risk is a flattening yield curve that is—brings along the economic strain that a more distressed economy, even a recession, is among the more likely options. That’s not really baked in right now, but with the banks having so much market cap, the insurers and those names believe are having a market cap to continue to drive the space higher. That is the scenario that we’re going to in the 20—later 2027, maybe even 2028. So economic decline is obviously the risk there, and also, you know, a more flattening yield curve makes that—that book of business or the big banks and traditional lending business much more difficult to become profitable. So those are the concerns we have with the space going forward. LINDSAY: Okay, we got to leave it there. Keith Buchanan, senior portfolio manager at Globalt Investments. Great to have you join us. Thank you. --- This BNN Bloomberg summary and transcript of the Oct. 22, 2026 interview with Keith Buchanan are published with the assistance of AI. items.title: Rooney labels Man United players 'selfish' after Fernandes criticism
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Manchester United's all-time leading scorer Wayne Rooney called the club's players "selfish" and said they were "like babies" after captain Bruno Fernandes questioned the coaching staff's tactics following Wednesday's 4-1 Champions League thrashing by Como.
items.body:
Manchester United's all-time leading scorer Wayne Rooney called the club's players "selfish" and said they were "like babies" after captain [USN:L6N4671CM TEXT:"Bruno Fernandes questioned"] the coaching staff's tactics following Wednesday's 4-1 Champions League [USN:L6N46717X TEXT:"thrashing by Como"].
Fernandes said United failed to apply enough pressure and adopted a "mood of defeat" after conceding in the second minute, as the heavy loss intensified scrutiny of manager Michael Carrick.
United's collapse at Como left them staring at another damaging defeat, with only a stoppage-time goal from Joshua Zirkzee reducing the margin of loss.
The criticism follows signs of growing frustration within the squad. Earlier this month, [USN:L8N4612C3 TEXT:"defender Lisandro Martinez criticised"] the club's hierarchy after a 2-0 Champions League defeat by Atletico Madrid, saying he expected greater investment to help the team compete at the highest level.
"When Martinez came out, I said this is an absolute nightmare because it will rip the dressing room apart," Rooney told the United Stand podcast on Thursday. "That was the start. We've seen it now with Bruno and you're going to see it with more players because they don't want to take responsibility.
"You can say whether Bruno was right or wrong in what he said but you have to take responsibility on the pitch. You have to take responsibility as a group of players.
"These players, they're selfish. They don't care about their teammates, don't care about the manager, the staff or the fans, they care about themselves.
"If they're not getting what's right for them, they're like babies and just throw. their toys out of the pram and go and deflect the blame on to anyone else but themselves."
Carrick, a former United midfielder who played alongside Rooney at Old Trafford, was appointed on an interim basis following [USN:L1N3Y607S TEXT:"Ruben Amorim's dismissal"] in January before [USN:L1N41Z0BH TEXT:"earning a contract through 2028"] after overseeing a dramatic improvement in results.
Carrick is under growing pressure with United winless in seven matches across all competitions. They are 20th in the Champions League standings and 13th in the Premier League.

items.title: Louisiana court buys AI servers to test how tech can streamline workload
items.author: Sara Merken
items.creator: Sara Merken
items.summary: A Louisiana state courthouse across the Mississippi River from New Orleans has a new addition: two AI servers to power new tools to support court staff and judges.
items.body:
A Louisiana state courthouse across the Mississippi River from New Orleans has a new addition: two AI servers to power new tools to support court staff and judges.
The servers and supporting equipment, installed about a month ago in Louisiana's Fifth Circuit Court of Appeal in Gretna, are part of the court's plan to create its own AI applications even as it continues to experiment with other commercially available options, Judge Scott Schlegel and Chief Judge Susan Chehardy wrote in a Substack post on Tuesday.
"Token prices, subscriptions, and the costs of operating AI will likely look quite different a few years from now," the judges wrote. "Rather than bet entirely on one approach, we decided to pursue both and learn from the experience."
The court bought two Dell servers with Nvidia chips that cost about $65,000 each at the time of purchase, Schlegel told Reuters. He said the court is not endorsing a particular product and other courts should evaluate their specific needs.
The Louisiana court appears to be the first state court to announce such a move, even as state and federal courts around the country have been putting in place rules and guidelines for how judges and court staff are permitted to use AI.
On the federal level, the clerk's office of the New Orleans-based 5th US Circuit Court of Appeals uses local servers to support case processing applications, which includes incorporating "limited AI" to increase efficiency and productivity, Thomas Plunkett, the clerk of the court, told Reuters.
Sixty percent of judges in a random-sample survey released in March said they are using at least one AI tool in their work, according to the [USN:L6N40I18R TEXT:"study"] by Northwestern University researchers.
The Louisiana state court is working with the nonprofit Institute for the Advancement of Legal and Ethical AI (ALEA Institute) to develop AI applications. Schlegel told Reuters the project began by interviewing court staff and clerks to see where the technology would be useful.
“Can it assist, should it assist, and in what sense should it assist? Augment, not replace,” he said.
The judges said early efforts will focus on the intake and compliance process when documents are submitted.
The court hopes to later build capabilities to help signal when filings include nonexistent cases and check documents for hidden instructions meant to manipulate AI systems, they wrote. Future applications could also help staff lawyers craft bench memoranda, which are documents meant to help prepare a judge.
Northwestern law professor Daniel Linna, who co-authored the study on judges' AI use, told Reuters this week that he wasn’t aware of many judges building AI tools. He and students at Northwestern built a prototype of a tool in collaboration with a judge to review Social Security disability benefits decisions, and are working with other judges on a case management project.
There is upside in "creating domain-specific tools that you can put some guardrails and other things in place to make sure you’re getting the kind of accuracy that you’d want to have for that work,” he said.

items.title: Camioneros del sur de Italia suavizan protestas tras aprobación de ayudas por parte del Gobierno
items.author: Francesca Piscioneri, Alvise Armellini
items.creator: Francesca Piscioneri, Alvise Armellini
items.summary: Las protestas de los camioneros, que han afectado gravemente al suministro de combustible y alimentos en el sur de Italia, se suavizaron el jueves, después de que el Gobierno de la primera ministra Giorgia Meloni aprobara ayudas y adoptara una postura más firme frente a los cortes de carretera.
items.body:
Las protestas de los camioneros, que han afectado gravemente al suministro de combustible y alimentos en el sur de Italia, se suavizaron el jueves, después de que el Gobierno de la primera ministra Giorgia Meloni aprobara ayudas y adoptara una postura más firme frente a los cortes de carretera.
Desde la semana pasada, los transportistas han estado bloqueando carreteras y autopistas para protestar contra los elevados precios del combustible y exigir ayudas para reducirlos, pero sus representantes afirmaron que los cortes de carretera se levantarían en Sicilia tras las conversaciones con el Gobierno.
Los camioneros de Calabria también suspendieron su protesta, mientras que Vincenzo Parisi, en nombre de los transportistas de la región de Campania, en los alrededores de Nápoles, declaró a la radio pública RAI que esperaba que los cortes de carretera pudieran levantarse en la zona a lo largo del jueves.
El Consejo de Ministros aprobó un decreto con más desgravaciones fiscales para los camioneros afectados por el aumento de los costos del combustible, añadiendo 106 millones de euros (118,66 millones de dólares) a los 434 millones ofrecidos antes y destinando 60 millones a los agricultores y 10 millones al sector pesquero.
"Quiero dar las gracias a las asociaciones que optaron por el diálogo y suspendieron los paros y las manifestaciones. Ha sido un acto de responsabilidad", declaró Meloni en las redes sociales.
Las protestas provocaron "graves trastornos" en Campania, lo que limitó el abastecimiento a supermercados, gasolineras y hospitales, declaró el viceministro de Infraestructuras, Edoardo Rixi, a la emisora de radio RAI.
Sin embargo, la oficina de Meloni tachó de "ridícula" una noticia de portada del periódico de la oposición Il Fatto Quotidiano según la cual la sede del Gobierno en Roma se estaba quedando sin papel higiénico debido a los bloqueos de los camioneros.
En Nápoles, la escasez de combustible dificultaba que los médicos llegaran a los hospitales o que las ambulancias respondieran a las emergencias, y también ponía en peligro la recogida municipal de residuos, según el alcalde Gaetano Manfredi.
(1 dólar = 0,8925 euros)

items.title: Hitachi Energy anuncia nova unidade produtiva no Brasil e eleva plano de aportes a US$350 mi
items.author: Leticia Augusto
items.creator: Leticia Augusto
items.summary: A Hitachi Energy vai construir uma nova unidade no Brasil dedicada à fabricação de componentes para transformadores de energia, um projeto que envolverá US$77 milhões em investimentos e visa ampliar a oferta desses produtos essenciais à infraestrutura elétrica, anunciou a companhia nesta quinta-feira.
items.body:
A Hitachi Energy vai construir uma nova unidade no Brasil dedicada à fabricação de componentes para transformadores de energia, um projeto que envolverá US$77 milhões em investimentos e visa ampliar a oferta desses produtos essenciais à infraestrutura elétrica, anunciou a companhia nesta quinta-feira.
Com a iniciativa, a subsidiária do grupo japonês Hitachi (6501.T) eleva para US$350 milhões seu plano atual de investimentos no Brasil, onde a empresa vai mais do que dobrar a capacidade produtiva em um momento de demanda mundial aquecida, disseram executivos à Reuters.
O investimento acompanha aportes globais de [USN:L1N3UQ0Z6 TEXT:"US$9 bilhões"] para ampliar a produção desses equipamentos em resposta à necessidade de ampliação e reforço da infraestrutura elétrica no mundo, dada a eletrificação das economias e aumento do consumo de energia para data centers e inteligência artificial.
A nova planta da Hitachi Energy para produzir componentes como buchas e comutadores ficará em Pindamonhangaba (SP), anexa à unidade que a companhia está construindo atualmente para fabricar transformadores de alta tensão.
Parte dos recursos também irá para expandir a produção de materiais de isolamento elétrico na unidade da companhia em Guarulhos (SP).
No Brasil, a companhia anunciou em 2024 a expansão de sua fábrica em Guarulhos e desde então vem ampliando o volume de aportes, com as novas unidades planejadas em Pindamonhangaba e um centro de serviços na região da Grande São Paulo.
"Quando falamos em investimento, não nos importamos de investir ainda mais, porque acreditamos que a visibilidade de longo prazo junto aos nossos clientes nos dá vantagem para entender onde precisamos investir mais", disse Bruno Melles, CEO Global da Unidade de Negócios de Transformadores da Hitachi Energy.
Os componentes fabricados no interior de São Paulo serão empregados na cadeia produtiva interna da Hitachi Energy, que opera de forma verticalizada, tanto no Brasil quanto no exterior.
"Brasil e Colômbia também são países exportadores (de produtos da Hitachi Energy), queremos garantir que vamos atender outros mercados, em especial a América do Norte e o Oriente Médio", afirmou Melles.
Ele acrescentou que os produtos também poderão ser vendidos a empresas concorrentes do setor que têm a Hitachi Energy como fornecedora.
Na visão da companhia, ampliar sua capacidade no Brasil reduz a exposição a interrupções globais e contribui para maior previsibilidade em custos, produção e prazos de entrega, ajudando a atender mais rapidamente clientes do mercado brasileiro e internacional.
A unidade de componentes deverá estar pronta no fim de 2028, cerca de um ano depois da nova fábrica de transformadores, prevista para novembro de 2027, segundo Alexandre Malveiro, vice-presidente sênior para América Latina da Unidade de Negócios de Transformadores da Hitachi Energy.
"Com esse investimento, estamos falando de cerca de 120 novos empregos diretos, que se somam aos 450 que já anunciamos para o outro projeto em Pindamonhangaba", destacou Malveiro.

items.title: Janela de importação de etanol pelo Brasil, que beneficia os EUA, deve ser reaberta
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A janela de importação de etanol do Brasil, utilizada principalmente por exportadores de combustível dos Estados Unidos, deve ser reaberta entre dezembro e janeiro, apesar de uma produção recorde esperada para o país em 2026/27, afirmaram a corretora StoneX e a consultoria Argus.
items.body:
A janela de importação de etanol do Brasil, utilizada principalmente por exportadores de combustível dos Estados Unidos, deve ser reaberta entre dezembro e janeiro, apesar de uma produção recorde esperada para o país em 2026/27, afirmaram a corretora StoneX e a consultoria Argus.
A corretora espera que a janela seja aberta para chegadas ao porto de Suape, prevendo que o primeiro trimestre de 2027 seja semelhante ao mesmo período de 2026, quando o etanol anidro chegou por Pernambuco.
"A nova previsão surpreende, em uma safra com expectativas de produção recorde de etanol", disse Maria Lígia Barros, responsável por precificação de etanol da Argus, à Reuters.
Segundo ela, a possibilidade de importação é ancorada pela visão de um balanço mais apertado de oferta e demanda até o fim da safra, devido a chuvas trazidas pelo El Niño, que prejudicaram a moagem de cana no centro-sul, além de benefícios governamentais concedidos ao etanol hidratado.
Interrupções sucessivas na moagem penalizam mais o anidro que o hidratado, pois sua produção exige etapas adicionais, explicou a Argus, citando ainda que o hidratado está desonerado do PIS/Cofins até 9 de novembro.
De acordo com a Argus, o Brasil pode importar entre 150 milhões e 200 milhões de litros de etanol entre outubro de 2026 e março de 2027.
Mas a maior parte dos desembarques deve ficar concentrada entre dezembro de 2026 e fevereiro de 2027. No mesmo período anterior, o Brasil importou 228,3 milhões de litros, segundo dados compilados pela Argus.
A janela de importação do Brasil se abre quando o custo de importação do etanol dos EUA -- incluindo frete, taxa de câmbio, a tarifa de 18% e custos portuários -- fica abaixo do preço do etanol anidro nacional no Nordeste do Brasil.
As importações tinham aumentado no Brasil no início do ano, levando a balança comercial do setor a um saldo negativo de janeiro a março, já que o etanol dos EUA chegou ao Nordeste a um preço mais baixo do que o etanol anidro nacional, apesar da tarifa de importação de 18%, lembrou a StoneX.
A balança comercial de etanol do Brasil voltou a ficar positiva a partir de abril, indicou a StoneX. As exportações brasileiras de etanol, no entanto, caíram 17% no acumulado do ano, para 1,03 bilhão de litros, pressionadas por uma queda de 34,1% na demanda por etanol industrial, enquanto os embarques de etanol combustível aumentaram 31,7%, pontuou a corretora.
A previsão pressupõe frete estável, aumento dos preços do etanol nacional e etanol norte-americano mais barato, o que reduziria a diferença de preço durante a entressafra da cana-de-açúcar brasileira, de dezembro a março.
(Reportagem de Marcelo Teixeira e Roberto Samora)

items.title: Trump asks Musk to lift Ukraine Starlink restrictions, WSJ reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US President Donald Trump called Elon Musk and asked him to lift restrictions on Ukraine's use of Starlink, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday, citing US officials.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump called Elon Musk and asked him to lift restrictions on Ukraine's use of Starlink, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday, citing US officials.
The Starlink system was working more normally on Thursday, shortly after the Trump-Musk conversation, according to US and Ukrainian officials cited by the Journal.
Some Ukrainian officials told the newspaper the system was not restored to full functionality but was working at higher speeds than under the cap.
President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said earlier on Thursday that Starlink speed had not been restored for Ukraine, adding that he hoped for talks with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in the coming days.
Trump told Musk he was frustrated the system's speeds remained capped at around 100 mph (160 kph), the Journal said, citing officials.
Rubio said on Wednesday that decisions regarding Ukraine's access to Starlink were up to its parent company SpaceX and its CEO Musk, not the White House.
Ukraine uses Starlink for battlefield communications and drone operations. Restricting the satellite service [USN:L8N4600M6 TEXT:"hampered "]the country's attack and air defense drone missions against Russia.

items.title: Seahawks activate RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP list
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Seattle Seahawks activated running back Zach Charbonnet from the physically unable to perform list on Thursday.
items.body:
The Seattle Seahawks activated running back Zach Charbonnet from the physically unable to perform list on Thursday.
To make room on the active roster, the team placed tight end Elijah Arroyo on injured reserve with a shoulder injury.
Head coach Mike Macdonald said earlier this week that Charbonnet is not guaranteed to play Sunday night when the Seahawks (3-3) host the Kansas City Chiefs (5-0).
"Zach is going to have a full week's worth of reps, so that's exciting, and there's a possibility that you could see him on Sunday in some capacity, so that's exciting," Macdonald said on Monday.
Charbonnet, 25, is nine months removed from tearing his ACL in the NFC divisional round win against San Francisco on Jan. 17. He returned to practice on Oct. 1 and Thursday marked the end of his 21-day practice window, meaning Seattle had to put him on the 53-man roster or shut him down for the season.
"It's remarkable," Macdonald said. "I know he's had a certain date in mind, which is a really ambitious date. Those who have tried to come back from a significant knee surgery understand the undertaking that it takes. Zach's a beast. He looks great. It's not easy to say, 'All right, let's go.' So for him to have that courage to say that and work through the things he's worked through, you can't do anything but tip your cap to him."
Charbonnet led the Seahawks in rushing touchdowns (12) and was second in rushing yards (730) last season. He has totaled 1,761 rushing yards and 21 TDs on the ground in 49 career games (eight starts) since the Seahawks drafted him in the second round in 2023.
ESPN reported that Arroyo underwent season-ending surgery on Thursday to repair the shoulder he injured in last Thursday's loss at Denver.
Arroyo, 23, has one catch for 17 yards in six games this season. He has 16 receptions for 196 yards and one TD in 19 games (four starts) since Seattle selected him in the second round in 2025.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Hitachi Energy to invest $77 million in new Brazil plant
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Hitachi Energy will build a new plant in Brazil to produce components for power transformers, the company said on Thursday, in a $77 million investment aimed at expanding supplies of equipment essential to power infrastructure.
items.body:
Hitachi Energy will build a new plant in Brazil to produce components for power transformers, the company said on Thursday, in a $77 million investment aimed at expanding supplies of equipment essential to power infrastructure.
The announcement brings the current investment plan of the energy unit of Japanese conglomerate Hitachi (6501.T) in Brazil to $350 million, the firm said in an interview, adding that it would more than double its production capacity in the segment.
The new plant will be located in Pindamonhangaba, Sao Paulo state, adjacent to a facility the company is building to manufacture high-voltage transformers
The unit will make components such as bushings and tap changers
The facility will supply the Brazilian market and other strategic export destinations, including North America and the Middle East
Part of the investment will also be used to expand the production of electrical insulation materials at the firm's facility in Guarulhos, Sao Paulo state

items.summary: The Ottawa Senators placed starting goaltender Linus Ullmark on injured reserve Thursday due to a lower-body injury.
items.body:
The Ottawa Senators placed starting goaltender Linus Ullmark on injured reserve Thursday due to a lower-body injury.
The injury occurred Wednesday night in the third period of Ottawa's 5-1 win over the Florida Panthers. Ullmark was replaced by backup Samuel Ersson.
Ersson is expected to take over as the Senators' primary goaltender. Ottawa recalled Jonas Johansson from Belleville of the American Hockey League. Johansson was acquired in a September trade with the Tampa Bay Lightning.
Ullmark, 33, is off to a strong start to the 2026-27 season, posting a 7-1-0 record with a .945 save percentage and a 1.33 goals-against average.
Before leaving Wednesday's game, he stopped 17 of 18 shots.
Ersson, 27, has appeared in four games, going 0-2 with a .831 save percentage and a 4.70 goals-against average.

items.title: Canadian agriculture’s $12 billion opportunity
items.author: Jordan Fleguel
items.summary: Canada’s agriculture industry has an opportunity to unlock billions of dollars in revenue from new markets and customers as it adjusts to a reimagined trading relationship with the U.S., says the head ...
items.body: Canada’s agriculture industry has an opportunity to unlock billions of dollars in revenue from new markets and customers as it adjusts to a reimagined trading relationship with the U.S., says the head of Farm Credit Canada (FCC). “We see an opportunity in terms of diversification of markets, and that opportunity has been quantified,” Justine Hendricks, president and CEO of FCC, told BNN Bloomberg on Thursday. “If you take a look over and above the north-south trade, which we know and recognize is important to this industry, there is a $12 billion opportunity that overall is there for us to go and get.” As a federal Crown corporation, FCC provides financing and advisory services to the agriculture industry, and reports to Canadians and Parliament through Canada’s Minister of Agriculture and Agri-Food. Hendricks noted that many Canadian agriculture products can still flow into the U.S. tariff free but given the current uncertain and sometimes hostile relationship between Ottawa and Washington, the sector should be looking to diversify its customer base. “So, there are some levers that the industry can lean on to also help navigate and frankly increase its diversification, which is an important tool as part of your risk mitigation,” she said. Her comments came amid ongoing trade tensions between Canada and the U.S., one of a number of factors creating uncertainty for Canadian farmers. Another is the cost of diesel fuel, which has reached historically high levels in recent months, shrinking Canadian farmers’ already-tight margins, as laid out in an FCC report released Wednesday. “It’s not just diesel prices, right, there’s what’s going on with the U.S., climate is also a key factor, (as is) the overall cost of input,” said Hendricks. “All of these elements have impact, and as a result of it, the environment that farmers and producers have to navigate has just become increasingly more complex.” Industry resilience Hendricks said the good news is that Canadian farmers, ranchers and producers are known for their agility and resilience in the face of uncertainty and change. “And we’ve got evidence to show – from the growth of the industry, to what it continues to provide as gross domestic product (GDP) to Canada – that it is continuing to thrive despite some of this complexity,” she said. Last year, Canada’s agriculture and agri-food industry generated $158 billion, or around seven per cent, of Canada’s total GDP, according to government figures. The sector employed approximately 2.3 million people in 2025, accounting for one in nine jobs across the country. In addition to diversifying its market access, Canadian agriculture should be focusing on increasing investment in innovation to drive growth going forward, Hendricks argued, noting that Canada lags behind many of its peers in that area. “That is one of the reasons why 18 months ago FCC stood up a capital division to respond directly to that gap,” she said, adding that since the division was launched, FCC has deployed over half a billion dollars towards funding innovation in Canadian food and agriculture. “We do feel that there is capital available, and certainly FCC has a role to play there, and that is why we’ve stood up and put our money where our mouth is so to speak to be able to play an active role and we’re starting to see some results.”

items.title: 銀行の自国国債保有制限案「時期尚早」、長期金利上昇が目下の問題＝伊中銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ローマ　２２日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行 （ＥＣＢ
items.body:
[ローマ　２２日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行 （ＥＣＢ ）理事会メンバーのパネッタ・イタリア中銀総裁は２２日、銀行による自国国債の保有を制限するという案は時期尚早であり、有益でないとの考えを示した。

銀行が多額の国債を保有すると金利上昇に対して脆弱になり、銀行と国家財政の「負の連鎖」を招く危険性は広く議論されており、一部のエコノミストは、銀行が自国の国債に対するエクスポージャーを制限することを提案している。

パネッタ氏はトリノで開催された経済フォーラムで、こうした提案は「やや時期尚早である」と指摘。２０１１─１２年のユーロ圏債務危機当時よりも銀行の財務体質は強化されており、資本準備金に対する国債保有比率もはるかに低いと述べた。

現在の問題は長期金利の上昇にあり、こうした状況下で長期国債の購入余地を制限することは賢明でないと述べた。さらに、監督当局は銀行が国債や金利リスクに過度にさらされていないかを既に監視していると説明。その上で「現時点でこの議論を行うことはあまり有意義ではないと思う」と述べた。
