items.title: Yes Bank unlikely to pay AT1 bond coupons despite bond holders demand, sources say
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: Yes Bank has announced potential non-payment of coupons on additional tier-1 bonds this fiscal year following a Supreme Court decision that annulled the previous write-off of these bonds. Bondholders are advocating for repayment based on the court's ruling, which emphasizes unsettled dues. Nonetheless, Yes Bank maintains it has ultimate authority over coupon payments, raising concerns about its financial losses impacting these obligations.
items.body: India's Yes Bank is unlikely to pay coupons due this year on its additional tier-1 (AT1) bonds despite a Supreme Court ruling overturning their write-off during the lender's 2020 rescue, two persons familiar with the matter said.The bank is preparing to seek a review of the ruling, one of the sources told Reuters, while bondholders press for payment of coupons that have remained unpaid since Yes Bank wrote the bonds off six years ago.Last week, India's Supreme Court upheld a 2023 Bombay High Court ruling that set aside Yes Bank's write-off of 84 billion rupees ($886 million) worth of AT1 bonds, in a setback to the lender and regulators that had defended the move.Yes Bank did not respond to an email seeking comment.The sources declined to be named as they were not authorised to speak on the matter.Retail investors holding the bonds said on Thursday they had not received coupon payments due on October 18, three days after the SC ruling.In a letter to Axis Trustee Services Ltd, reviewed by Reuters, investors sought clarity on the status of coupon payments and urged the debenture trustee to intervene. We call upon the Trustee to obtain immediate written confirmation from Yes Bank as to whether this coupon has been paid, cancelled or remains outstanding, bondholders said.They cited the Supreme Court order that payment of annual coupons shall remain unaffected by the outcome of these appeals and must be made in terms of the Information Memoranda. The sources, however, said the bond documentation gives the bank discretion over coupon payments and that the issue can only be considered once the AT1 bonds are reinstated on the bank's balance sheet.The losses the bank accumulated during fiscal years 2020 and 2021 are expected to be fully offset only by fiscal 2028, a third source familiar with the matter told Reuters. This could weigh on the bank's decision to pay coupons on its AT1 bonds, the source added.Yes Bank carries a debit balance of 52.79 billion rupees ($557 million) in its profit and loss account, according to the lender's latest annual report.

Nonetheless, Yes Bank maintains it has ultimate authority over coupon payments, raising concerns about its financial losses impacting these obligations.

items.title: US to host inaugural Women's Club World Cup in 2028
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The United States will host the inaugural edition of the Women's Club World Cup in January 2028, FIFA said on Thursday, with seven clubs confirmed so far for the 19-team tournament.
items.body:
The United States will host the inaugural edition of the Women's Club World Cup in January 2028, FIFA said on Thursday, with seven clubs confirmed so far for the 19-team tournament.
Arsenal Women, Club America Femenil, FC Barcelona Femeni, Gotham FC, Naegohyang Women’s FC, SC Corinthians and Wuhan Jiangda WFC have already qualified, with a dozen more yet to be determined.
The tournament will feature teams from all six confederations -- three clubs apiece from AFC, CAF, CONCACAF and CONMEBOL, one from OFC and six from UEFA. It will run from January 5 to 30.
"We undertook a detailed assessment to identify the most suitable host for the inaugural edition of the FIFA Women’s Club World Cup," FIFA Chief Women’s Football Officer Sarai Bareman said in a statement.
"Ultimately, the United States’ recent excellence in staging top FIFA tournaments, combined with the significant interest in women’s football there plus its elite sporting infrastructure, made the country the standout option."
FIFA has been eager to tap into the lucrative [USN:L6N43I00P TEXT:"American market"], and the US staged the men's Club World Cup in 2025 and co-hosted the FIFA World Cup earlier this year with Mexico and Canada.
The United States is expected to co-host the 2031 Women's World Cup with Costa Rica, Jamaica and Mexico, with formal FIFA approval due next month.

items.title: 中国チベットでＭ7の地震、人的・物的被害は不明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２２日 ロイター] - 中国地震ネットワークセンター（ＣＥＮＣ）によると、中国南西部のチベット自治区で２２日午後１０時３３分（１４３３ＧＭＴ、日本時間午後１１時３３分）ごろ、マグニチュード（Ｍ）７の地震が発生した。

人的被害や建物などの被害の有無は現時点では分かっていない。

ＣＥＮＣのデータによると、震央はチベット北部ナクチュの標高の高い地域に位置し、震源の深さは１０キロ。震央から半径５キロ以内の平均標高は約４８６４メートル。

ＣＥＮＣによると、中国で発生した地震としては２０２４年１月以来の規模。震央は自治区の中心都市ラサから約４００キロ離れている。

今回の震央から約２８０キロ離れた隣接する青海省玉樹では、２０１０年にＭ７．１の地震が発生し、少なくとも２６９８人が死亡、約３００人が行方不明となった。

items.title: Gucci sales slip again in latest blow to Kering recovery plan
items.author: Tassilo Hummel, Alessandro Parodi
items.creator: Tassilo Hummel, Alessandro Parodi
items.summary: Gucci sales fell in the third quarter as shoppers stayed away from its stores, its owner Kering said on Thursday, blowing hopes of a rapid return to growth for Luca de Meo, who took over as CEO last year.
items.body:
Gucci sales fell in the third quarter as shoppers stayed away from its stores, its owner Kering (PRTP.PA) said on Thursday, blowing hopes of a rapid return to growth for Luca de Meo, who took over as CEO last year.
The former automotive industry veteran is trying to turn Kering around with a five-year plan to double its profit margin, but the Iran war, weak demand in China and slowing momentum in the [USN:L8N45R16S TEXT:"United States"] are frustrating that ambition.
Lower-than-expected quarterly sales at [USN:L6N45Y0VL TEXT:"LVMH"] (LVMH.PA) and [USN:L6N4680E3 TEXT:"Hermes"] (HRMS.PA) have added to investor concerns over Kering and asked on media call if returning to overall growth was still the aim this year, its finance chief Armelle Poulou declined to comment, pointing to the publication of full-year results.
Kering's American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) were down 11% following its trading update, which showed sales at Gucci, which accounts for roughly half of group profit, were down 6% when adjusted for currency moves to €1.29 billion ($1.44 billion) in the quarter, while group revenue fell 1%.
Footfall, in particular in China, is the main problem at Gucci, where sales have been falling for more than three years, Kering said. Gucci sales also slid slightly in North America.
Kering plans to ramp up spending on marketing and client experience to attract more shoppers, Poulou said.
"We keep on carrying out our plan with the utmost discipline," Poulou said, adding Kering has so far reduced its retail network by 105 stores and was targeting 125 closures by the end of the year.
PRESSURE ON DESIGNER DEMNA Kering last year tapped De Meo to overhaul the group. Its shares had an early price bounce under the former Renault chief before cooling off, with the stock down 8% from a year earlier amid a wider sector downturn.
[USN:S8N3SZ01C TEXT:"De Meo"] aims to double Kering's profit margin from 11.1% in 2025 by the end of the decade through cost cuts, more store closures and a push to streamline supply chains.
But analysts have said mere efficiency measures will not be enough to turn around a business whose brands have lost appeal.
Both [USN:L6N45V0BJ TEXT:"Anthony Vaccarello"], the creative director of its second-biggest brand Saint Laurent, and Alexander McQueen designer [USN:L6N46114V TEXT:"Sean McGirr"] left their posts this month.
Fashion industry media have also speculated about the future of Balenciaga's creative director Pierpaolo Piccioli.
The recent changes are likely to pile even more pressure on Demna, who is nearing his first full year at the helm of Gucci, which he sought to reignite with a bold bet on daring, sexy styles reminiscent of the brand's successes under Tom Ford.
Demna also took some [USN:L6N45D0BT TEXT:"unusual manufacturing steps"], moving the production of his first sneaker models to China.
($1 = 0.8934 euros)

AUSTIN, Texas, Oct 22 : British teenager Freddie Slater will make his Formula One practice debut with Audi in Mexico next week, the team said on Thursday.
• The 18-year-old, first recruit to Audi's F1 driver development programme and one of Britain's emerging talents in junior series, will also take part in first Friday practice in Brazil the week after.
• Slater was Formula Three runner-up in his rookie season this year and is moving up to Formula Two, the last rung before Formula One, next year.
• "It is the right time for Freddie to step up," said Audi racing director Allan McNish. "These appearances in Mexico and Brazil will give him valuable experience of a Formula One race weekend and another chance to continue his development before he steps up to Formula Two".
• Slater missed out on the F3 title to McLaren junior driver Ugo Ugochukwu last month after going into the final round in Spain 15 points clear of his U.S. rival.

items.title: Ahead of the US midterms, Gen Z investors are making portfolio changes
items.author: Hani Richter
items.creator: Hani Richter
items.summary: Brandon Gaw is monitoring the news to adjust investments that he thinks could be hit hard by pre-election volatility ahead of the US midterms.
items.body:
Brandon Gaw, an Oregon-based engineering student and investor. Courtesy Brandon Gaw/Handout via REUTERS Brandon Gaw, an Oregon-based engineering student and investor, isn't just watching the news to stay in the know. He's also monitoring it to adjust investments that he thinks could be hit hard by pre-election volatility ahead of the US midterms .
“When others are fearful, that's the best time to invest,” he says.
One issue the 22-year-old is watching closely is the prospect of tighter restrictions involving Chinese-made memory chips entering the US market, as well as increased competition. Against this backdrop, Gaw says he is holding more cash and selling shares in smaller and newer companies that are more dependent on investors' excitement about AI, which he believes could be especially vulnerable to election uncertainty. Every few weeks, Gaw trades stocks worth $5,000 to $10,000. “In my opinion, those are going to get hit the most,” he says.
Brandon Gaw, an Oregon-based engineering student and investor. Courtesy Brandon Gaw/Handout via REUTERS Gaw accepts he’s taking more risk because of his age compared to an investor who may need their money sooner for retirement or a house. But he’s also investing in more established companies, including Microsoft, Google, Nvidia and Apple. “If anything, I added a few more positions in those companies,” he says. “I don't think they're going to run out of business anytime soon.”
For now, Gaw’s portfolio is fairly spread out: crypto, gold and silver collectively account for about 5% to 10%; ETFs make up around 30%; and individual stocks account for 60%. He has not made changes to his retirement investments. Taking a long-term view, Gaw says a market dip does not matter much to him if the S&P 500 falls. “I think these pullbacks are pretty good buying opportunities,” he says.
THE WIDER TREND
Nearly three-quarters of Gen Z investors have changed their retirement savings or portfolios in anticipation of the midterm election outcomes, compared to just 17% of Baby Boomers, according to a recent Nationwide Retirement Institute survey of over 2,000 US investors.
Tyler McConville, a Wisconsin-based certified financial planner and private wealth advisor at Capital Group, says “The challenge is determining which information actually matters to a long-term financial plan.”
While it is important to pay attention to elections and policy changes, markets have historically been influenced more by economic fundamentals and specific policy outcomes. “The biggest risk is when investors make long-term portfolio decisions based on short-term political concerns,” he says.
KEY TAKEAWAYS
Don’t make speculative trades. Use market-moving events as a reminder to review your investments and to consider how elections could affect certain sectors.
Keep diversification in mind. Gaw spreads his investments across individual stocks, ETFs, crypto and precious metals, while reducing his exposure to stocks that he considers volatile. A diversified portfolio can help limit reliance on any one investment or sector.
Focus on economic fundamentals. Rather than assuming one political party will be good or bad for stocks, consider factors such as inflation, interest rates, corporate earnings and specific policy changes when assessing your investments.
Have a money lesson or story to share? Tell us what worked for you — or what didn’t — by emailing hani.richter@tr.com .

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２２日 ロイター] - ２２日午前の米株式市場で、メタ・プラットフォームズの株価が６．５％下落し、一時約６週間ぶりの安値を付けた。同社のクレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（ＣＤＳ）
items.body:
[２２日 ロイター] - ２２日午前の米株式市場で、メタ・プラットフォームズの株価が６．５％下落し、一時約６週間ぶりの安値を付けた。同社のクレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（ＣＤＳ） も過去最高水準に上昇している。投資家は、急成長する人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェント事業の恩恵と、野心的なＡＩ事業拡大に伴う資金負担の増大を見極めている。

マークイットのデータによると、同社の債務不履行に備える保証コストであるＣＤＳは、５年物スプレッドが７．６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）拡大し、過去最高の１１４．７９ｂｐとなった。１日の拡大幅としては少なくとも２０２５年以降で最大となる見通し。

２１日終値時点では、株価は２６年に入って５％超上昇していた。現在の下落幅が続けば、時価総額は約８５０億ドル減少する見通し。

メタが２１日に発表した第３・四半期決算は、売上高が６４６億ドルと、ＬＳＥＧが集計したアナリスト予想の６３３億７０００万ドルを上回った。第４・四半期の売上高見通しも市場予想を上回った。

また、２６年の設備投資見通しを１３５０億─１４５０億ドルとし、従来の１３００億─１４５０億ドルから下限を引き上げた。

items.title: Top Democratic Virginia lawmaker charged by DOJ with running illegal cannabis operation
items.author: Andrew Goudsward
items.creator: Andrew Goudsward
items.summary: A senior Democratic state lawmaker in Virginia was charged with racketeering conspiracy, money laundering and other offenses for allegedly running an illegal cannabis business with members of her family, according to an indictment made public on Thursday.
items.body:
A senior Democratic state lawmaker in Virginia was charged with racketeering conspiracy, money laundering and other offenses for allegedly running an illegal cannabis business with members of her family, according to an indictment made public on Thursday.
Virginia State Senator L. Louise Lucas, 82, a long-serving Democrat, was charged along with two of her daughters, her grandson and three others, according to the indictment.
Prosecutors allege that Lucas and her associates arranged for the distribution and sale of large amounts of marijuana. Recreational cannabis dispensaries are not yet legally authorized in the state.
The indictment of a senior Democratic lawmaker comes less than two weeks before the November midterm elections , which will determine control of the US Congress, though Lucas and other members of the Virginia state Senate are not up for reelection this year.
The Justice Department under President Donald Trump has repeatedly investigated and, in some cases, prosecuted prominent critics of the Republican president, and the department faced criticism for raiding Democratic US Representative [USN:L1N45Y0CB TEXT:"Ilhan Omar's home"] last week.
Attorney General Todd Blanche said the investigation into Lucas has been ongoing for several years, rejecting suggestions that it was politically motivated.
"The charges listed in the indictment reflect the alleged behavior of a public servant who put her own financial interests before the people she was elected to serve," Blanche said during a press conference.
In a statement posted to social media, Lucas did not address the allegations in the indictment, but said the case resulted from her standing up to "people in power."
"I will not intimidated. I will not be bullied. And I will not back down," Lucas wrote.
Lucas surrendered to authorities on Thursday morning and was due to make her first court appearance later in the day in Norfolk, Virginia, federal court.
Lucas serves as president pro tempore of the state Senate, meaning she leads the legislative body when the lieutenant governor is not present.
She played a leading role in Virginia's unsuccessful attempt to redraw its legislative districts last year in a bid to keep pace with Republicans who were leading similar efforts in other states.

items.title: Peru taps fiscal strength to face El Niño impact, eases fiscal rules
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Peru on Thursday unveiled a package of economic measures aimed at cushioning a potential slowdown from the El Niño weather phenomenon.
items.body:
Peru on Thursday unveiled a package of economic measures aimed at cushioning a potential slowdown from the El Niño weather phenomenon.
Impacted firms will receive liquidity support and tax payment deferrals, Economy Minister Elmer Cuba said at a press conference, adding that Peru has the fiscal firepower to fund the measures.
"Not all countries can do that - only solvent ones. The vast majority of the planet cannot respond like this," Cuba said
Cuba cited three external shocks that could threaten Peru's economic momentum: El Niño, higher oil prices and rising global interest rates
Peru's accumulated fiscal deficit in the 12 months through September stood at 0.9% of gross domestic product, the lowest level in four years, helped by stronger tax revenue, including income tax collections, according to preliminary central bank data
Cuba also said Peru's economy could grow by more than the previously forecast 3.4%, even taking El Niño into account, though he did not give a revised estimate
Scientist say that [USN:L6N43N0VE TEXT:"warmer ocean temperatures"] linked to the El Niño phenomenon are disrupting marine ecosystems off Peru's Pacific coast, threatening the country's fishing industry
Speaking at the same press conference, President Keiko Fujimori said fiscal rules would be changed to allow an additional 18 billion soles ($5.22 billion) in investment next year
Fujimori added that the change in fiscal rules contemplates raising the deficit to 2.4% of GDP in 2027, taking advantage of the public accounts' solidity, from the actual government's target of 1.8% for this year and 1.4% for 2027
($1 = 3.4471 soles)

items.title: Anthropic IPO stands alone as AI market jitters sideline others
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: Anthropic plans to move forward with its initial public offering next month, navigating a challenging IPO landscape. While many companies in the AI field have delayed their public listings due to fluctuating interest rates and significant market instabilities, investors still see potential in Anthropic as a leading tech contender. Concerns are arising from the recent Oura IPO regarding institutional investor interest, emphasizing the heightened scrutiny on AI investment strategies.
items.body: A once-robust fall calendar for technology IPOs is down to just Anthropic.The AI lab is pressing ahead to hold its initial public offering as planned in the middle of next month after making its prospectus public as early as late October, people familiar with the matter said, cautioning the plan and the dates are subject to change.Anthropic's planned IPO will test whether its position at the center of the booming AI business, which the company is believed to deem worthy of a potential $1.5 trillion valuation, can overcome a market environment that might typically prompt bankers and deal lawyers to counsel delay. Anthropic is expected to begin marketing its shares to prospective investors during the week of November 9, one of the people said.For live updates on US Markets, click hereOther companies in the artificial intelligence infrastructure and data center sectors have delayed their listings, facing a rise in interest rates that has helped fuel a punishing selloff in shares and bonds of AI operators such as CoreWeave and broader questions about the sustainability of AI spending.The contrast underscores Anthropic's appeal to investors even as concerns about competition from open-source models and AI safety weigh on the sector.Many large investors remain bullish on Anthropic's prospects despite the fall turbulence, viewing the firm as one of the few opportunities to gain exposure to a technology sector that long-term investors cannot afford to ignore. Other issuers are reluctant to compete with Anthropic for institutional investors' attention and capital, two of the people said.Anthropic didn't immediately respond to a request for comment.VALUATIONS COMING UNDER PRESSUREThe AI sector pullback follows a string of IPO delays and withdrawals since September, as market volatility and rising interest rates have made it harder for companies to secure attractive valuations.Switch, a data center operator, and Nscale, an AI infrastructure provider, have pushed their IPO plans back to later this year, people familiar with the matter said, while stressing that plans remain fluid and subject to change. Nscale's delay was partly driven by the need to address comments from SEC staff, one other person said. SoftBank-backed SB Energy has also postponed its listing, Reuters previously reported.Switch, NScale and SB Energy didn't immediately respond to requests for comment.South Korean AI chip startup Elice was among the latest to shelve its listing plans overnight. Blackstone-backed AirTrunk REIT and Nvidia-backed Firmus have also pulled or paused their offerings, Reuters has reported.Oura's recent IPO has added to the caution among prospective issuers. The offering attracted little participation from long-only investors, a person familiar with the matter said, raising concerns about the depth of demand from institutional investors that typically provide a stable base of shareholders for newly listed companies.SCRUTINY ON MULTIPLE FRONTSThe retreat from AI infrastructure listings reflects growing scrutiny of the enormous capital required to build data centers and whether future demand will justify the investment.Recent developments involving CoreWeave have added to concerns about a potential slowdown in AI spending, although some market participants do not expect such a downturn to materialize.Nscale publicly filed its IPO registration statement in September, while Switch submitted its filing confidentially, Reuters reported previously. A confidential filing allows a company to work with regulators on its registration statement before disclosing financial and business details to the public. Companies typically publish the filing ahead of investor roadshows, when they begin marketing shares to prospective investors.
items.raw_description: Anthropic plans to move forward with its initial public offering next month, navigating a challenging IPO landscape. While many companies in the AI field have delayed their public listings due to fluctuating interest rates and significant market instabilities, investors still see potential in Anthropic as a leading tech contender. Concerns are arising from the recent Oura IPO regarding institutional investor interest, emphasizing the heightened scrutiny on AI investment strategies.

items.title: Sebi warns investors against fraudulent WhatsApp stock tip groups
items.author: Our Bureau
items.summary: The market regulator warned that unregistered entities use invitation-only WhatsApp groups, fabricated profit testimonials and overseas numbers to lure unsuspecting investors ...
items.body: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) on Thursday cautioned investors against unregistered entities offering stock tips and trading calls through invitation-only WhatsApp groups, warning of misleading profit claims and fraudulent practices. The operators, often using overseas numbers, pose as market experts and encourage members to post fabricated profit testimonials to create an impression of credibility. Sebi said members are frequently invited to new groups through messages from different numbers after the original groups are suspended or banned. The regulator advised investors to avoid acting on such tips, transferring money to suggested platforms or sharing trading account details, and to deal only with Sebi-registered intermediaries.  Mkt regulator allows margin relief against early pay-in of securities The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) on Thursday said that clearing corporations will not collect margins from trading and clearing members on clients’ subsequent buy or sell positions in the cash segment, up to the value of securities for which early pay-in (EPI) has been successfully accepted. It aims to provide margin relief to clients who have a net sell obligation in a settlement and have completed the EPI process through the clearing corporation.  BSE widens IPO fast-tracking to top 30 firms BSE Index Services will fast-track IPOs ranked among the top 30 companies into its indices, up from the top 10 at present. The change, effective October 23, applies to all broad and market-cap indices except the BSE AllCap Index, the circular said. For the AllCap, Size and Sector indices, IPOs in the top 30 by average daily total market capitalisation will be added with five days’ notice to clients.  Nippon Life India AMC Q2 profit drops 6% Nippon Life India Asset Management on Thursday reported a 6 per cent decline in profit after tax at ₹324.4 crore for September quarter primarily driven by a one-time exceptional item of ₹96.76 crore pertaining to Sebi settlement proceedings. The company earned a profit after tax of ₹344.64 crore in the year-ago period. Revenue from operations surged 21 per cent to ₹796 crore in the quarter.

items.title: Perú anuncia política "contracíclica", con mayor déficit fiscal, para enfrentar a El Niño
items.author: Marco Aquino
items.creator: Marco Aquino
items.summary: Perú pondrá en marcha una política "contracíclica" elevando los topes de su meta de déficit fiscal para hacer mas inversiones y enfrentar choques externos en la economía local, como los efectos del fenómeno climático de El Niño, anunció el jueves el ministro de Economía del país sudamericano, Elmer Cuba.
items.body:
Perú pondrá en marcha una política "contracíclica" elevando los topes de su meta de déficit fiscal para hacer mas inversiones y enfrentar choques externos en la economía local, como los efectos del fenómeno climático de El Niño, anunció el jueves el ministro de Economía del país sudamericano, Elmer Cuba.
En una conferencia de prensa junto a la presidenta Keiko Fujimori, Cuba dijo que el Gobierno otorgará bonos a familias vulnerables, se inyectará liquidez y aplazarán pagos de impuestos a las empresas afectadas.
El ministro dijo que el país minero tiene espacio fiscal para una respuesta frente a los choques externos, incluido el alza del petróleo y el aumento de las tasas de interés en el mundo.
"Cada uno de estos choques amenaza el normal funcionamiento de cualquier economía y puede afectar el dinamismo de Perú, algo que no vamos a permitir porque tenemos espacio fiscal", manifestó Cuba. "No todos los países pueden hacer eso, solamente los países solventes", agregó.
El déficit fiscal acumulado de Perú en los últimos 12 meses hasta septiembre fue del 0,9% del PIB, el más bajo en cuatro años, debido a mayores ingresos fiscales, según datos preliminares del banco central.
Durante la conferencia de prensa, la presidenta Fujimori dijo que el Gobierno elevará los topes de la regla fiscal del 2027 para permitir la inversión de 18.000 millones de soles (unos 5.220 mil millones de dólares) más el próximo año.
La mandataria detalló que, de ese monto, se destinarán 2.500 millones de soles en bonos para familias vulnerables, unos 2.000 millones de soles para el mantenimiento de la infraestructura y 13.000 millones de soles para culminar obras paralizadas.
"La respuesta tiene que ser fuerte e histórica", afirmó.
Fujimori dijo que el cambio de la regla fiscal contempla elevar el déficit a 2,4% del PBI en 2027, aprovechando la solidez de las cuentas públicas, desde la actual meta de un déficit fiscal de 1,8% este año y 1,4% el próximo.
El Gobierno dijo recientemente que la temperatura del mar en Perú ha llegado a sus niveles máximos en esta época del año, lo que hace prever que enfrentará el fenómeno climático de El Niño [USN:L1N4620VD TEXT:"más poderoso"] de las últimas décadas.
"Será un Niño sin precedente en los últimos 70 años", dijo Cuba, quien, sin embargo, agregó que la economía del país podría crecer este año más del 3,4% que espera el gobierno, aunque no proporcionó una nueva cifra.
El Niño ya está afectando a la industria de la pesca, a la agricultura y está presionando los precios. Por otra parte, se prevé que lluvias e inundaciones dañen infraestructura como carreteras y servicios básicos.
A mediados de septiembre, el Banco Central de Perú [USN:L1N45A0RI TEXT:"redujo su proyección de crecimiento"] para la economía del país minero a un 3,2% en 2026, desde el 3,4% que había previsto, debido a los efectos de El Niño.
(1 dólar = 3,45 soles)

items.title: CSN, Vale, Braskem e outras indústrias compram gás em leilão inédito da PPSA
items.author: Leticia Augusto
items.creator: Leticia Augusto
items.summary: A siderúrgica CSN , a mineradora Vale e a petroquímica Braskem , entre outras grandes companhias industriais, venceram lotes de gás natural da União ofertados em leilão inédito do insumo realizado pela Pré-Sal Petróleo (PPSA) nesta quinta-feira, segundo dados da plataforma do certame.
items.body:
A siderúrgica CSN (CSNA3.SA) , a mineradora Vale (VALE3.SA) e a petroquímica Braskem (BRKM3.SA) , entre outras grandes companhias industriais, venceram lotes de gás natural da União ofertados em leilão inédito do insumo realizado pela Pré-Sal Petróleo (PPSA) nesta quinta-feira, segundo dados da plataforma do certame.
O primeiro leilão para venda direta de gás à indústria brasileira terminou com todo o volume oferecido, de 1,1 milhão m³/dia dividido em 110 lotes, arrematado por 23 empresas de cinco setores grandes consumidores de gás.
O preço médio do gás negociado ficou em US$5,83/MMBtu, o que, segundo uma autoridade do Ministério de Minas e Energia, proporcionará às indústrias participantes reduções de 38% a 57% frente à média de US$12/MMBtu usada como referência de mercado.
No setor químico e petroquímico, que contou com o maior volume de gás disponibilizado, de 350 mil m³/dia, foram vencedoras a Braskem (BRKM3.SA) , Rhodia, Evonik, Ingredion e Peróxidos do Brasil.
Entre as siderúrgicas, metalúrgicas e mineradoras, com 320 mil m³/dia de gás ofertado, foram vencedoras CSN, Gerdau Aços Longos, Samarco, Ternium Brasil e Vale.
Também contrataram gás a Yara Fertilizantes e Multitécnica Industrial, do setor de fertilizantes nitrogenados, com 130 mil m³/dia, e outras 11 empresas dos setores ceramista (200 mil m³/dia) e vidreiro (100 mil m³/dia).
Em relação a preços, os menores lances foram de US$4,00/MMBtu para o setor vidreiro, US$1,86/MMBtu para o ceramista, US$2,30/MMBtu para o siderúrgico, metalúrgico e de mineração, US$1,92/MMBtu para químico e petroquímico e US$1,82/MMBtu para fertilizantes nitrogenados.
Os lances tiveram uma referência inicial de US$1,80/MMBtu para todas as disputas.
Com fornecimento entre março e dezembro de 2027, o gás vendido neste leilão será entregue no Complexo de Energias Boaventura da Petrobras, o antigo Comperj, em Itaboraí (RJ). A partir dali, cada comprador contrata o transporte por gasodutos até suas fábricas.
DEMANDA REPRIMIDA O leilão da PPSA é o primeiro de venda direta a consumidores do gás natural pertencente à União. A iniciativa buscou ampliar o número de agentes no mercado de gás e contribuir para a competitividade da indústria brasileira.
"O que o dia de hoje comprovou foi que a demanda (por gás) não só existe, mas você tem setores industriais ávidos por adquirir o gás natural a um preço competitivo, com uma formação de preço em leilão", disse Renato Dutra, secretário de Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis do Ministério de Minas e Energia.
Segundo ele, as reduções de dois dígitos de preço mostram que é possível fazer política pública com o gás da União, ajudando na competitividade da indústria nacional, "com um preço justo e adequado no sentido de remunerar as infraestruturas (de escoamento e processamento de gás)".
Segundo o presidente da PPSA, Luis Fernando Paroli, o Brasil terá um [USN:L1N4680YA TEXT:"novo leilão"] de gás natural da União à indústria em 2027, com oferta de 1,8 milhão de metros cúbicos por dia.

Oct 22 : Bayern Munich forward Luis Diaz will be out of action for the "foreseeable future" after suffering a minor muscle tear in his left hamstring during Wednesday's 2-2 Champions League draw with visiting Arsenal, the Bundesliga club said on Thursday.
The 29-year-old Colombia international came on in the 68th minute at the Allianz Arena but was forced off in stoppage time after suffering the injury.
Examinations carried out by Bayern's medical staff confirmed the hamstring tear, the club said in a statement.
"The 29-year-old forward will therefore be sidelined for the time being," Bayern said.

FAST

Oct 22 : Cable production capacity is emerging as a bottleneck for AI-driven data centre construction, Nexans' finance chief said, as demand rises faster than the industry's ability to expand manufacturing capacity.
Global cable capacity is tight and building a new cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) cable production line, known in the industry as a CV line, takes around three years, limiting how quickly suppliers can respond to demand, Nexans CFO Vincent Piquet told Reuters.
"Things can't move quickly and the people building these data centres are in a great hurry," Piquet said.
Data centres require large amounts of low- and medium-voltage cable to connect power infrastructure, with larger facilities consuming proportionately more medium-voltage cable.

The strain on power infrastructure is already delaying some projects. In September, Oracle issued a force majeure notice to a Blue Owl unit developing a large data centre in New Mexico, citing potential difficulties securing sufficient power for the site.
Piquet said grid constraints, while slowing some projects, were also supporting demand for Nexans' products and allowing the company to be more selective when allocating capacity.
French distribution network operator Enedis has moved from annual procurement agreements to contracts lasting six or seven years in order to secure cable supply, he said.
While Europe generally faces fewer grid-connection challenges than the United States and benefits from stronger electricity networks in some northern countries, Piquet said lengthy regulatory processes were delaying certain projects.
He said he did not expect demand linked to artificial intelligence to slow, although Europe's data-centre expansion was likely to be less pronounced than in the United States because private investment capacity was smaller and public funding played a larger role.

FAST

Oct 22 : Cable production capacity is emerging as a bottleneck for AI-driven data centre construction, Nexans' finance chief said, as demand rises faster than the industry's ability to expand manufacturing capacity.
Global cable capacity is tight and building a new cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) cable production line, known in the industry as a CV line, takes around three years, limiting how quickly suppliers can respond to demand, Nexans CFO Vincent Piquet told Reuters.
"Things can't move quickly and the people building these data centres are in a great hurry," Piquet said.
Data centres require large amounts of low- and medium-voltage cable to connect power infrastructure, with larger facilities consuming proportionately more medium-voltage cable.

The strain on power infrastructure is already delaying some projects. In September, Oracle issued a force majeure notice to a Blue Owl unit developing a large data centre in New Mexico, citing potential difficulties securing sufficient power for the site.
Piquet said grid constraints, while slowing some projects, were also supporting demand for Nexans' products and allowing the company to be more selective when allocating capacity.
French distribution network operator Enedis has moved from annual procurement agreements to contracts lasting six or seven years in order to secure cable supply, he said.
While Europe generally faces fewer grid-connection challenges than the United States and benefits from stronger electricity networks in some northern countries, Piquet said lengthy regulatory processes were delaying certain projects.
He said he did not expect demand linked to artificial intelligence to slow, although Europe's data-centre expansion was likely to be less pronounced than in the United States because private investment capacity was smaller and public funding played a larger role.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Líder da oposição do Equador González é presa por supostas irregularidades em financiamento de campanha
items.author: Alexandra Valencia
items.creator: Alexandra Valencia
items.summary: Uma proeminente política de esquerda do Equador, que ficou em segundo lugar nas duas últimas eleições, atrás do presidente Daniel Noboa, foi presa, informou nesta quinta-feira a chefe de seu partido.
items.body:
Uma proeminente política de esquerda do Equador, que ficou em segundo lugar nas duas últimas eleições, atrás do presidente Daniel Noboa, foi presa, informou nesta quinta-feira a chefe de seu partido.
Luisa González, protegida do ex-presidente socialista Rafael Correa, está sendo investigada por supostas irregularidades no financiamento político e nos gastos de campanha nas eleições de 2023.
Em uma postagem no X, González disse que a acusação era “absurda” e pediu união aos membros de seu partido para alcançar a liberdade e a democracia no Equador.
A líder do partido Revolução Cidadã, Gabriela Rivadeneira, confirmou a prisão em uma postagem nas redes sociais e argumentou que ela teve motivação política.
“Exigimos a libertação imediata de Luisa González, que não deveria ter que enfrentar um processo de perseguição e tortura imposto por este governo”, disse ela aos repórteres.
Em um vídeo publicado nas redes sociais, a Procuradoria-Geral informou que a investigação buscava esclarecer a origem dos recursos utilizados para financiar a propaganda eleitoral entre maio e agosto de 2023.
“Uma rede de pessoas jurídicas foi utilizada para canalizar aproximadamente US$500.000 para contratar e adquirir publicidade de campanha. Os recursos teriam sido canalizados sem a divulgação de sua origem ou da identidade dos contribuintes”, afirmou o vídeo.
Rivadeneira afirmou que os recursos da campanha de 2023 foram totalmente contabilizados e que as multas financeiras impostas anteriormente pela autoridade eleitoral já haviam sido pagas, reiterando declarações anteriores de González.
O ex-presidente Correa, que apoiou a candidatura de González, também contestou as alegações.
“Não se trata de legalidade, nem de se as regras estão sendo seguidas ou não. Trata-se de uma perseguição brutal e simples”, disse ele em um programa de rádio local.
A Procuradoria-Geral do Equador, em uma postagem nas redes sociais, informou que sete pessoas estão sob investigação por “inconsistências nas contribuições e na origem lícita dos recursos” durante a campanha presidencial de 2023.
Três pessoas foram presas até o momento e responderão a acusações por suposta lavagem de dinheiro, informou o órgão, sem revelar seus nomes completos.
González perdeu as eleições de 2023 e 2025 para Noboa e alegou fraude na derrota do ano passado. Ela tentou concorrer às eleições locais marcadas para 29 de novembro, mas não conseguiu registrar sua candidatura devido às regras de registro dos partidos.

items.body:
Helen Coster

[２２日　ロイター] - バンス米副大統領は２２日、オハイオ州知事選で共和党候補のビベック・ラマスワミ氏の陣営が民主党のライバル候補に対して展開した攻撃広告を擁護した。また、共和党議員に対して「泣き言を言うのはやめて」、選挙に勝つよう呼びかけた。

問題の広告は、民主党候補エイミー・アクトン氏と疎遠になっている母親ドナ・アーサー氏が登場し、幼少期にホームレス生活を送り、性的虐待を受けたというアクトン氏の主張にアーサー氏が異議を唱える内容となっている。アクトン氏によると、１９７８年以来会っていないというアーサー氏は、オハイオ州民に対しアクトン氏に投票しないよう訴えている。 アクトン氏は、１２歳の時に継父から性的虐待を受けたと主張している。 

この広告は広く非難を浴びており、品位を欠く中間選挙戦の様相を浮き彫りにした。トランプ大統領の大統領選以降、右傾化が進んだオハイオ州において、ラマスワミ氏や他の共和党候補にとって逆効果となる可能性がある。 

こうした中、バンス氏は２２日、ラマスワミ氏や共和党のジョン・ハステッド上院議員と共に演説を行い、こうした反発を一蹴した。 

バンス氏は、ラマスワミ氏との集会に先立ちシンシナティで、「共和党の同僚議員たちへの私のメッセージはこうだ。自分が信じていると述べているものを本当に信じるのなら、広告について泣き言を言うのはやめて、残り１３日の選挙戦で勝利を収めるべきだ」と強調。

その上で「皆さんへの私のメッセージは非常にシンプルだ。テレビ広告についてどう思おうと、その内容と事実に注目してほしい」と述べた。

この広告は当初、スポンサー表記のないまま２１日に交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に公開されたが、その後、ラマスワミ氏の陣営が制作元であることを認め、広告の宣伝のために４００万ドルを投じていると説明した明らかにした。 

トランプ氏は２２日、広告について何も知らないと語った。

Oct 22 : Indian IT services firm Tech Mahindra said on Thursday it has partnered with SpaceXSI to use AI to help companies modernise legacy applications and speed up software development.
• India's fifth-largest IT firm will also be bringing in chatbot Grok Build to set up industry-specific solutions
• The partnership will focus on supporting organizations across key sectors such as technology, telecommunications and banking, financial services
• While Tech Mahindra has similar pacts with Google Gemini and Microsoft, this is the first time an Indian IT major is collaborating with the AI division of rocket maker SpaceX

items.title: South Africa’s Trade With China Surges After Beijing’s Zero-Tariff Deal
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: South Africa’s trade with China has increased since Beijing introduced a temporary zero-tariff scheme for qualifying South African exports in May, offering Pretoria an opportunity to expand sales to its largest trading partner as relations with the United States come under increasing strain. South African …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
South Africa’s trade with China has increased since Beijing introduced a temporary zero-tariff scheme for qualifying South African exports in May, offering Pretoria an opportunity to expand sales to its largest trading partner as relations with the United States come under increasing strain.

South African exports to China rose nearly 25% year over year between May and August, while imports from China increased 23% over the same period, Chinese Ambassador Wu Peng said at an event in Pretoria on Thursday.

South Africa has been seeking to rebalance its trade with China, which is its largest trading partner. In 2025, South Africa exported about 222 billion rand ($13.5 billion) worth of goods to China and imported nearly twice that amount, Trade Minister Parks Tau said.

South Africa’s exports to China include agricultural products, minerals and manufactured goods. The government is seeking to expand access for higher-value products as it looks to narrow the trade imbalance and diversify its export markets.

Wu said he had heard South Africa’s concerns about the imbalance in bilateral trade and expressed confidence that Chinese market access for South African products would expand.

“I am confident more and more South African high value-added products will enter the Chinese market in the future,” he said.

China’s zero-tariff preference scheme took effect on May 1, 2026, and is scheduled to run through April 30, 2028, pending a broader economic partnership arrangement between China and African countries. The temporary measure covers qualifying South African exports that meet applicable rules of origin and documentation requirements, while certain products are subject to tariff-rate quotas.

The arrangement provides South African exporters with an opportunity to compete in the Chinese market without paying customs duties on eligible goods. However, the increase in trade recorded since May does not establish how much of the growth resulted directly from the tariff changes.

For Pretoria, expanding exports to China is part of a broader effort to develop alternative markets as uncertainty over access to the U.S. market threatens an established source of export demand.

The United States has extended the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA), which gives eligible sub-Saharan African countries duty-free access to the U.S. market for thousands of products, through 2028. South Africa, however, faces the risk of exclusion as President Donald Trump’s administration has criticized several of its domestic and foreign policies.

The Trump administration has accused the South African government of persecuting white people, an allegation Pretoria denies.

South African President Cyril Ramaphosa said on October 19 that the country must prepare for the possibility of losing its AGOA benefits, as his government pursues alternative markets and holds discussions with U.S. counterparts.

Tau said he expected an announcement in early November on whether South Africa would be excluded from the program, but remained “cautiously optimistic.”

The uncertainty has added urgency to South Africa’s efforts to diversify its export destinations, including through stronger commercial ties with China. However, expanding trade with Beijing does not necessarily guarantee a reduction in the bilateral trade imbalance, particularly as imports from China are also rising.

South Africa’s ability to benefit from the Chinese scheme will depend partly on whether domestic producers can increase exports of qualifying goods and move into higher-value agricultural, industrial and processed products. The tariff preference removes customs duties on eligible exports but does not eliminate other market-access requirements.

The two countries’ trade figures point to expanding commercial ties, but the challenge for Pretoria will be to translate that growth into greater export earnings and a more balanced trading relationship.

With a decision on South Africa’s AGOA eligibility expected in early November, the country faces pressure to strengthen its position in China and other markets while seeking to preserve preferential access to the United States.

items.title: 米ブラックストーン、第3四半期13％減益　市場混乱が逆風
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２２日 ロイター] - 米大手投資会社ブラックストーンが２２日発表した第３・四半期決算は減益となった。市場環境の混乱が投資回収の重荷となった。

世界の市場は、債券利回りの急上昇や高金利の長期化観測、イラン戦争に伴う相場変動の拡大で動揺している。

この結果、多くの案件が保留となり、２０２６年上半期の取引や新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）は減速した。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、第３・四半期の世界のＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収）は前四半期比４１％減少した。

ブラックストーンの投資回収に伴う収益は３４％減の約３億３２００万ドルとなった。プライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）事業で５０％近く減少したことが響いた。

分配可能利益（株主に還元可能な利益）は１株当たり１．３２ドルと１３％減少した。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の平均は１．２６ドルだった。

一方、６３０億ドルを超える資金の純流入が業績を下支えした。運用資産残高は１兆３７００億ドルに拡大し、手数料関連利益は６％増加した。

新規の資金流入はクレジット・保険事業が約３６０億ドルと最大で、ＰＥ事業が１２６億ドルで続いた。

ＰＥファンドの運用による手数料関連利益は２６％増の６億１９００万ドルとなった。

オルタナティブ資産運用各社の株価は２６年に入り下落している。今後の成長鈍化の見通しや、人工知能（ＡＩ）の進歩が投資先企業の事業に混乱をもたらす可能性に対し、投資家が慎重姿勢を強めたためだ。

特にプライベートクレジットに対する投資家の不安は強く、大手運用各社はここ数四半期にわたり解約請求の急増を報告している。

ブラックストーンは９月、同社のファンド「ＢＣＲＥＤ」への解約請求が第３・四半期も高水準にとどまったと明らかにした。ただ、投資先のファンダメンタルズ（基礎的条件）は引き続き健全だとの見解を維持している。

同社株は２６年に入り３０％近く急落し、他の資産運用会社とおおむね同様の値動きとなっている。一方、市場全体は１３％、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００金融株指数は約２％上昇している。

[２２日 ロイター] - 米大手投資会社ブラックストーンが２２日発表した第３・四半期決算は減益となった。市場環境の混乱が投資回収の重荷となった。

世界の市場は、債券利回りの急上昇や高金利の長期化観測、イラン戦争に伴う相場変動の拡大で動揺している。

この結果、多くの案件が保留となり、２０２６年上半期の取引や新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）は減速した。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、第３・四半期の世界のＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収）は前四半期比４１％減少した。

ブラックストーンの投資回収に伴う収益は３４％減の約３億３２００万ドルとなった。プライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）事業で５０％近く減少したことが響いた。

分配可能利益（株主に還元可能な利益）は１株当たり１．３２ドルと１３％減少した。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の平均は１．２６ドルだった。

一方、６３０億ドルを超える資金の純流入が業績を下支えした。運用資産残高は１兆３７００億ドルに拡大し、手数料関連利益は６％増加した。

新規の資金流入はクレジット・保険事業が約３６０億ドルと最大で、ＰＥ事業が１２６億ドルで続いた。

ＰＥファンドの運用による手数料関連利益は２６％増の６億１９００万ドルとなった。

オルタナティブ資産運用各社の株価は２６年に入り下落している。今後の成長鈍化の見通しや、人工知能（ＡＩ）の進歩が投資先企業の事業に混乱をもたらす可能性に対し、投資家が慎重姿勢を強めたためだ。

特にプライベートクレジットに対する投資家の不安は強く、大手運用各社はここ数四半期にわたり解約請求の急増を報告している。

ブラックストーンは９月、同社のファンド「ＢＣＲＥＤ」への解約請求が第３・四半期も高水準にとどまったと明らかにした。ただ、投資先のファンダメンタルズ（基礎的条件）は引き続き健全だとの見解を維持している。

同社株は２６年に入り３０％近く急落し、他の資産運用会社とおおむね同様の値動きとなっている。一方、市場全体は１３％、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００金融株指数は約２％上昇している。

items.title: Detienen a excandidata ecuatoriana Luisa González por acusación sobre fondos electorales
items.author: Alexandra Valencia
items.creator: Alexandra Valencia
items.summary: La dirigencia del partido izquierdista ecuatoriano Revolución Ciudadana informó sobre la detención en la madrugada del jueves de Luisa González, principal rival del presidente Daniel Noboa en las dos últimas elecciones, que calificó la acusación de "abusrda".
items.body:
La dirigencia del partido izquierdista ecuatoriano Revolución Ciudadana informó sobre la detención en la madrugada del jueves de Luisa González, principal rival del presidente Daniel Noboa en las dos últimas elecciones, que calificó la acusación de "abusrda".
González, una protegida del expresidente socialista Rafael Correa, es investigada, juntos a otros miembros de su partido, por presuntas irregularidades en la financiación política y los gastos de campaña del 2023.
"Hoy me toca a mi ser detenida por una acusación absurda", escribió González en una carta publicado en su cuenta de X. "Los presos políticos de la dictadura están siendo maltratados y torturados".
"Hemos llegado a una situación insostenible", añadió.
La presidenta del partido Revolución Ciudadana, Gabriela Rivadeneira, dijo a periodistas que los fondos de la campaña de 2023 fueron debidamente justificados y que las sanciones económicas impuestas antes por la autoridad electoral ya habían sido pagadas, reiterando así declaraciones previas de la propia González.
El movimiento político exigió la inmediata libertad de González ante la falta de pruebas en su contra.
Correa, quien respaldó la candidatura de González, también rechazó las acusaciones.
“Aquí no se trata de legalidad (...) es brutal y simple persecución y frente a eso sólo queda resistir de todas formas posibles", dijo a Radio Pichincha. "A Luisa la van a enterrar en vida".
La Fiscalía General del Estado informó de que siete personas están siendo investigadas en relación con este caso —tres de ellas detenidas, de quienes solo se proporcionaron sus iniciales— y añadió que en las próximas horas presentará cargos por presunto lavado de activos.
Más tarde, la institución explicó que además de los fondos declarados ante la autoridad electoral, se habrían utilizado "un entramado" de personas jurídicas para canalizar aproximadamente 500.000 dólares para la campaña electoral, de acuerdo a lo recabado en la investigación.
"Los fondos se habrían canalizado sin trasparentar su procedencia ni la identidad de quienes habrían aportado”, añadió la fiscalía en un video publicado en redes sociales.
González perdió frente a Noboa tanto en las elecciones de 2023 como en las de 2025. Tras la derrota del año pasado, denunció un supuesto fraude. Intentó postularse en los comicios seccionales del 29 de noviembre, pero no pudo inscribirse por las normas de registro de partidos políticos.

BRUSSELS, Oct 22 : Digital advertisers and publishers lobbied on Thursday for EU and UK regulators to suspend Meta Platforms' new commercial terms due to come into effect on October 30, alleging that these would give Meta an unlimited right to use their content for its AI services.
Advocacy group the Movement for an Open Web, whose members include digital advertisers and publishers, said it had complained to the European Commission and the UK's Competition and Markets Authority and requested interim measures.
Publishers worldwide are stepping up their fight with AI companies that use their content without permission to train large language models, underscoring the clash between copyright owners and those citing fair use arguments.
"Meta's new terms are clearly anti-competitive. Many businesses effectively have no choice but to use Meta's services and these conditions would force them to sign away the rights to their digital content with no means of opting out," Tim Cowen, co-founder of the Movement for an Open Web, said.

"The terms would give Meta a free hand to scrape content from nearly every website in the world, potentially using that data to power AI-powered services that would then compete with those businesses," he said.
Meta said it disagreed with the complaint.
"The crawling terms we consolidated only applied to our ads and business products, and we've clarified that in the terms themselves. It does not change how Meta uses web crawlers," a Meta spokesperson said.
"As always, content owners can use robots.txt to signal their preferences. This is not about scraping news sites, and these updates don't give us new rights that supersede those preferences."
The CMA said it met with Meta on Wednesday to get more details on its new business terms.
"This is an important issue and we recognise the concerns that have been raised by businesses in the UK. We are engaged in urgent discussions with Meta as we consider our next steps," a CMA spokesperson said.
The European Commission said it has received a complaint which it would assess in line with its usual procedure and that it was committed to ensuring that Meta's practices comply with EU laws. 
Companies requesting interim measures have to show that they will suffer serious and irreparable damage from the alleged anti-competitive practices.
The criticism by the Movement for an Open Web followed similar complaints aired by the European Publishers Council (EPC) last week and Germany's Digital Publishers and Newspaper Publishers Association (BDZV) and the Association of the Free Press (MVFP) earlier this week.    

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 22 : Nippon Steel will invest about $3 billion in the U.S. Steel-operated Mon Valley works in Pennsylvania to upgrade the plant's hot rolling facility, the Nikkei newspaper reported on Thursday.
The move is part of the Japanese steelmaker's pledge to invest $11 billion in U.S. Steel by 2028, following its acquisition of the company in 2025.
Nippon Steel did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours.
Mon Valley's hot rolling equipment, which heats slabs of iron from blast furnaces and rolls them into thinner steel, has been in operation for about 90 years, Nikkei added.
The new equipment is set to enter operation in the second half of 2029, which would enable production of higher-quality steel, the report said.
Nippon Steel raised its fiscal 2026 earnings forecast in August, lifted by stronger U.S. Steel earnings and a firm steel market.

Source: Reuters

Oct 22 : Anyone who has watched a manta ray glide over a reef knows how unhurried these marine animals can look. Yet researchers working off Costa Rica found their movements are varied, with juveniles staying nearby and close to shore while adults venture hundreds of kilometres.
Manta rays are among the ocean's largest fish, with wing-like fins that can span up to about 8 meters (26 feet) and the largest brain of any fish.
Researchers tracked endangered oceanic manta rays between 2018 and 2025, fitting 59 of them with acoustic transmitters and tracking 12 with satellite tags, along with photo identification. 
"By combining different technologies ... we were able to piece together a highly detailed map of their movements and their use of coastal cleaning stations," said Jeffry Madrigal-Mesén, director of the research group Mantas Costa Rica and lead author of the study published in the journal Frontiers in Fish Science.

A coastal cleaning station is a rocky reef site where small fish remove parasites from the skin of the manta rays in an example of symbiotic behaviour.
Researchers found that smaller, immature mantas stayed within Costa Rica's coastal waters, called its exclusive economic zone. Larger, mature animals undertook long-distance journeys, some reaching as far as the waters off Guatemala.
"This makes us believe that smaller mantas do not risk these long migrations, likely due to the threat of large predators like orcas and tiger sharks," Madrigal-Mesén said.
The smaller animals in the study measured around 3 to 3.5 meters across (10 to 11.5 feet), compared with around 4 to 4.5 meters (13 to 15 feet) for those making the longer journeys.
DANGER FROM PREDATORS
A juvenile, at around 3 meters across, would still appear enormous to most swimmers. Yet that size may not be enough protection.
Madrigal-Mesén said that "their massive size is one of their main defence mechanisms. It is quite common to see animals missing portions of their bodies, and in many cases, the shape of the wounds strongly suggests they are bites from other large marine predators."
What prompts mantas to eventually join the migratory population remains unclear, although researchers suspect that reaching feeding and breeding grounds in highly productive waters across Central America may play a role.
The manta rays also repeatedly return to the same coastal cleaning stations. Observations of feeding, courtship and recent mating suggest these sites may also function as social hubs. Scientists do not yet know how mantas navigate back to particular sites.
"Based on the bathymetry of the different sites we monitor, there must be a relationship with the rock formations. We humans have favourite places we like to go to," Madrigal-Mesén said. "Why couldn't mantas have a preference for one cleaning station over another?"
The findings also suggest the mantas may not roam as far as once thought. Researchers initially suspected that animals seen in Costa Rica might migrate from populations in Ecuador or Mexico. The tracking data instead raises the possibility that Central America has its own distinct population, something the team is now investigating through genetic work.
Mantas are particularly vulnerable because, like other rays and sharks, they reproduce slowly and take years to reach sexual maturity. Madrigal-Mesén said that once the animals left Cocos Island, a volcanic island in the Pacific Ocean, and most monitored coastal sites, they entered waters with no protection, exposing them to threats including fishing and vessel traffic.
"Studies like this help us recognise that these coastal havens only protect them for a specific time of the year. ... This is why it is so critical to protect the marine corridors these migratory species travel through."
Coastal mantas also showed strong site fidelity, with very few moving between monitoring sites even when they were only tens of kilometres apart. 
One male became a particularly striking example. Nicknamed "Mickey Mouse" for its distinctive spot pattern, the ray was repeatedly photographed at Cabo Blanco and tracked using both satellite and acoustic tags, showing a strong attachment to the site. 
But researchers have not seen this ray in Costa Rica for more than a year. 
"We have a lot of affection for him," Madrigal-Mesén added. "We hope he comes back soon."

Source: Reuters

NEW YORK, Oct 22 : The yen was on track for its strongest daily gain in almost a month on Thursday, as investors sought safety amid fragile equity markets, elevated crude prices from the drawn-out war in the Middle East, and doubts over future returns from artificial intelligence.
The US dollar, meanwhile, rose against the euro. Worries about social unrest in France and a worsening fiscal outlook for the country outweighed concerns about the AI trade, which pushed US stocks lower.
"AI is making people nervous, as is oil ... and as is France," said Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets.
Oil prices climbed about 3 per cent to a five-month high after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concerns of further disruption to energy supplies from the key exporting region.

The Japanese yen strengthened 0.75 per cent to 156.96 per dollar.
Some of the move in the yen may also be due to its approaching the key 160 level, which is seen as increasing the odds of further intervention by Japanese authorities to shore up the currency.
Kevin Ford, lead FX and macro strategist at Convera, called it "the intervention premium," noting that "every time the yen gets closer to the 160 line, that's where there's higher speculation that the central bank will intervene."
Against the Swiss franc, another traditional safe haven, the dollar weakened 0.42 per cent to  0.821 francs per dollar.
The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, fell 0.08 per cent to 101.60, with the euro down 0.09 per cent at $1.1222.
The dollar has become increasingly tied to capital flows and to growth and inflation expectations linked to the AI trade. It fell last week as fears over the AI outlook grew. On Thursday, however, concerns about France outweighed those fears.
"You have these competing stories and weak points between US AI-related credits and then France's sovereign credit, and we've seen this push and pull in the last couple of days where at times one is more of a concern than the other,” said Erik Nelson, global head of FX strategy at Wells Fargo. “As long as France is more of a concern than US AI credits, then you're going to see the euro underperform.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that "illegitimate" protests would be banned in the coming days and blamed "seditious" ultra-left groups and vandals for last weekend's riots and looting.
Concerns about France's ability to manage its huge debt burden have hurt French government bonds and raised worries about other heavily indebted euro zone countries. The spread between France and Germany's 10-year note yields reached 177.7 basis points on Thursday, the widest gap since 2011.
Sterling strengthened 0.05 per cent to $1.3401. The Australian dollar  weakened 0.11 per cent to $0.7019.
In cryptocurrencies, bitcoin fell 4.27 per cent to $81,023. 
(Additional reporting by Amanda Cooper and Tom Westbrook; Editing by Xevi Fontdegloria and Andrea Ricci )

items.title: Ecuadorean opposition leader Gonzalez arrested over alleged irregularities in campaign financing
items.author: Alexandra Valencia
items.creator: Alexandra Valencia
items.summary: A prominent leftist politician in Ecuador who was runner-up to President Daniel Noboa in the last two elections has been arrested, the head of her party said on Thursday.
items.body:
A prominent leftist politician in Ecuador who was runner-up to President Daniel Noboa in the last two elections has been arrested, the head of her party said on Thursday.
Luisa Gonzalez, a protege of former socialist President Rafael Correa, is under investigation over alleged irregularities in political financing and campaign spending in the 2023 election.
In a post on X, Gonzalez said the accusation was "absurd" and she asked for unity from members of her party to reach freedom and democracy in Ecuador.
The head of the Citizens' Revolution party, Gabriela Rivadeneira, confirmed the arrest in a social media post and argued it was politically motivated.
"We demand the immediate release of Luisa Gonzalez, who should not have to face a process of persecution and torture imposed by this government," she told reporters.
In a video posted on social media, the Attorney General's Office said the investigation was seeking to clarify the source of the funds used to finance election advertising between May and August 2023.
"A network of legal entities was used to channel approximately $500,000 to contract and purchase campaign advertising. The funds were allegedly channelled without disclosing their source or the identity of those who contributed them,” it said in a video.
Rivadeneira said the 2023 campaign funds were fully accounted for and prior financial penalties imposed by the electoral authority had been paid, echoing earlier statements from Gonzalez.
Former President Correa, who backed Gonzalez's candidacy, also disputed the allegations.
"This is not about legality, or whether the rules are being followed or not. It is brutal and simple persecution," he told a local radio program.
The Ecuadorean Attorney General's Office in a social media post said seven people are under investigation over "inconsistencies in the contributions and the lawful source of the funds" during the 2023 presidential campaign.
Three people so far have been arrested and will face charges for alleged money laundering, it said, without providing their full names.
Gonzalez lost both the 2023 and 2025 elections to Noboa, and alleged fraud in last year's loss. She had attempted to run in local elections set for November 29 but was unable to register her candidacy due to party registration rules.

Oct 22 : The cost of insuring Meta Platforms' debt against default touched an all-time high on Thursday, as investors grappled with concerns about its plan to spend more on its AI build-out.
Meta raised the lower end of its annual forecast for capital expenditure to between $135 billion and $145 billion this year, up from $130 billion to $145 billion expected previously.
As a result, five-year credit default swaps widened 7.6 basis points to a record high of 114.79 bps and were set for its biggest one-day jump since at least 2025, Markit data showed. Its shares were last down 6.1 per cent at $655, hitting their lowest in about six weeks.
Meta also introduced new non-voting shares and reported a free cash flow deficit of $2.12 billion in the third quarter, turning cash flow negative for the first time since 2012.

"The market has been questioning whether all the spending on AI is having the type of returns that the market originally expected," said Steve Sosnick, chief market analyst at Interactive Brokers.
"In Meta's case, investors are interpreting the new non-voting shares as a backdoor for issuing more stock and diluting holdings eventually so I think that's adding to this aggressive selloff."
Investors are growing more cautious about debt-fueled AI spending in the face of rising borrowing costs, with neocloud firm CoreWeave at the center of a storm that has erased more than 34 per cent of its market value this month.
CoreWeave shares slumped 8.4 per cent on Thursday, while rival Nebius Group and data center operators IREN and Applied Digital also saw heavy losses.
US chip stocks, widely viewed as one of the biggest winners of the AI boom, also sold off heavily with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index set to erase more than $688 billion in market value on Thursday alone.
Five-year credit default swaps of hyperscaler Oracle were also close to a record high, while that of Amazon.com held near its highest level since March 2020, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence data.
Oracle and Alphabet shares dropped more than 2 per cent, while Microsoft slipped 1.3 per cent and Amazon fell 3.7 per cent.

items.title: 米新規失業保険申請6000件減の19.4万件、約57年ぶり低水準に迫る
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　２２日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン　２２日　ロイター] - 米労働省が２２日発表した１０月１７日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比６０００件減の１９万４０００件となった。レイオフ（一時解雇）の少なさを背景に、申請件数は１９６９年以来の低水準となった７月中旬の１８万９０００件に迫る水準にある。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２０万件だった。

週ごとの変動をならした４週間移動平均は１０００件減の１９万７７５０件と、１９６９年以来の低水準となった。 

エコノミストらは、堅調な内需を背景に企業収益が伸びていることに加え、退職の増加やトランプ政権による移民取り締まりで労働力人口が縮小していることが、労働者を解雇から守っていると指摘している。ただ、中東紛争の長期化に伴う金融環境の引き締めや金利上昇が、来年の労働市場に悪影響を及ぼす恐れがあるとの懸念もある。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「政権の移民政策により労働市場は逼迫し、企業は財（モノ）・サービスの生産に必要な人手を確保できなくなっているため、既存の労働者を手放さない状況になっている」と指摘。「多くの産業において、突如として労働者が代替不可能な存在となっている」と述べた。

今回の申請件数データは、１０月の雇用統計の調査期間と重なっている。 

１０月１０日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は２万５０００件増の１７２万８０００件となった。 ただ、継続受給件数には、大学を最近卒業した人や、職歴が浅い、または全くないために受給資格がない人は含まれていない。

長期失業者の一部が、大半の州で２６週間に制限されている受給資格を使い果たした可能性もあり、これが継続受給件数が低水準で推移する一因となっている可能性がある。９月の失業期間の中央値は１１．５週と、約４年半ぶりの高水準に近いものの、９月の失業率は４．２％にとどまっており、労働市場がインフレの要因とはなっていない。

ハイ・フリークエンシー・エコノミクスのチーフエコノ ミスト、カール・ワインバーグ氏は「米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、需要を抑制しスラック（需給の緩み）を拡大して、インフレ目標回帰を確実にするために金融引き締めが必要と判断すれば、来週にも自由に利上げに踏み切ることができる」と指摘。「雇用に関するＦＲＢの責務は明らかに満たされている」と述べた。

[ワシントン　２２日　ロイター] - 米労働省が２２日発表した１０月１７日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比６０００件減の１９万４０００件となった。レイオフ（一時解雇）の少なさを背景に、申請件数は１９６９年以来の低水準となった７月中旬の１８万９０００件に迫る水準にある。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２０万件だった。

週ごとの変動をならした４週間移動平均は１０００件減の１９万７７５０件と、１９６９年以来の低水準となった。 

エコノミストらは、堅調な内需を背景に企業収益が伸びていることに加え、退職の増加やトランプ政権による移民取り締まりで労働力人口が縮小していることが、労働者を解雇から守っていると指摘している。ただ、中東紛争の長期化に伴う金融環境の引き締めや金利上昇が、来年の労働市場に悪影響を及ぼす恐れがあるとの懸念もある。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「政権の移民政策により労働市場は逼迫し、企業は財（モノ）・サービスの生産に必要な人手を確保できなくなっているため、既存の労働者を手放さない状況になっている」と指摘。「多くの産業において、突如として労働者が代替不可能な存在となっている」と述べた。

今回の申請件数データは、１０月の雇用統計の調査期間と重なっている。 

１０月１０日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は２万５０００件増の１７２万８０００件となった。 ただ、継続受給件数には、大学を最近卒業した人や、職歴が浅い、または全くないために受給資格がない人は含まれていない。

長期失業者の一部が、大半の州で２６週間に制限されている受給資格を使い果たした可能性もあり、これが継続受給件数が低水準で推移する一因となっている可能性がある。９月の失業期間の中央値は１１．５週と、約４年半ぶりの高水準に近いものの、９月の失業率は４．２％にとどまっており、労働市場がインフレの要因とはなっていない。

ハイ・フリークエンシー・エコノミクスのチーフエコノ ミスト、カール・ワインバーグ氏は「米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、需要を抑制しスラック（需給の緩み）を拡大して、インフレ目標回帰を確実にするために金融引き締めが必要と判断すれば、来週にも自由に利上げに踏み切ることができる」と指摘。「雇用に関するＦＲＢの責務は明らかに満たされている」と述べた。

Oct 22 : Investors betting against US neocloud and data center companies have raked in $6 billion in paper profits so far this month, after fears their debt-fueled AI buildout was becoming unsustainable sparked a selloff. 
Short interest in CoreWeave, IREN, Nebius Group, Applied Digital and Core Scientific ranged from about 20 per cent to 26 per cent of their free float, according to data analytics firm ORTEX.
• Current short interest in CoreWeave stands at 23.7 per cent of its free float, up from 19.6 per cent at the start of the month, but slightly higher than the 22.7 per cent seen at the beginning of 2026
• Short sellers have made close to $1.7 billion in paper profits from CoreWeave trades so far this month, after the company's shares slumped almost 30 per cent

• Short interest on Nebius has climbed to 20 per cent of free float, from 15.4 per cent at the start of 2026
• Investors betting against Nebius have raked in $2.94 billion in paper profits so far in October, though they have recorded a paper loss of $3.33 billion year-to-date
• Short sellers of data center operators IREN and Applied Digital have recorded combined paper profits of more than $1.2 billion so far this month
• Data center firm Core Scientific also had high short interest at 23.1 per cent of its free float, with short sellers clocking $115 million in paper profits in October
• Together, about $17 billion of stock across the five companies is currently sold short and borrowing remains cheap for all of them, ORTEX said
• On Thursday, CoreWeave and Nebius shares fell more than 4 per cent in early trading, while IREN lost 6.1 per cent, Applied Digital shed 3.7 per cent and Core Scientific dipped 2.4 per cent

Oct 22 : IBM shares fell 6.5 per cent in premarket trading on Thursday, as analysts said part of the company's third-quarter software rebound was driven by deals delayed from the previous quarter, raising questions about how sustainable the boost would be.
Here are more details:
• About $250 million of IBM's software growth in the quarter came from deals pushed out of the second quarter, and the improvement was more modest without them, BofA Global Research analysts said
• IBM now expects annual software revenue growth of about 7 per cent to 8 per cent, up from 6 per cent to 8 per cent, but kept its overall revenue growth forecast unchanged

• Third-quarter revenue in IBM's transaction processing unit, which sells software tied to its mainframe computers, grew 9 per cent, though CEO Arvind Krishna said he doesn't expect that pace to continue and sees a more "normalized performance, especially going into next year"
• The rebound follows a decline in the unit in the second quarter, when weakness in IBM's mainframe hardware and transaction processing software cut more than five points from its growth, finance chief James Kavanaugh said at the time
• Bernstein said IBM's forecast suggests sales in the unit will dip slightly in the fourth quarter as the lift from the delayed deals wears off
• The stock had fallen about 15 per cent this year through Wednesday's close, including its steepest one-day drop in over a century in July after CEO Arvind Krishna said IBM had “faltered” in adapting to a shift in customer spending
• If current losses hold, IBM is set to lose more than $15 billion in market value

FAST

Oct 22 : A once-robust fall calendar for technology IPOs is down to just Anthropic. 
The AI lab is pressing ahead to hold its initial public offering as planned in the middle of next month after making its  prospectus public as early as late October, people familiar with the matter said, cautioning the plan and the dates are subject to change. 
Anthropic's planned IPO will test whether its position at the center of the booming AI business, which some investors believe to deem worthy of a potential $1.5 trillion valuation, can overcome a market environment that might typically prompt bankers and deal lawyers to counsel delay. Anthropic is expected to begin marketing its shares to prospective investors during the week of November 9, one of the people said. 
Other companies in the artificial intelligence infrastructure and data center sectors have delayed their listings, facing a rise in interest rates that has helped fuel a punishing selloff in shares and bonds of AI operators such as CoreWeave and broader questions about the sustainability of AI spending.

The contrast underscores Anthropic's appeal to investors even as concerns about competition from open-source models and AI safety weigh on the sector. 
Many  large investors remain bullish on Anthropic’s prospects despite the fall turbulence, viewing the firm as one of the few opportunities to gain exposure to a technology sector that long-term investors cannot afford to ignore. Other issuers are reluctant to compete with Anthropic for institutional investors' attention and capital, two of the people said.
Anthropic declined to comment.
VALUATIONS COMING UNDER PRESSURE
The AI sector pullback follows a string of IPO delays and withdrawals since September, as market volatility and rising interest rates have made it harder for companies to secure attractive valuations.
Switch, a data center operator, and Nscale, an AI infrastructure provider, have pushed their IPO plans back to later this year, people familiar with the matter said, while stressing that plans remain fluid and subject to change. Nscale’s delay was partly driven by the need to address comments from SEC staff, one other person said. SoftBank-backed SB Energy has also postponed its listing, Reuters previously reported.
NScale declined to comment. Switch didn't immediately respond to a request for comment.
South Korean AI chip startup Elice was among the latest to shelve its listing plans overnight. Blackstone-backed AirTrunk REIT and Nvidia-backed Firmus have also pulled or paused their offerings, Reuters has reported.
Oura's recent IPO has added to the caution among prospective issuers. The offering attracted little participation from long-only investors, a person familiar with the matter said, raising concerns about the depth of demand from institutional investors that typically provide a stable base of shareholders for newly listed companies.
SCRUTINY ON MULTIPLE FRONTS
The retreat from AI infrastructure listings reflects growing scrutiny of the enormous capital required to build data centers and whether future demand will justify the investment.
Recent developments involving CoreWeave have added to concerns about a potential slowdown in AI spending, although some market participants do not expect such a downturn to materialize.
Nscale publicly filed its IPO registration statement in September, while Switch submitted its filing confidentially, Reuters reported previously. A confidential filing allows a company to work with regulators on its registration statement before disclosing financial and business details to the public. Companies typically publish the filing ahead of investor roadshows, when they begin marketing shares to prospective investors.

Source: Reuters

WASHINGTON, Oct 22 : The US Commerce Department said on Thursday it plans to award $389 million in research and development funding to four companies working on power semiconductor devices and critical materials to boost technologies like commercial fusion.
As a condition of funding, the US government will receive minority, non-controlling and non-voting equity stakes, the department said.
In recent months, it has awarded 19 R&D grants to semiconductor firms from a $10 billion fund approved by Congress in 2022. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said in a statement the awards will "accelerate American semiconductor innovation to enhance our domestic energy and power resources."
Reuters first reported the new funding. The department said it had signed letters of intent to provide four new awards:

• Washington-based Helion will receive up to $175 million to develop high-voltage power semiconductors and advanced energy power modules in fusion power generation. The semiconductors will power and use energy from magnets driving Helion fusion generators. Helion said the award will be accompanied by $50 million in new private investment funds. "Building fusion power plants at scale requires us to accelerate the development of technologies like semiconductors that are critical to making fusion possible,” said Helion CEO David Kirtley.
• Massachusetts-based Commonwealth Fusion Systems will receive up to $85 million to develop semiconductors for radio-frequency plasma heating, power electronics, fusion diagnostics, and radiation-hardened electronics.
• Commonwealth said the funding will help develop semiconductor technologies for robotic maintenance systems. "These innovations will be a vital part of our global effort to deploy commercial fusion," Commonwealth CEO Bob Mumgaard said.
• Vertical Semiconductor will receive up to $73 million to advance its vertical gallium nitride power semiconductors for use in AI data center racks. The company, a startup spun out of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, said the funding will help accelerate R&D of next-generation power transistors and speed domestic production of this technology to drastically improve efficiency and power density for AI data centers and critical energy infrastructure.
• Sibelco North America will receive up to $56 million to develop next-generation purification for ultra-high-purity quartz used in the semiconductor supply chain. Sibelco North America, part of Belgium parent Sibelco, said the funding for key quartz components in semiconductor manufacturing will be used for next-generation leaching technologies and a demonstration facility to support testing new products in North Carolina. Sibelco CEO Hilmar Rode said announcement "represents a significant step for Sibelco and reflects the importance of high purity quartz within the semiconductor manufacturing supply chain"
