England's Harry Brook smashed the fastest double-century in One-Day International history and became the first Englishman to score 200 in the format but Sri Lanka sealed a two-wicket win in their tri-series clash with one ball to spare on Thursday.
The 27-year-old captain rewrote the record books by racing to his double hundred in 114 balls, surpassing the previous mark of 117 deliveries set by India's Shubman Gill.
In the process, Brook also eclipsed England's highest individual ODI score of 182, held by all-rounder Ben Stokes.
Brook's scintillating performance ended with the final ball of England's innings when he was caught by Sahan Arachchige off the bowling of Janith Liyanage.
He made 202 from 116 deliveries, peppering the Sri Lanka attack with 21 fours and 10 sixes before departing to warm applause from the crowd.
The defeat leaves England bottom of the standings after losing both their matches, with Brook saying they need to win their next two games to reach the final in Lahore.
"Unfortunately, it (the record) doesn't matter now. I thought we were going to be in a good position but, unfortunately, it doesn't even count," Brook said.
"Heart-breaking. I think you've hit the nail on the head there. It's very disappointing that we haven't been able to defend 430, but that's life, that's cricket," he added.
"You don't see many teams chase down 430 and hats off to Sri Lanka. They've played exceptionally well. We couldn't execute our skills enough with the ball and, again, they've just played an absolute blinder there ...
"We'll have a good chat about it now and over the next couple of days. We've got a good opportunity in the next couple of games to really try and get to that final in Lahore."
Joe Root provided strong support with 69 off 66 balls as England piled up 429-4.
But the total proved insufficient as Sri Lanka completed the second-highest successful run chase in ODI history.
Pavan Rathnayake top-scored with 130 from 106 deliveries, while opener Avishka Fernando and Dasun Shanaka both fell three runs short of centuries.
Needing six runs from the final two deliveries, Sri Lanka sealed victory when Liyanage launched Josh Tongue over long-off for six, leaving Brook's record-breaking innings all in vain.
Tongue was England's most successful bowler with 3-79.
England lost by 87 runs at the same venue in Rawalpindi on Tuesday to Pakistan, who lead the table with two wins from two.

items.title: Ebola patient in Nigeria believed to have contracted disease in Uganda, Switzerland says
items.author: The Straits Times
items.summary: DAKAR, Oct 22 - The Ebola patient in Nigeria, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, is believed to have contracted the disease while travelling in Uganda, a Swiss government statement to Reuters said on Thursday.
items.body:
Ebola patient in Nigeria believed to have contracted disease in Uganda, Switzerland says
Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox

Published   Oct 22, 2026, 08:41 PM

Updated   Oct 23, 2026, 03:01 AM

Set as preferred source

Listen

DAKAR, Oct 22 - The Ebola patient in Nigeria, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, is believed to have contracted the disease while travelling in Uganda, a Swiss government statement to Reuters said on Thursday.
Nigeria reported the case, its first Ebola case in more than a decade, on Tuesday, becoming the fourth African country and the most populous yet to be affected by an outbreak that was announced in Democratic Republic of Congo in mid-May and has since become the fastest-spreading on record.
Ugandan authorities have said the woman who fell ill in Nigeria had travelled to eastern Congo before transiting through Uganda. But the World Health Organization and Africa's top health agency said on Thursday they had not received confirmed information that the woman had travelled to Congo.

The woman "has been in a private clinic in Abuja for around a week with symptoms. She is believed to have contracted the virus whilst travelling to Uganda around two weeks ago," said an emailed statement from the Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs.
"Her husband is in isolation; he has not shown any symptoms. He was travelling with his wife when she is believed to have contracted Ebola."
Uganda reported 20 cases in May and June, mostly imported from Congo, but the World Health Organization declared the country Ebola-free in August.

Ugandan government spokesperson Alan Kasujja told Reuters late on Thursday that Uganda had no Ebola cases.
"That's a fact. If we did, as has happened before, we'd be the first to say," he said.
Asked whether the Ugandan government had proof that the woman had travelled to Congo, Kasujja said, "Like what? A passport stamp? Without infringing on the patient’s rights?"

AFRICA CDC, WHO SAY NO INFORMATION THAT PATIENT WENT TO CONGO
Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention official Wessam Mankoula said on Thursday that Nigeria and Uganda were sharing information to establish the patient's movements and possible source of exposure.
"So far, there is no validated information (that) this case traveled to DRC (Democratic Republic of Congo)," Mankoula told an online press conference.
The WHO said information it had received about the case did not include travel outside Uganda.
"The facts which we have received is that the patient returned to Abuja on October 3, being away from September 16 in Uganda," WHO representative to Nigeria Pavel Ursu told the press conference.
Ursu said the focus in Nigeria was now on containing the viral infection and that the patient remained hospitalised, with her biochemical markers improving.
Jean Kaseya, Africa CDC director, told Reuters on Wednesday that the patient had been on a two-week holiday in Uganda.
Patrick Otim, a WHO emergency response manager, said on Thursday the source of her infection was still unknown as health authorities were working to piece together her travel history.
One issue under investigation is which health facilities the woman visited in Abuja after the onset of her symptoms and before her hospitalisation 48 hours later, Otim said.
KENYA TRACES ALL CONTACTS OF FIRST CASE
Separately, a senior Kenyan health official said authorities there had now traced all 135 contacts of the country's first Ebola case, which was confirmed on October 6 and after which a further eight cases have been reported.
"We have been able to account for them 100%," health ministry director-general Patrick Amoth said. He said the last contact to be traced was a Ugandan citizen who had arrived in Kenya in early October on the same flight as the index patient but exited by road via the Namanga border post with Tanzania, which meant it took more time to find him.
Africa CDC is investigating whether the Kenyan case may have come into contact with the patient being treated in Nigeria, as both travelled from Uganda's Entebbe airport on the same day, Mankoula said. Transmission between the two was one of the possible scenarios being examined, he said.
Ebola spreads through direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected people, whether living or dead. The disease can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding.
The rare Ebola species behind the current outbreak kills about half of those infected and has no approved treatment or vaccine.
So far the outbreak is confirmed to have killed about 4,700 people across the four African countries that have reported cases, according to the Africa CDC. REUTERS

items.title: Actor Tom Skerritt, star of 'Alien' and 'Top Gun,' dies at 93
items.summary: Versatile actor Tom Skerritt, who starred in Hollywood megahits including the sci-fi classic "Alien," the war comedy "M*A*S*H," and the action drama "Top Gun," has died at the age of 93, his manager ...
items.body:
Actor Tom Skerritt, star of 'Alien' and 'Top Gun,' dies at 93
Reuters | Updated: 23-10-2026 01:06 IST | Created: 23-10-2026 01:06 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Versatile actor Tom Skerritt, who starred in Hollywood megahits including the sci-fi classic "Alien," the war comedy "M*A*S*H," and the action drama "Top Gun," has died at the age of 93, his manager confirmed.
Skerritt, a Detroit native whose Hollywood career spanned from the 1960s to the 2020s, died on Wednesday of natural causes, said ABC7, citing a statement from his family. Known for his rugged good looks and ability to shine in a variety of genres, Skerritt delivered memorable performances in leading and supporting roles in film and television.
Skerritt's breakthrough role was a roguish US Army surgeon in director Robert Altman's 1970 Korean War black comedy "M*A*S*H," a film whose ensemble cast also included Donald Sutherland, Elliott Gould and Sally Kellerman. Skerritt played Southerner Duke Forrest as the doctors at the Mobile Army Surgical Hospital stitched up wounded troops. The film, whose popularity coincided with American unease over the Vietnam War, was nominated for five Academy Awards.
In director Ridley Scott's claustrophobic 1979 sci-fi horror "Alien", Skerritt played Dallas, the captain of an ill-fated spacecraft whose crew encounters a deadly parasitic extraterrestrial creature with a surrealist look and a bad attitude. In the film's famous and bloody "chestburster" scene, Skerritt's character is seated next to cast mate John Hurt when a baby alien violently exits the torso of Hurt's character. "Alien," an influential masterpiece whose ensemble cast also included Sigourney Weaver and Ian Holm, earned two Oscar nominations.
"It is spontaneity and impulse that make the difference, and that is what I felt we had with 'Alien.' Every one of us had that immediate rapport with each other - the respect that I had for the other actors and the respect that they had for me," Skerritt told interviewer Peter Sobczynski in 2019, while also lauding Scott's directorial brilliance. "Alien" was one of several films in which Skerritt appeared that featured strong female characters, in this case Weaver's courageous character Ripley. That was considered pioneering at the time.
"When I read the script, one of the things that I liked most about it was that the woman becomes the hero. I loved that," Skerritt said. "The sight of women being in positions of strength and fortitude to make the right connections and decisions was what appealed to me. I experienced that as well in 'Steel Magnolias,' with the women in that. I liked the idea of women being tough and strong and influential."
In "Steel Magnolias" (1989), Skerritt played Drum Eatenton, husband of Sally Field's M'Lynn Eatenton. Tony Scott, the brother of the "Alien" director, cast Skerritt in the key supporting role of naval aviation instructor Viper Metcalf in the 1986 blockbuster "Top Gun" that helped star Tom Cruise soar into Hollywood's stratosphere.
Skerritt also played Shirley MacLaine's husband in director Herbert Ross's 1977 ballet drama "The Turning Point," and starred alongside another emerging star in Brad Pitt in Robert Redford's beautifully shot 1992 period drama "A River Runs Through It." Among other films in which he appeared were: "Harold and Maude" (1971), "Ice Castles" (1978), "The Dead Zone" (1983), "Poltergeist III" (1988), "Contact" (1997), "Tears of the Sun" (2003) and "Ted" (2012).
On the small screen, Skerritt starred in the offbeat CBS series "Picket Fences" from 1992 to 1996, playing a Wisconsin town sheriff and claiming an Emmy as outstanding lead actor in a drama series in 1993. Born on August 25, 1933, in Detroit, Skerritt served in the US Air Force before becoming an actor, making his film debut in 1962 alongside a young Redford in "War Hunt." He was a father of five children and was married three times.

Oct 22 : Digital security firm eMudhra is exiting its global business of issuing security certificates for websites including India's tax portal after major browser makers blocked them for vulnerabilities that sparked worldwide cybersecurity concerns.
The company announced its decision on Thursday after technology giants including Google , Apple and Microsoft stopped trusting its SSL/TLS certificates, which encrypt data sent between users and websites to keep hackers from intercepting it.
The vulnerabilities came to light over the weekend, when an independent cybersecurity researcher found several of eMudhra's main certificates could be attacked.
EMudhra's customers range from IT majors Infosys and TCS to government agencies, and its certificates protect sites as important as India's income-tax portal.

"EMudhra's certificates are internationally accepted, and a vulnerability like this has created a trust deficit among the global cybersecurity landscape," said Mredul Sarda, founder of San Francisco-based cybersecurity firm Causal Security.
The vulnerability went undetected for the last 18 months and passed two rounds of audits, eMudhra said in its statement.
The flaws stemmed from eight keys eMudhra generated in April last year that were mistakenly shortened by its software, making them significantly weaker, co-founder Kaushik Srinivasan told Reuters.    
Cryptographic keys are long strings of characters used to encrypt and decrypt data when passed through an algorithm. But eMudhra's keys were small enough to make the encryption easier to break.
"A single compromised certificate authority can impersonate any website," said Lukasz Olejnik, independent consultant and visiting senior researcher at the Department of War Studies at King's College London.
Browsers quickly blocked the compromised certificates but less frequently updated internet-connected devices could remain exposed. "Millions of older devices may remain at risk for years, or forever, because they will still trust those certificates," Olejnik said.
India's Computer Emergency Response Team said on Wednesday some eMudhra intermediate certificates had been compromised.
EMudhra said it had withdrawn eight certificates, but maintained its infrastructure was not compromised and that no data was breached.
Social media attention had brought disproportionate scrutiny to a business that accounts for just 1 per cent of its revenue, the company said.
Investors have reacted sharply, with eMudhra shares down 40 per cent in the two days since the vulnerability was disclosed.

items.title: Tesla drops as spending pullback clouds AI, robotics ambitions
items.author: Reuters Staff
items.summary: Tesla’s shares slid five per cent in premarket trading on Thursday as the EV maker’s reduced capital spending forecast raised questions about the pace of investment behind Elon Musk’s AI, robotics and ...
items.body: Tesla’s shares slid five per cent in premarket trading on Thursday as the EV maker’s reduced capital spending forecast raised questions about the pace of investment behind Elon Musk’s AI, robotics and autonomous-driving ambitions. The company on Wednesday lowered its 2026 capital spending forecast to about US$20 billion from more than $25 billion after spending far less than expected on AI and robotics in the third quarter, which led to a surprise positive free cash flow. The strong position may prove valuable as CEO Musk explores combining Tesla with the far more capital-intensive SpaceX. But “investors are likely to come away with mixed feelings,” J.P.Morgan analysts, led by Rajat Gupta, wrote in a note. “The delay helps near-term cash burn but also suggests delays in investments that matter for fruition of long-term opportunities.” Wednesday’s management commentary suggested spending will be ramped up in 2027 and 2028 as Tesla continues to fund robotaxi, Optimus, AI compute and Terafab milestones, the brokerage said. Tesla’s shares have declined about 14 per cent this year, in contrast to the Nasdaq’s roughly 15 per cent gain. The stock is about 23 per cent below its record intraday high of $498.83, reached in December 2025. Its valuation, however, remains well above peers: Tesla traded at 188.24 times its forward earnings estimates, compared with 6.58 for Ford and 5.16 for General Motors. “The risk is Tesla now enters a period of limbo while investors await news on a potential combination with SpaceX, which ... might face significant regulatory hurdles,” said Russ Mould, investment director at AJ Bell. (Reporting by Joel Jose in Bengaluru; Editing by Joyjeet Das)

items.summary: Somewhat unexpectedly, the global economy has weathered the challenges of the past few years extraordinarily well. Following the pandemic, shock followed shock — Russia’s war on Ukraine, Washington’s rejection of rule-based liberal trade, then most recently the war with Iran. items.title: Yen se dispara por preocupación por el petróleo, la IA y Francia
items.author: Karen Brettell
items.creator: Karen Brettell
items.summary: El yen registró el jueves su mayor subida diaria en casi un mes, porque los inversionistas lo buscaron como refugio ante la inestabilidad de los mercados bursátiles, los altos precios del crudo por la guerra en Oriente Medio y las dudas sobre la rentabilidad futura de la inteligencia artificial (IA).
items.body:
El yen registró el jueves su mayor subida diaria en casi un mes, porque los inversionistas lo buscaron como refugio ante la inestabilidad de los mercados bursátiles, los altos precios del crudo por la guerra en Oriente Medio y las dudas sobre la rentabilidad futura de la inteligencia artificial (IA).
En tanto, el dólar se apreciaba frente al euro, porque la preocupación por los disturbios sociales en Francia y el deterioro de las perspectivas fiscales del país pesaban más que las inquietudes sobre el sector de la IA, que provocaba una caída de las acciones estadounidenses.
"La IA está poniendo nerviosa a la gente, al igual que el petróleo (...) y Francia. Es evidente que hay un ligero grado de aversión al riesgo en el mercado", dijo Chris Scicluna, de Daiwa Capital Markets.
Los precios del petróleo subieron alrededor de un 3%, a un máximo en cinco meses, después de que nuevos ataques hutíes en Arabia Saudita avivaron el temor a una escalada del conflicto en Oriente Medio y a nuevas interrupciones en el suministro.
El yen japonés se apreció un 0,75%, a 156,96 unidades por dólar.
Parte de la evolución del yen también podría deberse a que se está acercando al nivel clave de 160 unidades por dólar, lo que se considera que aumenta la probabilidad de una nueva intervención de las autoridades japonesas para apuntalar la moneda.
El dólar se debilitó un 0,42% frente al franco suizo, otro refugio tradicional, que cotizaba en 0,821 unidades por dólar.
El índice dólar , que mide la cotización de la moneda estadounidense frente a una cesta de seis divisas que incluye al yen y al euro, cayó un 0,08%, a 101,6 unidades, mientras que el euro bajaba un 0,09%, a 1,1222 dólares.
La preocupación sobre la capacidad de Francia para gestionar su enorme deuda ha perjudicado a los bonos del Estado francés y ha avivado el temor por otros países muy endeudados de la zona del euro. El diferencial entre los rendimientos de los bonos a 10 años de Francia y Alemania alcanzó los 177,7 puntos básicos el jueves, la mayor diferencia desde 2011.

items.title: Israeli fire kills four people in Gaza, medics say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Israeli strikes and gunfire killed at least four people in the Gaza Strip in separate incidents on Thursday, health officials in the enclave said.
items.body:
Israeli strikes and gunfire killed at least four people in the Gaza Strip in separate incidents on Thursday, health officials in the enclave said.
In Gaza City, a strike on a car killed at least one person, medics said. They earlier said there had been two deaths. A crowd gathered around the burning wreckage, as orange-vested emergency crews sprayed it with water, photos from the scene showed.
Other strikes killed a Palestinian man on a bike in the southern city of Khan Younis and a man near Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, and gunfire killed a woman near the Jabalia refugee camp, in the north, the medics added.
Israel's military said it had struck Hamas militants in Khan Younis, Nuseirat and Gaza City, but that it was not aware of the reported incident in Jabalia.
The Hamas-led Interior Ministry in Gaza said an Israeli airstrike killed a non-commissioned officer and wounded another officer from the drug control police department after hitting their vehicle while returning from an assignment in Tel al-Hawa neighborhood.
Israel, which says the Hamas militant group has been rearming and launching attacks in violation of [USN:L6N45Q023 TEXT:"a year-old ceasefire"], has stepped up strikes on the group in recent weeks.
Hamas has denied trying to carry out attacks or rebuild its arsenal and accuses Israel of undermining the Gaza peace deal.
Last year's US-brokered ceasefire calls for eventual reconstruction of the territory. But little progress has been made as negotiators have failed to agree terms for Hamas to disarm and Israel to withdraw its troops.
Israeli airstrikes have continued. At least 1,500 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since the ceasefire, according to the territory's health officials, while Israel says four soldiers have been killed.
Palestinian authorities say more than 74,000 people have been killed in Israel's assault on Gaza, launched after Hamas-led fighters killed about 1,200 people in southern Israel on October 7, 2023.

Oct 22 : Meta Platforms shares fell more than 7 per cent on Thursday as investors balked at another increase in its annual AI spending forecast and a plan to sell new stock to help pay for it.
The cost of insuring the social media giant's debt against default also hit an all-time high, the latest sign that fears over the cost of the AI race were spreading to credit markets.
The selloff came despite better-than-expected results and a strong forecast, highlighting growing investor unease over AI spending that is pushing historically cash-rich tech companies to take on debt. That expenditure also pushed the Instagram and Facebook owner to its first cash burn in more than a decade.
Investors have already been on edge this month over the mounting AI debt, dumping shares of neoclouds such as CoreWeave and Nebius that are spending several times their revenue on data centers to serve a growing backlog of orders.

Experts have said that the borrowing binge leaves AI companies vulnerable to any sharp drop in demand while saddling them with chips that depreciate within five or six years, forcing another round of spending to stay competitive.
Meta on Wednesday increased the lower end of its capex forecast range by $5 billion, to a range of $135 billion to $145 billion.
That spending would go towards the company's sweeping plan to put its viral Muse agent at the heart of Meta's AI strategy and turn a technology that has gained traction largely with businesses automating coding into a consumer moneymaker.
To help fund the push, Meta will create a new class of non-voting shares called Class C. The company said it could raise hundreds of billions of dollars over several years to fund AI investments, acquisitions and employee compensation, with issuances beginning as early as fall 2026.
The filing also noted that the issuances helped avoid debt financing which could adversely affect Meta's credit ratings.
On Thursday, Meta's five-year credit default swaps were trading at record highs of 114.79 basis points.
However, Shay Boloor, chief market strategist at Futurum Equities, said the move was not necessarily a sign of deteriorating fundamentals.
The surge in CDS spreads "could have more to do with banks hedging exposure to Meta's massive AI debt financing than actual default risk," he said.
As of Wednesday's close, the stock had gained more than 5 per cent this year. If current losses hold, Meta is set to shed about $114 billion in market value.

By Niket Nishant and Manya Saini
Oct 22 : SoFi Technologies on Thursday launched a "tokenized deposit" product that lets customers earn interest on cash set aside for crypto purchases, while offering protections similar to those of a traditional bank deposit.
Cash held in a SoFi Earn account will generate 4.4 per cent annual interest and be insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, which protects eligible deposits of up to $250,000 per depositor if a bank fails.

"Too much money in the digital asset ecosystem is sitting idle, leaving massive potential earnings on the table for millions of people," SoFi CEO Anthony Noto told Reuters.
The product moves SoFi into a space historically dominated by non-bank crypto firms. In recent years, funds earmarked for crypto trading were often parked in interest-bearing stablecoins, giving investors a way to earn yield while keeping money ready to deploy.
That model has come under pressure after the GENIUS Act, signed last year, barred stablecoin issuers from paying interest, creating an opening for banks to offer regulated, interest-bearing alternatives through products such as tokenized deposits.
SoFi Earn will also let users buy crypto directly or transfer funds to another platform.
"The primary opportunity is with people who already participate in crypto and want that money to keep working and ready to move," Noto said.
Traditional financial institutions are developing products to tap the crypto market, arguing that bank-issued alternatives offer greater regulatory oversight than stablecoins issued by non-bank entities.
In September, a group of 21 financial institutions including Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Citi and Deutsche Bank, said they planned to create a company this year to issue a dollar-pegged cryptocurrency in the first half of 2027.
"Over the next year or so, you're going to see an inflection point. It is a big effort to move traditional finance on chain, but I think the economic drivers are just so powerful that it's inevitable," said Sam MacPherson, CEO at digital asset finance firm Spark.

items.title: Barril toca máximos de cinco meses ya que ataques de hutíes generan temores por suministro
items.author: Scott Disavino
items.creator: Scott Disavino
items.summary: Los precios del petróleo subían el jueves alrededor de un 3%, a un máximo de cinco meses, luego de que ataques de los hutíes en Arabia Saudita avivaron la preocupación por posibles nuevas interrupciones en el suministro de energía.
items.body:
Los precios del petróleo subían el jueves alrededor de un 3%, a un máximo de cinco meses, luego de que ataques de los hutíes en Arabia Saudita avivaron la preocupación por posibles nuevas interrupciones en el suministro de energía.
* Los futuros del crudo Brent trepaban 3,51 dólares, o un 3,2%, a 112,33 dólares por barril, a las 1705 GMT, mientras que el crudo estadounidense West Texas Intermediate (WTI) sumaba 2,14 dólares, o un 2,2%, a 99,29 dólares.
* Esto llevó al Brent a entrar en terreno de sobrecompra técnica por tercera vez en una semana, situando al contrato en camino a su cierre más alto desde el 4 de mayo.
* Saudi Aramco ordenó al personal evacuar su sede en Dhahran, en el golfo Pérsico, cerca de Baréin, reportó Reuters, a medida que se intensificaban los combates entre el mayor exportador de crudo del mundo y los hutíes de Yemen.
* Los enfrentamientos entre los hutíes y una coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita, que respalda al gobierno de Yemen reconocido internacionalmente, se han recrudecido desde que el grupo alineado con Irán avanzó hacia el estrecho de Mandeb, un punto crítico para la navegación situado en la entrada del mar Rojo.
* "Los informes que indican que las exportaciones de crudo de Oriente Medio superan los niveles previos al conflicto quedan más que compensados por los ataques a buques en el estrecho de Ormuz y las ofensivas hutíes contra Arabia Saudita y su infraestructura petrolera", dijo Tamas Varga, analista de PVM Oil.
* Los analistas de Morgan Stanley estimaron en una nota que las exportaciones de crudo de Oriente Medio rondaron los 17 millones de barriles por día la semana pasada. Según datos de Kpler, en los 12 meses anteriores al inicio del conflicto, las exportaciones de crudo de la región promediaron cerca de 18 millones de barriles diarios.
* En Estados Unidos, la refinería Valero Energy registró el mayor beneficio trimestral de su historia, superando las expectativas de Wall Street, ya que las interrupciones derivadas del conflicto en Oriente Medio provocaron un fuerte aumento en los márgenes de refinado durante el tercer trimestre.

items.title: India overcome New Zealand fightback to win T20 opener
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: India overcame a spirited New Zealand fightback after a blazing start to secure a thrilling four-wicket victory in Christchurch on Thursday and take a 1-0 lead in the five-match T20 series.
items.body:
India overcame a spirited New Zealand fightback after a blazing start to secure a thrilling four-wicket victory in Christchurch on Thursday and take a 1-0 lead in the five-match T20 series.
India survived a mid-innings wobble in a 226-run chase after openers Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma laid the platform, with Shreyas Iyer's contribution reviving the chase and Naman Dhir applying the finishing touches to seal victory in 19.4 overs.
"When they (openers) click, they set up the game for us and the rest of us try to steady the ship and finish," India captain Iyer said. "He (Dhir) gives us lots of options. I personally feel the calm and composed nature he showed tonight, it was magnificent."
Put in to bat, New Zealand made the most of favourable conditions as openers Tim Seifert and Finn Allen set the tone before Glenn Phillips produced a dazzling knock to propel the hosts to 225-4.
The total was New Zealand's biggest T20 score against India on home soil, but the visitors completed their highest-ever successful run chase despite a stuttering middle phase.
Samson and Abhishek stitched together a 93-run opening stand, with Samson hammering 67 off 33 balls, including eight fours and four sixes, as India surged to 94-1 in the powerplay.
New Zealand hit back by removing three batters in quick succession, but Iyer countered with 42 off 28 balls to wrest back the momentum, before a late flourish from Dhir (42 not out)took India over the line.
"They (India openers) put us under pressure. Another big powerplay from them. We were not at our best," New Zealand captain Mitchell Santner said.
"In the middle, we did well to squeeze them. Tight game and both teams might look at things that could have gone here or there."
Seifert and Allen had earlier given New Zealand a solid platform, helping the hosts reach 65-1 in the powerplay, with Allen blasting 45 off 24 balls.
Phillips then took charge, producing an unbeaten 82 off 40 deliveries, including eight fours and three sixes, while Bevon Jacobs added 31 before being run out.
India's bowlers struggled to contain the scoring, with all five used going at 10 runs an over or more.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar, playing his first T20 international in four years after last featuring against New Zealand in 2022, endured an expensive return with figures of 0-49.
The second T20 will be played on Saturday in Christchurch.

items.title: Rifts emerge in Libya as eastern parliament backs central bank chief's resignation
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A new contest for control of the central bank in divided Libya could emerge after the eastern-based parliament said on Thursday it approved in principle the resignation of its governor, Naji Issa, and backed a member of the bank's board to replace him on an interim basis.
items.body:
A new contest for control of the central bank in divided Libya could emerge after the eastern-based parliament said on Thursday it approved in principle the resignation of its governor, Naji Issa, and backed a member of the bank's board to replace him on an interim basis.
The House of Representatives's (HoR) spokesperson said parliament backed Fowzi Musbah Abukhzam, the board member, to temporarily fill the role at the central bank.
In the western half of the North African country, however, Naji Mukhtar Ali, the first deputy of the High Council of State (HCS), rejected Issa's resignation and told him to stay in his post.
Yet the head of HCS, Mohamed Takala, contradicted his first deputy's position, and called on Abukhzam to carry on his duties on an interim basis, in line with the HoR decision, underlining some rifts even among the main Libyan factions.
"You are requested to assume your duties and carry out the functions of the Governor of the Central Bank of Libya on an interim basis, pending an agreement with the House of Representatives on the appointment of a Governor for the Central Bank," Takala said in a letter to Abukhzam, which was viewed by Reuters and confirmed by a person at the HCS.
The eastern parliament will discuss Issa's resignation in a coming session, its spokesperson wrote on X.
In August, Issa submitted his resignation to the two legislative chambers, saying he could not continue in his post but without explaining why, according to two documents seen by Reuters at the time.
DIVIDED COUNTRY Libya has been split since 2014 into rival authorities in the west and east that emerged from the turmoil following the fall of Muammar Gaddafi in a NATO-backed uprising in 2011. It is now run by the eastern-based HoR, which was elected in 2014, and the western-based HCS, whose members were drawn from a parliament elected in 2012.
After Issa submitted his resignation, both chambers had said he should stay in the position until the issue was discussed.
In reaction to Thursday's decision by the eastern parliament, Ali, the HCS first deputy in the west, rejected what he called "the unilateral measures taken by the presidency of the House of Representatives."
"You are requested to continue performing your tasks," Ali told Issa in a letter seen by Reuters that was confirmed by a central bank official and an HCS source.
Issa took up the post in 2024 when the two legislative chambers agreed on his appointment as a way to end a stand off over control of the central bank.
Separately, the central bank said in a statement on its verified Facebook page that it condemned the forced entry of people into its headquarters, violating the governor’s office in his absence.
It did not explain the incident, but it said it holds all those involved responsible for any consequences, "foremost among them the Ministry of Defence, given its responsibility for protecting and securing the bank’s headquarters."
In a separate incident, masked men tried to [USN:L1N4670MR TEXT:"storm the country's financial oversight agency"] on Wednesday, in what Libya's UN mission called an "unacceptable" attempt to install a senior employee by force.

items.title: ＰＨＰ脆弱性、世界で修正急ぐ　攻撃試行は数百万件に
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京／北京 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[東京／北京 ２２日 ロイター] - 世界各国の企業や政府は２２日、広く利用されているプログラミング言語「ＰＨＰ」で見つかった重大な脆弱性の修正を急いだ。サイバーセキュリティー企業によると、脆弱性の公表後に確認されたハッキングの試みは数百万件に及ぶ。

前日の２１日には、ウェブサイト運営者がＰＨＰを使うシステムの安全確保に追われる中、欧州などの政府が予防措置としてウェブサイトを停止した。ＰＨＰの開発者は、人工知能（ＡＩ）によって発見されるまで何年も潜んでいた脆弱性の緊急修正プログラムを公開、利用者に「直ちに更新する」よう呼びかけた。

世界各国で銀行、航空、鉄道、税務、行政のサービスが緊急停止し、公共・企業システムのＰＨＰへの依存度の高さと、脆弱性が明らかになった後に迅速に修正する難しさを示した。

マイクロソフトのサティア・ナデラ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２２日、ドイツのケルンで開いた同社のイベントで「ＩＴやセキュリティーに携わる全ての人にとって、長い一日、長い夜だったと思う。これほどの事態は長らく見たことがない」と語った。

今回の事態は、安全に保守が可能なデジタルシステム構築の重要性を浮き彫りにしたと述べた。

ベルギーのサイバーセキュリティー企業アイキドウ ・セキュリティーの共同創業者、マデリン・ローレンス氏は「修正プログラムの準備が整う前に脆弱性の詳細が公になり、攻撃が報告されている」と説明。「攻撃に備え企業は更新を急いでいる。まさに時間との競争だ」と語った。

クラウドサービス企業クラウドフレアによると、企業や政府が修正プログラムを適用し、予防措置としてウェブサイトを停止する中、ハッキングの試みは数百万件に急増した。

同社のマシュー・プリンスＣＥＯは２１日夜、「公表前の１０時間に、当社のネットワーク全体で脆弱性を悪用しようとする試みを数千件確認した」とＸに投稿。「公表後４５分で数万件、２時間以内に数十万件に跳ね上がり、今では数百万件に達している」とした。

日本では野村ホールディングス、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ、ＡＮＡホールディングス、ＪＲ東日本などが２２日、緊急措置の一環として一部のインターネットサービスを一時停止すると発表した。

東京海上ホールディングスは、グループ会社のウェブサイトを停止したと明らかにした。

財務省と気象庁は安全対策を実施するためオンラインサービスを一部停止し、国税庁もサービスを一時停止した。

予防的な停止措置は、日本でサイバーセキュリティーへの懸念が高まっていることを示している。トレンドＡＩのデータによると、２０２６年１─９月に日本で記録されたサイバーインシデントの件数は、２５年通年を上回った。

フランスの通信大手オレンジは、予防措置として、複数の子会社でＰＨＰを使う一部のウェブサイトやアプリケーションへのアクセスを一時停止したと説明した。

中国のクラウドサービス大手テンセントクラウドは、更新版のＰＨＰを導入するよう顧客に呼びかけたが、広範なウェブサイト停止を求めるには至らなかった。

フィンランドの政府ＩＴサービス機関バルトリは、前日に政府の一般向けウェブサービスを停止した後、夜間もＰＨＰのセキュリティー修正プログラムの適用を続け、予防的なサービス停止を段階的に解除していると説明した。「更新に加えてシステムを慎重にテストする必要があるため、サービスの復旧には数日、場合によっては数週間かかる可能性がある」と声明で述べた。

同機関は、サービス停止は脆弱性の悪用やサイバー侵害によるものではなく、脆弱性が実際に悪用された事例も把握していないと説明した。

アジアの複数の政府は２２日、ＰＨＰの脆弱性に関連するサイバーセキュリティー点検を指示した。

中国の工業情報省は、組織や利用者にシステムを直ちに点検し、安全性が確保された最新のＰＨＰに更新するよう呼びかけた。また、サイバーセキュリティー監視を強化し、必要に応じてアカウント、パスワード、鍵（キー） を変更するよう勧告した。

韓国はハッキング攻撃のリスク増大への懸念を理由に、民間部門のサイバーセキュリティー警戒レベルを引き上げ、緊急対応措置を発動した。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京／北京 ２２日 ロイター] - 世界各国の企業や政府は２２日、広く利用されているプログラミング言語「ＰＨＰ」で見つ...
items.body:
ＰＨＰ脆弱性、世界で修正急ぐ　攻撃試行は数百万件に
10/22 20:42 配信

英機関によるＰＨＰの脆弱性への警告、22日撮影 REUTERS/Toby Melville

[東京／北京 ２２日 ロイター] - 世界各国の企業や政府は２２日、広く利用されているプログラミング言語「ＰＨＰ」で見つかった重大な脆弱性の修正を急いだ。サイバーセキュリティー企業によると、脆弱性の公表後に確認されたハッキングの試みは数百万件に及ぶ。

前日の２１日には、ウェブサイト運営者がＰＨＰを使うシステムの安全確保に追われる中、欧州などの政府が予防措置としてウェブサイトを停止した。ＰＨＰの開発者は、人工知能（ＡＩ）によって発見されるまで何年も潜んでいた脆弱性の緊急修正プログラムを公開、利用者に「直ちに更新する」よう呼びかけた。

世界各国で銀行、航空、鉄道、税務、行政のサービスが緊急停止し、公共・企業システムのＰＨＰへの依存度の高さと、脆弱性が明らかになった後に迅速に修正する難しさを示した。

マイクロソフトのサティア・ナデラ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２２日、ドイツのケルンで開いた同社のイベントで「ＩＴやセキュリティーに携わる全ての人にとって、長い一日、長い夜だったと思う。これほどの事態は長らく見たことがない」と語った。

今回の事態は、安全に保守が可能なデジタルシステム構築の重要性を浮き彫りにしたと述べた。

ベルギーのサイバーセキュリティー企業アイキドウ ・セキュリティーの共同創業者、マデリン・ローレンス氏は「修正プログラムの準備が整う前に脆弱性の詳細が公になり、攻撃が報告されている」と説明。「攻撃に備え企業は更新を急いでいる。まさに時間との競争だ」と語った。

クラウドサービス企業クラウドフレアによると、企業や政府が修正プログラムを適用し、予防措置としてウェブサイトを停止する中、ハッキングの試みは数百万件に急増した。

同社のマシュー・プリンスＣＥＯは２１日夜、「公表前の１０時間に、当社のネットワーク全体で脆弱性を悪用しようとする試みを数千件確認した」とＸに投稿。「公表後４５分で数万件、２時間以内に数十万件に跳ね上がり、今では数百万件に達している」とした。

日本では野村ホールディングス、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ、ＡＮＡホールディングス、ＪＲ東日本などが２２日、緊急措置の一環として一部のインターネットサービスを一時停止すると発表した。

東京海上ホールディングスは、グループ会社のウェブサイトを停止したと明らかにした。

財務省と気象庁は安全対策を実施するためオンラインサービスを一部停止し、国税庁もサービスを一時停止した。

予防的な停止措置は、日本でサイバーセキュリティーへの懸念が高まっていることを示している。トレンドＡＩのデータによると、２０２６年１─９月に日本で記録されたサイバーインシデントの件数は、２５年通年を上回った。

フランスの通信大手オレンジは、予防措置として、複数の子会社でＰＨＰを使う一部のウェブサイトやアプリケーションへのアクセスを一時停止したと説明した。

中国のクラウドサービス大手テンセントクラウドは、更新版のＰＨＰを導入するよう顧客に呼びかけたが、広範なウェブサイト停止を求めるには至らなかった。

フィンランドの政府ＩＴサービス機関バルトリは、前日に政府の一般向けウェブサービスを停止した後、夜間もＰＨＰのセキュリティー修正プログラムの適用を続け、予防的なサービス停止を段階的に解除していると説明した。「更新に加えてシステムを慎重にテストする必要があるため、サービスの復旧には数日、場合によっては数週間かかる可能性がある」と声明で述べた。

同機関は、サービス停止は脆弱性の悪用やサイバー侵害によるものではなく、脆弱性が実際に悪用された事例も把握していないと説明した。

アジアの複数の政府は２２日、ＰＨＰの脆弱性に関連するサイバーセキュリティー点検を指示した。

中国の工業情報省は、組織や利用者にシステムを直ちに点検し、安全性が確保された最新のＰＨＰに更新するよう呼びかけた。また、サイバーセキュリティー監視を強化し、必要に応じてアカウント、パスワード、鍵（キー） を変更するよう勧告した。

韓国はハッキング攻撃のリスク増大への懸念を理由に、民間部門のサイバーセキュリティー警戒レベルを引き上げ、緊急対応措置を発動した。

Oct 22 : Quest Diagnostics on Thursday said it learned of unauthorized access to its Quanum LSM system, which some clients use to place test orders, receive and look up results.
The breach adds to a growing number of cyberattacks on the healthcare sector, including those on medical device makers Abbott, Stryker, Medtronic and Boston Scientific. Drugmaker Novo Nordisk and drug-delivery equipment supplier West Pharmaceutical Services have also faced threats.
• While the full scope of unauthorized access remains under investigation, at this time Quest believes that an unauthorized party accessed certain patient records
• The company disclosed in a regulatory filing that it learned of the incident on Wednesday and has notified federal law enforcement authorities and initiated cybersecurity incident response procedures

items.title: France's Macron tightens curbs on protests, blaming hard left for unrest
items.author: Michel Rose
items.creator: Michel Rose
items.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that "illegitimate" protests would be banned in the coming days and blamed "seditious" ultra-left groups and vandals for last weekend's riots and looting.
items.body:
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that "illegitimate" protests would be banned in the coming days and blamed "seditious" ultra-left groups and vandals for last weekend's [USN:L6N4660DJ TEXT:"riots and looting"].
Speaking after a meeting with intelligence chiefs and senior ministers, [USN:L6N4650JF TEXT:"Macron"] said demonstrations organised by groups such as trade unions would be allowed to go ahead but could be diverted along alternative routes to protect businesses.
"Last Saturday we had political and seditious acts by ultra-left groups whose aim is to bring down the Republic," he said.
His comments came as authorities across France prepared for fresh protests following some of the country's [USN:L1N4670D4 TEXT:"worst urban unrest in years"].
Justice Minister Gerald Darmanin said he wanted voting rights suspended for people who defy bans on taking part in demonstrations, and restrictions on social media access for people involved in violence, looting or attacks on police.
All protests planned for Saturday in Marseille and Lyon, France's second- and third-largest cities, have been banned, local authorities said. Yet [USN:L1N46608H TEXT:"fresh demonstrations"] are already taking shape before what officials fear could be another volatile weekend.
France's main student union, UNEF, has called for rallies on Saturday, while the Yellow Vest movement, the anti-establishment force that emerged in 2018, has filed plans for a march through central Paris.
Businesses in central Paris have begun boarding up their shop windows in case of violence. Luxury goods group Hermes said [USN:S8N3Z600A TEXT:"it had stepped up security measures"] at its French stores.
Organisers of the Art Basel Paris international art collectors fair being held in a central Paris exhibition hall said it would be closed all weekend.
Elsewhere, authorities in the northern city of Orleans were bracing for potential unrest as the far-right National Rally was due to hold an annual meeting and unions and left-wing groups planned demonstrations.
A student protest called for Thursday in Paris was initially banned but eventually allowed to go ahead, though metro stations in central Paris were nonetheless shuttered by transit authorities in anticipation of unauthorised gatherings.
PUBLIC ANGER France was rocked on October 17 by violence on the fringes of nationwide protests, exposing the depth of public anger and raising questions about the security services' ability to keep order.
Two people have been arrested over an arson attack on Limoges city hall, French officials and media said.
A third consecutive night of local curfews passed without major incidents in areas affected by the violence, offering the government some respite ahead of the weekend.
The unrest has laid bare a deeper malaise in France, where soaring energy costs, pressure on household budgets and concerns over deteriorating public services have fuelled growing frustration among workers and younger people.
The French political class has also descended into a bitter blame game, with the government accusing [USN:L6N4670XJ TEXT:"far-left"] political groups of stoking the unrest.
Highlighting investor unease, the [USN:L6N46814J TEXT:"risk premium"] on French government debt over safe-haven German bonds widened to its highest in 15 years on Thursday, while France's benchmark 10-year bond yield hit 5.14%, its highest level since July 2002.

items.title: ロシアとウクライナ攻撃応酬、ゼレンスキー氏「ロシアはクラスター弾頭使用」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Olena Harmash　Gleb Bryanski

[キーウ／モスクワ ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Olena Harmash　Gleb Bryanski

[キーウ／モスクワ ２２日 ロイター] - ロシアは２２日未明にかけてキーウを弾道ミサイルで激しく攻撃し、ウクライナはモスクワに向けて数百機の無人機（ドローン）を飛ばした。米国が戦争終結に向けて新たな働きかけを行っているが、両国は攻撃の応酬を続けている。

ウクライナ側は、ロシアが３波にわたり少なくとも２１発の弾道ミサイルを発射したと発表した。ロシア側は、ウクライナが夜間に首都モスクワに向けて無人機６３０機を発射したとしている。 

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアがクラスター弾頭を搭載した弾道ミサイル３発で首都キーウを攻撃したと明らかにした。ゼレンスキー氏によると、こうしたミサイルは目標に接近すると空中で爆発し、直径約４００メートルの範囲に被害を及ぼすよう設計されている。１発がキーウの歴史地区に着弾し、世界遺産「キーウ・ペチェールシク大修道院」の修道院近くが直撃を受けたという。

ベラルーシの国営ベルタ通信によると、双方は戦死者の遺体を交換し、ロシアが２５２人、ウクライナが２５人の遺体を引き渡した。

米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使は今週、ノルウェーの首都オスロでゼレンスキー氏のほか、欧州、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の当局者と会談した後、ロシアのプーチン大統領とサンクトペテルブルクで会談した。

ロシアのウシャコフ大統領補佐官は「米国側は（オスロで）いくつかの新たな変化を感じ取り、われわれに伝えた。しかし、そうした変化はわれわれが十分に満足できるものではない」と述べた。

プーチン氏とウィットコフ氏の会談結果について説明を受けたロシア高官によると、会談は比較的短く、踏み込んだ議論はなかった。ウィットコフ氏はオスロでまとめた一連の提案をプーチン氏に手渡し、検討するよう求めたという。

ロシア大統領府に近い別の関係者によると、米国の提案には、ウクライナがドンバス地域全域をロシアに割譲する見返りに、ＮＡＴＯから将来の安全の保証を受ける案が含まれていた。

＜米特使「プーチン氏は人道主義者」と称賛、ウクライナは反発＞

ゼレンスキー氏は２２日、ウィットコフ氏がロシア訪問中にプーチン氏を「人道主義者」とたたえたことに反発した。ウィットコフ氏は、ウクライナでロシア軍に拘束されていた７４歳の米国人の解放について、プーチン氏に謝意を示していた。 

ゼレンスキー氏はＸに「昨夜以降、ロシアの『人道主義者たち』がキーウに３波にわたって弾道ミサイルを発射した」と投稿した。「２１発のミサイルが使われた。残念ながら市内の多数の場所が被弾し、被害を受けた」と述べた。ウクライナの１０以上の地域が攻撃され、２人が死亡、子ども５人を含む３４人が負傷したと明らかにした。   

ゼレンスキー氏は、ロシアは引き続きウクライナのエネルギーインフラを標的にしており、１１日以降、重要なエネルギー施設に対する攻撃が１７０件を超えたとしている。

ロシアはオデーサ州の港湾インフラとウクライナ軍が使用する船舶に対し、夜間に「大規模攻撃」を実施したと発表した。

ロシアでは、ウクライナのドローンによりモスクワ近郊で２人が負傷したと、ソビャニン市長が通信アプリ「テレグラム」で明らかにした。ドローンの大半は遠方で撃墜されたという。

ウクライナと国境を接するベルゴロド州では、ウクライナのドローン攻撃で男性１人が死亡、別の１人が負傷したと地元当局者が明らかにした。

items.title: Melanie Paradis: Streamlining mines is good, but Ottawa needs a plan to finance them
items.summary: Political analyst and communications expert Melanie Paradis warns that the federal government’s new fast-track regulatory bill will not be enough to spark a new resources boom, unless Ottawa actively ...
items.body:
Melanie Paradis is the president of Texture Communications and has worked at the intersection of mining and politics for 20 years.
There is a tendency in Ottawa to think that if you permit a mine, the capital will flow. But those working in the mining industry and on Bay Street know it isn’t that simple.

This week, Energy and Natural Resources Minister Tim Hodgson said the world is entering the “largest investment supercycle in the history of the metals and mining industry.” A supercycle refers to a long period of investment in new mines driven by significant shifts in the global economy.
According to Hodgson, this supercycle is tied to increased demand for critical minerals generated by changes to the industrial strategies and economic policies of many countries.
To leverage this, the federal government introduced Bill C-39 , the Building Canada Strong Act , to compress into one year a federal approvals process that routinely takes several. But while government policy decides which projects are permitted, prices decide which ones get built. When the two line up, Canada builds mines. When they don’t, no amount of legislative reform fills the gap.
To actually build Canada strong, C-39 must be the first step in a countercyclical industrial strategy for mining that would accelerate viable projects today, build the infrastructure tomorrow’s mines will need, and work with allies to make strategically important minerals financeable even when markets are manipulated.
Let’s start with the last time a government bet on regulatory reform.
In 2012, Stephen Harper’s government overhauled federal environmental assessments to speed up resource development, just as the last commodity supercycle was ending. Mineral exploration spending in Canada fell from about $4.2 billion in 2011 to $1.6 billion in 2016. The new rules were designed to be faster, but the regulatory reform alone could not reverse the collapse in investment.
The capital hurdle Today’s federal government must learn from that experience that while C-39 can make a mine permittable, it can’t attract investors to the mine with a permit alone. The reverse is also true. Government would also be wise not to spurn financeable mines with an overly narrow definition of “national interest.” Gold is a good example. According to the Scotia Growth Institute , gold now accounts for 46 per cent of the value of Canada’s 10 largest mining commodities, up from just 24 per cent three years ago.
Gold projects have and will continue to advance in response to market demand, and for that reason they tend to fly under the notice of governments. But treating gold as an afterthought because it doesn’t fit the critical minerals narrative would be a mistake.
A gold mine that opens in 2028 trains a workforce and builds the roads and power lines that the next critical-minerals project will be able to leverage. It also proves to investors that Canada can take a deposit from discovery to production.
When prices for other commodities recover, that track record will let Canadian critical minerals projects raise capital quickly. It’s therefore in the national interest for viable mines that don’t meet the definition of “critical minerals,” like gold, to be opened.
Beijing’s market chokehold Some critical minerals are not as easily financed in the current market, and many of Canada’s biggest deposits sit in feasibility purgatory despite the government’s desire to see them advance. And this is not by accident. Beijing floods the market to drive down prices, which starves Western projects of capital so they don’t get built, securing China’s grip on vital supply chains.
A U.S. congressional select committee has documented this predatory pricing, and Washington is now pursuing agreements to establish a trade zone for critical minerals with tariffs and price floors to help build supply chains within allied countries. Because of ongoing trade negotiations with the U.S., Canada has not yet committed to that plan.
The job of government is to invest in readiness during the lean years so that when prices align, projects are permitted, financed and ready to build. C-39 offers a tool for that. Its proposed Regions of National Interest could streamline federal approvals inside a designated mining district, for example. The time to designate those regions with provinces and Indigenous partners is now; we should build the roads and power lines that will make future mines less expensive to develop.
Laying that foundation also means treating the national-interest list as a floor, not a ceiling. The projects on the list deserve the attention they’re getting, but the same speed should be available to every viable mine. And where the government invests its own money, it should strategically serve as a counterweight to market manipulation.
Taken together, these steps would form the foundation of a countercyclical industrial strategy for mining to ensure we are ready for the mining supercycle, Hodgson says, is just beginning.

AMSTERDAM, Oct 22 : AI cloud services firm Nebius on Thursday said it had secured a $3.5 billion financing facility from Citi to fund continued development of its data centres and GPU purchases as it races to expand capacity.
The announcement comes against the backdrop of a selloff in shares last week related to AI infrastructure, after bonds issued by rival CoreWeave fell sharply in value. CoreWeave is usually grouped with Nebius as among the top "neocloud" firms that are building data centres specialized for AI.
The new Nebius facility matures in 364 days and carries an initial interest rate of 2.75 per cent over the term SOFR benchmark rate.
The Amsterdam-based company said the financing would give it greater flexibility over the timing and structure of further fundraising to support growth in 2027 and beyond. Its funding sources also include customer prepayments and operating cash flow.
Chief Operating Officer Ophir Nave said Nebius had other financing options available, including borrowing against more than $40 billion in long-term contracts with investment-grade customers, which include Microsoft and Meta .
"This facility provides additional financing to support our near-term capacity build-out," Nave said in a statement. The company has around $10 billion in convertible bond debt outstanding following a $5.75 billion issue in August.

Source: Reuters

Oct 22 : Comcast on Thursday flagged more than $1 billion in charges for the fourth quarter as it changes its organizational structure, ahead of the planned spinoff of its NBCUniversal business in mid-2027.
The company lost more broadband customers than expected in the third quarter as fierce competition chipped away at its core business, while NBCUniversal benefited from gains in theatrical and streaming.
Shares of the company were up 3 per cent in early trading.

• The media division posted a 13 per cent increase in third-quarter revenue to $5.36 billion, driven by soccer World Cup programming and "Love Island USA" on Peacock
• Peacock reported a quarterly pre-tax profit of $261 million, compared with a $217 million loss a year ago
• NBCUniversal's theme park unit is seeing weaker demand in Orlando, while geopolitical tensions continue to deter Chinese tourists from visiting its parks in Japan, which is a major market
• The segment reported a 4.4 per cent decline in revenue to $2.60 billion, missing analysts' average estimate of $2.71 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG

India on Thursday said it was ascertaining details of an incident involving 14 Indian nationals on board a yacht off the coast of Yemen, assuring all possible assistance to ensure their safety and well-being. The statement followed claims by Yemen's Houthis that their forces had launched a rescue operation after what they described as a Saudi attack on the vessel.
"We have seen reports regarding an incident involving 14 Indian nationals on board a yacht off the coast of Yemen today. We are ascertaining further details about the incident and will provide all possible help for ensuring the safety and well-being of the Indian nationals," the Embassy of India in Yemen posted on X. Earlier in the day, Yemen's Houthis alleged that Saudi Arabia had targeted an Indian yacht carrying 14 Indian nationals near Zuqar Island in the southern Red Sea, following which their forces initiated a rescue operation.
Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree, citing preliminary information, stated that the Yemeni Armed Forces would share further details as they became available. "The Saudi enemy is targeting an Indian yacht near Zuqar Island, carrying 14 people of Indian nationality, according to preliminary information. The Yemeni Armed Forces are rescuing them and will provide more details later. This reckless act by the Saudi enemy in targeting it threatens international navigation in the Red Sea, and the international community must stop the Saudi enemy from these reckless actions," Saree had posted on X.
The latest development comes a day after an attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, killed two people, including an Indian national, while two other Indian nationals sustained injuries, according to the Indian Embassy in Riyadh. India has also strongly condemned the continued attacks on civilian and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, including the strikes on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam and Saudi Aramco's Shaybah oil field. New Delhi also expressed hope for an early restoration of peace and normalcy in the region.
"We strongly condemn the continued attacks on civilian and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, including the attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam and Saudi Aramco's Shaybah oil field in the Eastern Province on October 21. These attacks have unfortunately resulted in civilian deaths and injuries," the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said in a statement. Meanwhile, Yemen's Houthis have accused Saudi forces of carrying out air and missile strikes across several Yemeni provinces this week. (ANI)

items.title: França relata primeiro caso humano do vírus Shamonda após morte de paciente
items.author: Sybille de La Hamaide, Gus Trompiz
items.creator: Sybille de La Hamaide, Gus Trompiz
items.summary: A França relatou nesta quinta-feira o primeiro caso humano do vírus Shamonda, normalmente encontrado em animais de criação, em um paciente que morreu no hospital, embora autoridades tenham afirmado que não há risco para a população em geral.
items.body:
A França relatou nesta quinta-feira o primeiro caso humano do vírus Shamonda, normalmente encontrado em animais de criação, em um paciente que morreu no hospital, embora autoridades tenham afirmado que não há risco para a população em geral.
O homem estava hospitalizado em Lyon devido a uma doença grave não relacionada, informou um representante do Ministério da Saúde da França a jornalistas.
A vítima tinha cerca de 60 anos e morava na região de Lyon, noticiou o jornal local Le Progrès.
A Organização Mundial da Saúde (OMS) informou que está em contato com as autoridades francesas a respeito do assunto.
"Com base nas informações atuais e no conhecimento sobre a transmissão de vírus intimamente relacionados, trata-se de um caso humano isolado; é improvável que isso leve a uma propagação mais ampla neste momento", afirmou a OMS, sediada em Genebra, que coordena respostas a questões e emergências de saúde pública em nível internacional.
"Estamos, claramente, diante de um caso sem precedentes do ponto de vista científico e virológico. Ele está associado ao sistema imunológico severamente debilitado desse homem", explicou Gregory Emery, diretor-geral de saúde da França, a jornalistas.
"Do ponto de vista médico e de saúde pública, não há motivo para alerta nem crise", acrescentou.
VÍRUS EM ANIMAIS NA EUROPA Transmitido por mosquitos picadores e mais comumente encontrado em bovinos, o vírus Shamonda também já foi detectado em cavalos, alpacas, ovelhas e cabras, informou a Organização Mundial de Saúde Animal (WOAH, na sigla em inglês).
Não há relato de transmissão de gado para humanos ou de humano para humano, disse Emery.
Atualmente, não há vacinas comercialmente disponíveis contra o vírus Shamonda, informou a WOAH.
Identificado na Nigéria em meados da década de 1960, o vírus Shamonda foi confirmado pela primeira vez na Europa no final de julho, após testes genômicos em bovinos doentes no sul da Alemanha, na Suíça e no leste da França.
Um relatório do boletim semanal de vigilância sanitária animal da França indicou que o vírus também havia sido detectado na Áustria, Bélgica, Irlanda, Itália, Liechtenstein, Luxemburgo, Holanda, Portugal, Eslovênia, Espanha e na ilha de Jersey, no Reino Unido.
O vírus provoca diversos efeitos nos animais. O gado infectado apresenta diarreia, fraqueza, perda de apetite e, com menos frequência, febre, informaram as autoridades francesas de saúde animal.
Um estudo realizado em nove fazendas leiteiras francesas constatou que a produção de leite caiu em até 75% nos rebanhos afetados.

Oct 22 : Tesla's shares fell 2 per cent on Thursday after the EV maker cut its capital spending forecast, raising concerns among investors counting on heavy investment for Elon Musk's AI and robotics vision.
The company on Wednesday lowered its 2026 capital spending forecast to about $20 billion from more than $25 billion after spending far less than expected on AI and robotics in the third quarter, which led to a surprise positive free cash flow.
The strong position may prove valuable as CEO Musk explores combining Tesla with the far more capital-intensive SpaceX.
Capex is a delicate balance in this market, said Josh Gilbert, lead analyst at etoro. Investors welcome a larger budget if they can see returns, but a smaller one hints at slowing growth, he added.

"For a stock priced on Cybercab and Optimus, that (capex forecast cut) explains why the shares went nowhere on a result that beat on most measures."
Tesla did not break down the areas that would see spending cuts and the leadership on Wednesday attributed the adjustment to managing capital deployment efficiently.
Tesla's shares have declined about 14 per cent this year, in contrast to the Nasdaq's roughly 15 per cent gain. The stock is about 23 per cent below its record intraday high of $498.83, reached in December.
Its valuation, however, remains well above peers: Tesla traded at 188.24 times its forward earnings estimates, compared with 6.58 for Ford and 5.16 for General Motors.
Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees to discuss a potential mega-merger, Musk said on Tuesday. The move could create an AI, cars, satellites and rockets behemoth worth about $3.5 trillion.
"The risk is Tesla now enters a period of limbo while investors await news on a potential combination with SpaceX, which ... might face significant regulatory hurdles," said Russ Mould, investment director at AJ Bell.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [香港 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[香港 ２２日 ロイター] - 破綻した中国不動産開発業者、中国恒大集団の清算人は２２日、２０２４年１月に香港の裁判所が清算を命じて以来２回目となる進捗報告書を公表し、これまでの資産売却や貸付金回収を通じて４億３５９０万ドルを回収したと明らかにした。ただ、同社に対して約４６０億ドルの債権を保有する債権者への返済がいかに困難であるかが浮き彫りになっている。

清算人は、２７年上半期に債権者への第１回中間配当を目指すとしているが、その額は未定だ。

かつて中国最大の不動産開発業者だった同社は、約３０００億ドルの負債の大部分について債務不履行に陥り、中国不動産危機の象徴となった。

香港本社で発見された１０７点の美術品のうち９６点が２８８０万ドルで売却されたが、損失を伴うものだったという。このコレクションには、ピカソ、モネ、ウォーホルの作品に加え、ムーアやヘップワースの彫刻も含まれていた。

第４・四半期にはプライベートジェットも売却対象となっており、約１２００万ドルでの売却が見込まれている。また、清算人は、２０年に行われた寄付金の一部について、米国の大学に対し２００万ドルの返還を求めている。

業界の専門家らは、会社の規模と複雑さを考慮すると、恒大集団の清算が完了するまでには１０年以上かかる可能性があると指摘している。

items.title: サウジアラムコ、本社退避を指示　フーシ派との戦闘激化
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Timour Azhari　Marwa Rashad　Olesya Astakhova

[ドバイ ２２日 ロイター] - 石油大手サウジアラムコは、湾岸の
items.body:
Timour Azhari　Marwa Rashad　Olesya Astakhova

[ドバイ ２２日 ロイター] - 石油大手サウジアラムコは、湾岸の ダーランにある本社から退避してリモート勤務に切り替えるよう従業員に指示した。関係筋６人が２２日、明らかにした。世界最大の原油輸出国サウジと、イランと同盟関係にあるイエメンの武装組織フーシ派との戦闘が激化している。 

今回の指示は、フーシ派がアラムコやサウジの空港を標的とする一連の攻撃を行った後に出された。イラン戦争開始以降では初の本社退避となるが、アラムコのコメントは得られていない。退避の理由は不明だ。

アラムコ本社には、世界最大の石油会社であるアラムコが陸上・海上の石油掘削施設や製油所、輸出ターミナル、総延長数千キロのパイプラインを監視するための操業管理センターがある。

サウジアラビア民間航空総局は２２日、東部の石油産業拠点ダンマンにあるキング・ファハド国際空港が２１日夜に攻撃され、２人が死亡、８人が負傷したと発表した。ダンマンはダーランの北約１５キロに位置する。

これとは別にサウジのエネルギー省によると、２１日には南東に数百キロ離れたアラムコのシャイバ油田の施設を攻撃しようとしたドローンをサウジの防空部隊が迎撃し、その後２人が死亡した。

サウジはフーシ派の攻撃に対し、ミサイル発射拠点への一連の攻撃で応じている。

フーシ派のサリー軍報道官はテレビ演説で、紅海沿岸都市ヤンブーにあるアラムコの施設と、首都リヤドのサウジ国防省を攻撃したと表明した。サウジ当局は攻撃を確認していない。

一方サウジ主導の連合軍は２２日、リヤドとヤンブーに近いイスラム教の聖地メディナの上空でドローンを迎撃したと発表した。

これとは別にサリー氏は２２日、海峡近くのズカル島沖で攻撃されたインド人１４人を乗せた船の救助を進めていると明らかにした。同島はフーシ派が９月の進攻で制圧した地域の一つ。攻撃をサウジによるものと非難した。

フーシ派は今月、本社ビルを攻撃し、甚大な被害を与えていた。

米当局者が２１日にロイターに明らかにしたところによると、米国務省はサウジにある在外公館の一部外交官と家族に退避を命じ、湾岸地域にある他の複数の米在外公館からも家族を退避させる方針だ。

items.title: El oro cae a mínimo de más de dos meses por el temor a la inflación
items.author: Noel John, Anushree Mukherjee
items.creator: Noel John, Anushree Mukherjee
items.summary: El oro cayó el jueves a un mínimo de más de dos meses, ya que el aumento de los precios del petróleo avivó el temor a la inflación, lo que reforzó las expectativas de que las tasas de interés podrían mantenerse altas durante más tiempo, mientras los inversores esperaban con interés la reunión de la Reserva Federal de la próxima semana.
items.body:
El oro cayó el jueves a un mínimo de más de dos meses, ya que el aumento de los precios del petróleo avivó el temor a la inflación, lo que reforzó las expectativas de que las tasas de interés podrían mantenerse altas durante más tiempo, mientras los inversores esperaban con interés la reunión de la Reserva Federal de la próxima semana.
El oro al contado cayó un 2,4%, a 4.041,39 dólares por onza, a las 1805 GMT, su nivel más bajo desde el 3 de agosto. Los futuros del oro estadounidense para entrega en diciembre cerraron con un descenso del 2,2%, a 4.060,40 dólares por onza.
Los precios del petróleo subían alrededor de un 3%, a máximos de cinco meses, después de que los ataques hutíes en Arabia Saudita hicieron crecer el temor a nuevas interrupciones del suministro energético.
"Hemos visto cómo los precios de la energía subían de la noche a la mañana. Y, como consecuencia de ello, está aumentando la preocupación por las presiones inflacionistas. A medida que aumentan esas presiones inflacionistas, vemos el resultado obvio de los temores de que la Fed vaya a seguir subiendo las tasas de interés", dijo David Meger, director de operaciones con metales de High Ridge Futures.
Aunque el oro suele considerarse una cobertura frente a la inflación, el aumento de las tasas de interés reduce el atractivo de este activo, que no rinde intereses.
Los datos de la semana pasada sobre la inflación de los consumidores y de los productores en Estados Unidos fueron más altos de lo esperado, en gran parte debido a que los costos energéticos siguen subiendo. Esto refuerza los argumentos a favor de una política monetaria más restrictiva, aunque se sigue esperando que los responsables de la Fed mantengan el "statu quo" cuando se reúnan los días 27 y 28 de octubre.
Según la herramienta FedWatch de CME, los operadores descuentan una probabilidad del 91% de que se produzca una subida en diciembre.
Los datos sobre el gasto en consumo personal (PCE) de Estados Unidos, cuya publicación está prevista para el 29 de octubre y que el banco central sigue muy de cerca, podrían ofrecer más pistas sobre las perspectivas de las tasas de interés.
Entre otros metales, la plata al contado cayó un 5,4%, a 54,84 dólares por onza; el platino bajó un 3,7%, a 1.570,85 dólares, mientras que el paladio descendió un 2,7%, a 1.057,83 dólares.

items.title: ＰＨＰの脆弱性、韓国が緊急対応　サイバー警戒レベル引き上げ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 韓国政府は２２日、ウェブ開発用プログラミング言語「ＰＨＰ」に重大な脆弱性が見つかり、ハッキングの危険性が高まったことを受け、民間部門のサイバーセキュリティー警戒レベルを引き上げ、緊急対応措置を発動した。

大統領府の発表によると、国家安保室は情報機関、国防省、科学省の当局者を集めた緊急会議を開き、官民と軍の対応を検討した。

科学省は、最高情報セキュリティー責任者を登録している約２万８０００社と、政府の情報共有ネットワークに参加する５９００のメンバーのほか、重要インフラの運営事業者、ウェブホスティング企業、データセンターにセキュリティー対策を通知したと明らかにした。

政府は各組織に対し、ＰＨＰの開発者が２１日に公開したセキュリティー更新プログラムを導入するよう促し、すぐに修正できない場合は暫定的な防御措置を講じるよう求めた。

科学省によると、これらの脆弱性が悪用されると、攻撃者が認証なしで悪意のあるコマンドを実行したり、データを盗んだり、ウェブサイトを停止させたりする恐れがある。

items.title: US refiner Valero posts record quarterly profit as supply disruptions boost margins
items.author: Nicole Jao, Vallari Srivastava
items.creator: Nicole Jao, Vallari Srivastava
items.summary: Refiner Valero Energy kicked off earnings season for US refiners on Thursday by posting its highest-ever quarterly profit, beating Wall Street expectations, as fuel supply disruptions due to wars in Iran and Ukraine boosted margins during the third quarter.
items.body:
Refiner Valero Energy (VLO.N) kicked off earnings season for US refiners on Thursday by posting its highest-ever quarterly profit, beating Wall Street expectations, as fuel supply disruptions due to wars in Iran and Ukraine boosted margins during the third quarter.
Diesel, used in manufacturing and agriculture, has hit record high prices, and gasoline prices are also elevated, creating pain for consumers and US President Donald Trump's Republican Party ahead of next month's midterm elections, but enriching refiners.
The 3-2-1 crack spread , which measures US refinery margins, gained more than 150% during the July-September period, from a year earlier.
Valero said its refining margin per barrel of throughput nearly tripled to $39.24 in the quarter, with adjusted operating earnings in the refining segment jumping over 400% to $8.8 billion from a year earlier.
Valero shares were down 3%.
NO SIGNS OF SOFTENING DEMAND The US, the world's largest crude oil producer and second-largest refiner after China, ramped up exports of crude, gasoline, diesel and jet fuel to record levels earlier this year, following war-driven supply disruptions.
"Export demand for diesel is also very, very strong, both to Latin America and Europe," Chief Operating Officer Gary Simmons said during a call with investors. He said economic and trucking industry indicators show demand for the fuel will remain robust.
US refiners are also running at 95% to 100% of capacity, with many delaying planned maintenance to benefit from high energy prices.
Valero plans to operate its refineries in the United States and Britain at 96% to 99% of their combined total throughput capacity of 3 million barrels per day in the fourth quarter.
Valero said it has completed an optimization project at its St. Charles refinery in Louisiana, increasing production capacity of alkylate and gasoline.
The Texas-based company posted adjusted profit of $23.90 per share, up about 553% from the same time last year.
"While the volatility is probably not behind us at this point, we're in a good position to be even more aggressive with shareholder returns," Chief Financial Officer Homer Bhullar said. "Whether margins and cash flow profile of our business remain strong or not, our long-term targets on cash have really not changed."

items.title: Lockheed lands Pentagon deal for 850 F-35 jets, lifts annual forecast
items.author: Mike Stone, Aatreyee Dasgupta
items.creator: Mike Stone, Aatreyee Dasgupta
items.summary: Lockheed Martin announced an agreement on Thursday to sell the Pentagon at least 850 stealthy F-35 Lightning II fighter jets over the next 10 years, a deal worth at least $78 billion.
items.body:
Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) announced an agreement on Thursday to sell the Pentagon at least 850 stealthy F-35 Lightning II fighter jets over the next 10 years, a deal worth at least $78 billion.
Lockheed shares surged as much as 10%, on track for their biggest percentage gain in three months. The US defense contractor raised its annual sales and profit forecasts to beat Wall Street estimates, as geopolitical conflicts drove demand for its systems.
The fighter jet, which the company considers the world's most advanced, uses stealth technology to evade enemy detection. It is at the core of Lockheed's aeronautics division, which generates nearly 40% of the company's quarterly revenue.
Under the agreement, Lockheed will aim to maintain annual production at 156 aircraft for US and international customers, and the company will self-fund at least $7 billion in initiatives that support the F-35 program.
"That investment will help both with the ability to produce the capabilities on the production line now, as well as in the supply base, the tooling, and the workforce repair lines," OJ Sanchez, president of Lockheed Martin's aeronautics segment, told Reuters.
As the fleet of F-35 jets grows, repair and maintenance needs have increased, straining the industry's F-35 production and repair capacity. Part of the investment will fund new repair lines at the original equipment manufacturers, said Chauncey McIntosh, general manager of the F-35 Lightning II program. Smaller suppliers often lack dedicated repair lines and use the same equipment and workers for repair work that they use to manufacture new parts, which McIntosh said is inefficient.
The agreement does not constitute a sales order, but Lockheed counts it as a prearranged long-term contract. The deal requires US congressional approval.
$78-BILLION DEAL The least expensive version of the jet costs $92 million, so the [USN:L4N4680VI TEXT:"10-year framework agreement"] would be worth at least $78.2 billion. The Marines' F-35B short takeoff and landing version of the jet costs $121 million and the Navy's F-35C costs $110 million. The contract's mix of jets is unknown, and prices are expected to rise with inflation and labor costs.
Lockheed, a supplier of missile-defense systems such as Patriot Advanced Capability-3 (PAC-3) and Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) interceptors, joined RTX (RTX.N) and Northrop Grumman (NOC.N) in [USN:L4N4660W1 TEXT:"raising forecasts this week"] on strong demand for munitions, air-defense systems and military aircraft.
Lockheed expects 2026 sales of about $80 billion to $82 billion, up from its prior forecast of $79.75 billion to $81.75 billion.
The company also lifted its annual earnings-per-share forecast to range between $30.35 and $30.75 from its previous view of $29.95 to $30.65.
The company's backlog rose 27% sequentially to a record $292 billion, boosted by a $52.5 billion multiyear award for PAC-3 Missile Segment Enhancement interceptors, stockpiles of which were heavily used by US and allied forces in the Iran war.
Lockheed raised its 2026 free cash flow forecast to about $7.8 billion to $8 billion, from $7 billion to $7.2 billion earlier.
Sales for the quarter ended on September 27 rose 11% to $20.71 billion, driven by 24% growth in its missiles unit on higher PAC-3 and THAAD production and a 13% increase in aeronautics revenue from F-35 and C-130 programs.
Analysts estimated $20.51 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.
Chief Financial Officer Evan Scott told Reuters a fourth-quarter increase in capital spending would be driven primarily by investments to expand munitions production capacity.
Third-quarter profit of $7.97 per share came in above analysts' estimate of $7.43 per share.

items.title: Polymarket, Kalshi expand political donations as firms face state, federal scrutiny
items.author: Douglas Gillison
items.creator: Douglas Gillison
items.summary: Prediction market operators Kalshi, Polymarket and their founders have given at least $5 million combined to Republican and Democratic political groups this election cycle, according to campaign finance records and a private remittance document seen by Reuters.
items.body:
Prediction market operators Kalshi, Polymarket and their founders have given at least $5 million combined to Republican and Democratic political groups this election cycle, according to campaign finance records and a private remittance document seen by Reuters.
The spending includes a previously unreported $1 million donation Polymarket made to a Democratic nonprofit that does not disclose its donors, the remittance document shows.
Though a fraction of the [USN:L1N4310KM TEXT:"money spent by similar industries such as crypto"] and [USN:L6N43Q0T7 TEXT:"sports betting"], the companies' $5 million outlay is a sharp increase on the 2024 cycle, marking their first significant foray into political giving.

The pair have so far slightly favored Republicans, who received $2.7 million, with Democrats taking the remainder. Just over a third of the total cash went to state-level groups backing candidates for governor, attorney general and state legislatures, according to an analysis by the Center for Political Accountability (CPA), a transparency nonprofit.
The spending surge comes as both companies [USN:L6N45G0XO TEXT:"battle state efforts to regulate their wagers as gambling"], and as they face growing scrutiny from federal lawmakers worried that prediction markets are spawning insider trading and undermining national security.
"We have an industry where we're kind of figuring out the regulations on the fly," said David Primo, a professor of political science at the University of Rochester in New York.
"If you're not engaging with these politicians, other people are going to be writing these regulations, and that could be an existential threat to these companies," he said.
In a statement, Kalshi's head of federal government relations, John Bivona, said that by Election Day the company's full disclosures would show that its donations were roughly evenly distributed across both parties.
"Regulation that keeps prediction markets safe for consumers and allows them to grow in America isn't a partisan issue," he added.
A Polymarket spokesperson did not address questions about the company's donations but said in an email: "We engage with all sides of the debate and welcome conversations with anyone who wants to learn more about our platform."
POLYMARKET CEO COPLAN STARTS GIVING TO REPUBLICANS Prediction markets allow wagers on an array of events, including sports games, elections and government announcements. Kalshi and Polymarket rose to prominence in 2024 when they bucked traditional opinion polls in [USN:L1N3M00OE TEXT:"signaling that President Donald Trump"], a Republican, would win the election.
Trump's administration has generally supported the industry, although a handful of congressional Republicans have raised concerns about election betting. Democrats, meanwhile, have introduced multiple bills aimed at restricting prediction wagers.
Polymarket Chief Executive Shayne Coplan, who previously donated almost exclusively to Democrats, has broadened his giving this cycle. Campaign finance records show that he and Polymarket have directed roughly $1.3 million to Republican committees and candidates, while also supporting Democratic groups.
According to the remittance document seen by Reuters, Blockratize Inc, which operates as Polymarket, this summer transferred $1 million to House Majority Forward, a nonprofit that works to elect Democrats. Companies frequently donate via such tax-exempt "dark-money" organizations, which are not required to disclose their donors.
Polymarket and Coplan gave the roughly $1.3 million combined to the Republican National Committee, as well as a super political action committee, or PAC, supporting House Republicans, and V-PAC, a super PAC which supports Ohio Republican gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy.
Representatives for House Majority Forward and the Republican fundraising vehicles either declined to comment or did not respond to requests for comment.
Reuters could not identify any political contributions by Kalshi founders Luana Lopes Lara and Tarek Mansour in publicly available campaign finance records for previous cycles. As of early October, they had given at least $1 million, about 72% of which went to Republican causes and candidates, campaign finance records show.
COMPANIES GIVE TO STATE GROUPS AMID LEGAL FIGHT State gaming authorities, attorneys general and Native American tribes have sued to block Kalshi, Polymarket and others from offering sports bets, arguing that such wagers are gambling and subject to stringent state oversight. The companies say their wagers [USN:L6N43T15B TEXT:"are financial instruments"] overseen by federal agencies.
This cycle, the companies began donating to groups that back state-level candidates who could determine how that fight unfolds, with spending accelerating over the past 12 months and so far marginally favoring Democrats, the CPA data shows.
Kalshi has so far given nearly $1.5 million to such groups, split roughly evenly across both parties. Polymarket has so far given nearly $250,000 to two Democratic groups and one Republican group, the data shows.
Jeanne Hanna, vice president for research at CPA, said the slight tilt toward Democratic groups could reflect an expectation that the party is poised for greater success at the state level this election cycle. In addition to funding campaigns, such state-level groups also allow companies to establish rapport with policymakers, she said.
"There definitely is a membership structure in which larger contributions get you greater access," she added.

items.title: ロシュ、第3四半期売上高が予想上回る　主力薬堅調
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Patrick Wingrove　Marleen Kaesebier

[チューリヒ／ロンドン ２２日] -
items.body:
Patrick Wingrove　Marleen Kaesebier

[チューリヒ／ロンドン ２２日] - スイスの製薬大手ロシュが２２日発表した第３・四半期売上高は、市場予想を上回った。「オクレバス」など主力薬の需要が堅調だった。

グループ売上高は為替変動の影響を除くベースで７％増の１６１億３０００万スイスフラン（１９６億１０００万ドル）となり、同社がまとめた市場予想の１５７億５０００万フラン（１９１億５０００万ドル）を上回った。

ただ競争圧力の兆しも表れた。大型薬「ゾレア」は初の安価な後続品が発売された影響で、売上高が８億４８００万フラン（１０億３０００万ドル）と、市場予想の９億２５００万フラン（１１億２０００万ドル）を下回った。

株価は午前の取引で１．１％下落した。

診断部門の売上高は５％増の３５億４０００万フラン（４３億ドル）で、経営陣は、来年は１桁台半ばから後半の「通常」の伸びに戻る見通しだとした。中国市場について、医療価格改革による下押し圧力は和らいでいると指摘した。

ドルの対スイスフラン相場が安定しつつあることもロシュに追い風となった。グループ売上高の半分近くを占める北米市場で、長引いていた為替の悪影響が和らいだ。

医薬品部門は主力薬がけん引した。中でも多発性硬化症の注射薬オクレバスは、売上高が為替変動の影響を除くベースで９％増の１８億４０００万フラン（２２億４０００万ドル）となった。
